title_en: SynerMedGen: Synergizing Medical Multimodal Understanding with Generation via Task Alignment
title_zh: SynerMedGen：通过任务对齐协同医学多模态理解与生成

sentences.en: Unifying multimodal understanding and generation is a compelling frontier that is beginning to emerge in the medical field.
sentences.zh: 统一多模态理解与生成是一个引人注目的前沿方向，正在医学领域开始兴起。

sentences.en: However, the limited existing unified medical models typically treat understanding and generation as disjoint objectives, lacking a meaningful functional synergy.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的统一医学模型为数不多，它们通常将理解与生成视为互不相干的目标，缺乏有意义的功能协同。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify and address a critical question in unified medical modeling: what form of “understanding” truly benefits generation.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们识别并回应了统一医学建模中的一个关键问题：究竟何种形式的“理解”才能真正惠及生成。

sentences.en: We present SynerMedGen, a unified framework built on the proposed principle of generation-aligned understanding, which synergizes understanding objectives with generation tasks via task alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SynerMedGen，一个构建在所提出的生成对齐理解原则之上的统一框架，通过任务对齐将理解目标与生成任务协同起来。

sentences.en: SynerMedGen introduces three generation-aligned understanding tasks and a two-stage training strategy that transfers generation-beneficial representations learned during understanding training to medical image synthesis.
sentences.zh: SynerMedGen 引入了三个生成对齐的理解任务，以及一个两阶段训练策略，将理解训练期间学到的有益于生成的表示迁移到医学图像合成中。

sentences.en: Remarkably, even with understanding training alone, our SynerMedGen achieves strong zero-shot performance across 22 medical image synthesis tasks and demonstrates robust generalization.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，即使仅进行理解训练，我们的 SynerMedGen 也能在 22 个医学图像合成任务上取得强劲的零样本性能，并展现出稳健的泛化能力。

sentences.en: When combined with generation training, SynerMedGen consistently outperforms state-of-the-art specialized medical image synthesis models as well as recent unified medical models.
sentences.zh: 当与生成训练相结合时，SynerMedGen 持续优于最先进的医学图像合成专用模型以及近期的统一医学模型。

sentences.en: We also release SynerMed, a large-scale dataset of 1M paired synthesis samples and 2M understanding instances for studying understanding–generation synergy.
sentences.zh: 我们还发布了 SynerMed，一个包含 100 万配对合成样本和 200 万理解实例的大规模数据集，用于研究理解-生成协同。

sentences.en: Our project can be accessed at https://github.com/piooip/SynerMedGen.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目可在 https://github.com/piooip/SynerMedGen 访问。

title_en: SynGR: Unleashing the Potential of Cross-Modal Synergy for Generative Recommendation
title_zh: SynGR：释放跨模态协同在生成式推荐中的潜力

sentences.en: Generative Recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm by formulating item recommendation as a sequence-to-sequence generation task over item identifiers.
sentences.zh: 生成式推荐（GR）已作为一种前景广阔的范式出现，它将物品推荐表述为基于物品标识符的序列到序列生成任务。

sentences.en: Recent studies have incorporated multimodal signals to provide richer token-level evidence for generation.
sentences.zh: 近期研究已纳入多模态信号，以为生成提供更丰富的词元级证据。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches largely rely on alignment-centric fusion and underexplore synergistic information across modalities.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法在很大程度上依赖以对齐为中心的融合，对跨模态的协同信息探索不足。

sentences.en: In practice, synergistic information plays a critical role in capturing emergent item properties that cannot be inferred from any single modality alone.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，协同信息在捕获无法仅从任何单一模态推断出的涌现物品属性方面发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: Such properties encode intrinsic item semantics and guide user preferences, enabling models to move beyond surface-level feature matching.
sentences.zh: 此类属性编码了物品的内在语义并引导用户偏好，使模型能够超越表面层面的特征匹配。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SynGR}, a synergistic generative recommendation framework that explicitly encourages the exploitation of cross-modal dependencies during generation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出了 \textbf{SynGR}\，一种协同生成式推荐框架，明确鼓励在生成过程中利用跨模态依赖。

sentences.en: By constraining overreliance on dominant modalities, SynGR enables the model to capture emergent item semantics beyond shared or modality-specific signals.
sentences.zh: 通过约束对主导模态的过度依赖，SynGR 使模型能够捕获超越共享或模态特异信号的涌现物品语义。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets demonstrate that SynGR achieves superior  performance.
sentences.zh: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SynGR 取得了优越的性能。

title_en: SynLaD: Latent Diffusion for Generating Synthesizable Molecules Conditioned on 3D Pharmacophore Profiles
title_zh: SynLaD：以 3D 药效团分布为条件生成可合成分子的潜扩散模型

sentences.en: We present SynLaD, a latent diffusion framework for small-molecule generation that unifies ligand-based drug design objectives (what to make) with synthetic accessibility (how to make it).
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 SynLaD，一个用于小分子生成的潜扩散框架，将基于配体的药物设计目标（该合成什么）与合成可行性（该如何合成）统一起来。

sentences.en: Current models typically optimize one objective at the expense of the other, creating a bottleneck for discovering high-scoring and synthesizable molecules.
sentences.zh: 现有模型通常以牺牲一个目标为代价来优化另一个，从而成为发现高分且可合成分子的瓶颈。

sentences.en: SynLaD combines reaction-constrained generation with pharmacophore-conditioned 3D design by learning a latent space that decodes to both 3D structures and synthesis pathways.
sentences.zh: SynLaD 通过学习一个既能解码为 3D 结构又能解码为合成路径的潜在空间，将反应约束生成与药效团条件化 3D 设计相结合。

sentences.en: An encoder maps molecules to a latent representation used by two decoder heads: (i) a geometric head that reconstructs atom types and coordinates and (ii) an autoregressive synthesis head that outputs synthetic routes in a serialized, reaction-based notation.
sentences.zh: 编码器将分子映射到两种解码头使用的潜在表示：（i）重构原子类型和坐标的几何头，以及（ii）以序列化、基于反应的记法输出合成路线的自回归合成头。

sentences.en: A diffusion transformer generates novel latents in the learned space, conditioned on pharmacophore profiles.
sentences.zh: 扩散 Transformer 在所学空间中生成新颖的潜在表示，并以药效团分布为条件。

sentences.en: Across analogue generation tasks for bioactive ligands, SynLaD outperforms existing baselines in synthesizable and diverse hit generation, demonstrating that a single model can produce shape-aligned molecules with feasible synthesis plans.
sentences.zh: 在生物活性配体的类似物生成任务中，SynLaD 在可合成且多样的命中生成方面优于现有基线，表明单一模型可以产生形状对齐且具有可行合成方案的分子。

title_en: Syntax vs. Semantics: How Transformers Learn Deep Dependencies
title_zh: 语法与语义：Transformer 如何学习深层依赖

sentences.en: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable syntactic fluency, yet the optimization dynamics governing their acquisition of deep semantic dependencies remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型展现出显著的句法流畅性，但支配它们习得深层语义依赖的优化动态仍鲜为人知。

sentences.en: We propose a mechanistic framework that models this learning process as a competition between Surface Statistics and Deep Semantics.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个机制性框架，将这一学习过程建模为表层统计与深层语义之间的竞争。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis identifies a "Gradient Starvation" phenomenon where the error signals for sparse semantic dependencies are actively suppressed during early optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析识别出一种“梯度饥饿”现象，即在早期优化阶段，针对稀疏语义依赖的误差信号被主动抑制。

sentences.en: This suppression impedes the learning of structural reasoning and causes its emergence to manifest as a sudden phase transition.
sentences.zh: 这种抑制阻碍了结构推理的学习，并使其涌现表现为突发的相变。

sentences.en: Furthermore, this framework offers a mechanistic basis for the effectiveness of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) strategies.
sentences.zh: 此外，这一框架为思维链（CoT）策略的有效性提供了机制基础。

sentences.en: By externalizing intermediate reasoning steps into concrete tokens, CoT effectively bypasses the suppression regime inherent to implicit reasoning.
sentences.zh: 通过将中间推理步骤外化为具体的词元，CoT 有效绕过了隐式推理所固有的抑制机制。

sentences.en: We validate these findings across scales ranging from toy transformers to production models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B).
sentences.zh: 我们在从玩具 Transformer 到生产模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B）的多种规模上验证了这些发现。

sentences.en: Finally, guided by this theory, we propose a topology-aligned contrastive objective that explicitly rectifies the gradient geometry.
sentences.zh: 最后，在这些理论的指导下，我们提出了一个拓扑对齐的对比目标，显式地修正梯度几何。

sentences.en: Experiments on variable binding tasks demonstrate that our method achieves an improvement that is over 2× larger than that obtained via standard cross-entropy fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在变量绑定任务上的实验表明，我们的方法取得的提升是标准交叉熵微调所获提升的 2 倍以上。

sentences.en: Code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/jr-zhao/Deep-Dependencies/tree/main.
sentences.zh: 代码将公开发布于：https://github.com/jr-zhao/Deep-Dependencies/tree/main。

title_en: Synthesizable Molecular Generation via Soft-constrained GFlowNets with Rich Chemical Priors
title_zh: 利用富含化学先验的软约束 GFlowNets 进行可合成分子的生成

sentences.en: The application of generative models for experimental drug discovery campaigns is severely limited by the difficulty of designing molecules de novo that can be synthesized in practice.
sentences.zh: 生成模型在实验药物发现活动中的应用，严重受限于难以从头设计实际可合成的分子。

sentences.en: Previous works have leveraged Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) to impose hard synthesizability constraints through the design of state and action spaces based on predefined reaction templates and building blocks.
sentences.zh: 先前工作已利用生成流网络（GFlowNets），通过基于预定义反应模板和构建模块设计状态与动作空间，来施加硬的可合成性约束。

sentences.en: Despite the promising prospects of this approach, it currently lacks flexibility and scalability.
sentences.zh: 尽管这种方法前景可观，但它目前缺乏灵活性和可扩展性。

sentences.en: As an alternative, we propose S3-GFN, which generates synthesizable SMILES molecules via simple soft regularization of a sequence-based GFlowNet.
sentences.zh: 作为替代方案，我们提出了 S3-GFN，通过对基于序列的 GFlowNet 施加简单的软正则化，来生成可合成的 SMILES 分子。

sentences.en: Our approach leverages rich molecular priors learned from large-scale SMILES corpora to steer molecular generation towards high-reward, synthesizable chemical spaces.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法利用从大规模 SMILES 语料中学到的丰富分子先验，将分子生成引向高奖励、可合成的化学空间。

sentences.en: The model induces constraints through off-policy replay training with a contrastive learning signal based on separate buffers of synthesizable and unsynthesizable samples.
sentences.zh: 该模型通过离策略回放训练来诱导约束，并借助基于可合成与不可合成样本分离缓冲区的对比学习信号。

sentences.en: Our experiments show that S3-GFN learns to generate synthesizable molecules ($\geq 95$%) with higher rewards in diverse tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，S3-GFN 在多种任务中学会了生成可合成的分子（$\geq 95$%），且奖励更高。

title_en: Synthesizing Multimodal Geometry Datasets from Scratch and Enabling Visual Alignment via Plotting Code
title_zh: 从零合成多模态几何数据集，并借助绘图代码实现视觉对齐

sentences.en: Multimodal geometry reasoning requires models to jointly understand visual diagrams and perform structured symbolic inference, yet current vision--language models struggle with complex geometric constructions due to limited training data and weak visual--symbolic alignment.
sentences.zh: 多模态几何推理要求模型同时理解视觉图形并执行结构化的符号推理，但当前的视觉-语言模型由于训练数据有限和视觉-符号对齐薄弱，在处理复杂几何构造时颇为吃力。

sentences.en: We propose a pipeline for synthesizing complex multimodal geometry problems from scratch and construct a dataset named \textbf{GeoCode}, which decouples problem generation into symbolic seed construction, grounded instantiation with verification, and code-based diagram rendering, ensuring consistency across structure, text, reasoning, and images.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一条从零合成复杂多模态几何问题的流水线，并构建了一个名为 \textbf{GeoCode}的数据集，它将问题生成解耦为符号种子构建、带验证的实例化，以及基于代码的图表渲染，从而确保结构、文本、推理和图像之间的一致性。

sentences.en: Leveraging the plotting code provided in GeoCode, we further introduce code prediction as an explicit alignment objective, transforming visual understanding into a supervised structured prediction task.
sentences.zh: 利用 GeoCode 中提供的绘图代码，我们进一步将代码预测引入为显式的对齐目标，把视觉理解转化为有监督的结构化预测任务。

sentences.en: GeoCode exhibits substantially higher structural complexity and reasoning difficulty than existing benchmarks, while maintaining mathematical correctness through multi-stage validation.
sentences.zh: GeoCode 表现出比现有基准高得多的结构复杂度和推理难度，同时通过多阶段验证保持数学正确性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that models trained on GeoCode achieve consistent improvements on multiple geometry benchmarks, demonstrating both the effectiveness of the dataset and the proposed alignment strategy.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在 GeoCode 上训练的模型在多个几何基准上取得了一致的改进，证明了该数据集和所提对齐策略的有效性。

title_en: Synthesizing world models for bilevel planning
title_zh: 为双层规划合成世界模型

sentences.en: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) systems have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex environments, such as video games.
sentences.zh: 现代强化学习（RL）系统在诸如电子游戏等复杂环境中已展现出卓越的能力。

sentences.en: However, they still fall short of achieving human-like sample efficiency and adaptability when learning new domains.
sentences.zh: 然而，当学习新领域时，它们仍未达到类人的样本效率和适应性。

sentences.en: Theory-based reinforcement learning (TBRL) is an algorithmic framework specifically designed to address this gap.
sentences.zh: 基于理论的强化学习（TBRL）是一种专门用于弥补这一差距的算法框架。

sentences.en: Modeled on cognitive theories, TBRL leverages structured, causal world models---``theories''---as forward simulators for use in planning, generalization and exploration.
sentences.zh: TBRL 以认知理论为模型，利用结构化、因果性的世界模型——“理论”——作为前向模拟器，用于规划、泛化和探索。

sentences.en: Although current TBRL systems provide compelling explanations of how humans learn to play video games, they face several technical limitations: their theory languages are restrictive, and their planning algorithms are not scalable.
sentences.zh: 尽管当前的 TBRL 系统为人类如何学习玩电子游戏提供了令人信服的解释，但它们仍面临若干技术局限：其理论语言具有限制性，其规划算法不具备可扩展性。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce TheoryCoder, an instantiation of TBRL that exploits hierarchical representations of theories and efficient program synthesis methods for more powerful learning and planning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们引入了 TheoryCoder，TBRL 的一种实例化，它利用理论的分层表示和高效的程序合成方法，实现更强大的学习与规划。

sentences.en: TheoryCoder equips agents with general-purpose abstractions (e.g., ``move to''), which are then grounded in a particular environment by learning a low-level transition model (a Python program synthesized from observations by a large language model).
sentences.zh: TheoryCoder 为智能体配备通用抽象（例如“移动到”），然后通过学习一个低层转移模型（由大型语言模型从观测中合成的 Python 程序），将这些抽象落地到特定环境中。

sentences.en: A bilevel planning algorithm can exploit this hierarchical structure to solve large domains.
sentences.zh: 一种双层规划算法可以利用这种分层结构来求解大规模领域。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that this approach can be successfully applied to diverse and challenging grid-world games, where approaches based on directly synthesizing a policy perform poorly.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，这种方法可以成功应用于多样且具有挑战性的网格世界游戏，而基于直接合成策略的方法在这些游戏中表现不佳。

sentences.en: Ablation studies demonstrate the benefits of using hierarchical abstractions.
sentences.zh: 消融研究证明了使用层次抽象的好处。

title_en: Systematic Failures in Collective Reasoning under Distributed Information in Multi-Agent LLMs
title_zh: 多智能体 LLM 在分布式信息下的集体推理系统性失效

sentences.en: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are expected to enhance decision-making by pooling distributed information, yet systematically evaluating this capability has remained challenging.
sentences.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的多智能体系统，预期通过汇集分布式信息来增强决策，但系统地评估这一能力仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: We introduce HiddenBench, a 65-task benchmark grounded in the Hidden Profile paradigm, which isolates collective reasoning under distributed information from individual reasoning ability.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 HiddenBench，一个扎根于隐藏档案范式的 65 任务基准，它将分布式信息下的集体推理与个体推理能力分离开来。

sentences.en: Evaluating 15 frontier LLMs, we find that multi-agent LLMs achieve only 30.1% accuracy under distributed information, compared to 80.7% accuracy for single agents given complete information.
sentences.zh: 对 15 个前沿 LLM 的评估显示，多智能体 LLM 在分布式信息下的准确率仅为 30.1%，而拥有完整信息的单个智能体准确率为 80.7%。

sentences.en: We trace this gap to a systematic failure mode: agents cannot recognize or act under latent information asymmetry—they fail to reason about what others might know but have not yet expressed, leading to premature convergence on shared evidence while critical distributed facts remain unexplored.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一差距追溯到一个系统性的失效模式：智能体无法识别或应对潜在的信息不对称——它们无法推理他人可能已知但尚未表达的内容，导致过早收敛于共享证据，而关键的分布式事实仍未被探索。

sentences.en: These failures persist across prompting strategies, communication depths, and group sizes—and worsen as groups scale.
sentences.zh: 这些失效在各类提示策略、通信深度和群体规模下持续存在——并且随着群体规模扩大而加剧。

sentences.en: While some models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro) outperform others, neither model scale nor individual reasoning accuracy reliably predicts collective performance.
sentences.zh: 虽然某些模型（例如 Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro）优于其他模型，但模型规模或个体推理准确率都不能可靠地预测集体性能。

sentences.en: We further show that this bottleneck is actionable: a lightweight structured communication protocol substantially improves collective reasoning across model families.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，这一瓶颈是可以改变的：一种轻量级的结构化通信协议能大幅提升各类模型家族的集体推理能力。

sentences.en: Our results identify failures in collective information exploration in decision-making as a key limitation of multi-agent LLMs, and provide a theory-grounded, reproducible framework for diagnosing collective reasoning failures.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果将决策中集体信息探索的失效识别为多智能体 LLM 的关键局限，并提供了一个有理论依据、可复现的诊断集体推理失效的框架。

title_en: T$^2$PO: Uncertainty-Guided Exploration Control for Stable Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: T$^2$PO：面向稳定多轮智能体强化学习的不确定性引导探索控制

sentences.en: Recent progress in multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly improved reasoning LLMs' performances on complex interactive tasks.
sentences.zh: 多轮强化学习（RL）的近期进展显著提升了推理型 LLM 在复杂交互任务上的表现。

sentences.en: Despite advances in stabilization techniques such as fine-grained credit assignment and trajectory filtering, instability remains pervasive and often leads to training collapse.
sentences.zh: 尽管细粒度信用分配和轨迹过滤等稳定化技术不断进步，不稳定性仍然普遍存在，常常导致训练崩溃。

sentences.en: We argue that this instability stems from inefficient exploration in multi-turn settings, where policies continue to generate low-information actions that neither reduce uncertainty nor advance task progress.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这种不稳定性源于多轮设定下的低效探索，即策略持续生成低信息量的动作，这些动作既不能降低不确定性，也不能推进任务进展。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose Token- and Turn-level Policy Optimization (T$^2$PO), an uncertainty-aware framework that explicitly controls exploration at fine-grained levels.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了 Token 级与 Turn 级策略优化（T$^2$PO），一种不确定性感知框架，在细粒度层面显式控制探索。

sentences.en: At the token level, T$^2$PO monitors uncertainty dynamics and triggers a thinking intervention once  the marginal uncertainty change falls below a threshold.
sentences.zh: 在词元层面，T$^2$PO 监测不确定性动态，并在边际不确定性变化降至阈值以下时触发思考干预。

sentences.en: At the turn level, T$^2$PO identifies interactions with negligible exploration progress and dynamically resamples such turns to avoid wasted rollouts.
sentences.zh: 在回合层面，T$^2$PO 识别探索进展可忽略的交互，并动态重新采样此类回合，以避免浪费的 rollout。

sentences.en: We evaluate T$^2$PO in diverse environments, including WebShop, ALFWorld, and Search QA, demonstrating substantial gains in training stability and performance improvements with better exploration efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们在包括 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 Search QA 在内的多种环境中评估了 T$^2$PO，展示了训练稳定性和性能提升方面的显著收益，并具有更好的探索效率。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/T2PO-ICML-3C21.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/T2PO-ICML-3C21 获取。

title_en: T-Edit: Triple-Branch Diffusion Anchoring for Consistent Editing
title_zh: T-Edit：用于一致编辑的三分支扩散锚定

sentences.en: While Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MMDiTs) have achieved remarkable success in high-fidelity generation, maintaining semantic faithfulness and structural consistency during the image editing process remains a fundamental challenge.
sentences.zh: 虽然多模态扩散 Transformer（MMDiT）在高保真生成方面取得了巨大成功，但在图像编辑过程中保持语义忠实性和结构一致性仍是一个根本性挑战。

sentences.en: DiT-based editing is primarily limited by cumulative drift and semantic leakage induced by new textual conditions.
sentences.zh: 基于 DiT 的编辑主要受累积漂移以及新文本条件所引发的语义泄漏的限制。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose T-Edit, a training-free framework that formalizes consistent editing as a trajectory anchoring process.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 T-Edit，一个免训练框架，将一致编辑形式化为一种轨迹锚定过程。

sentences.en: T-Edit explicitly decouples the inversion, reconstruction, and editing trajectories, leveraging the reconstruction branch as a structural reference to achieve real-time compensation for deviations in the latent manifold.
sentences.zh: T-Edit 显式解耦反演、重建和编辑轨迹，利用重建分支作为结构参考，对潜在流形上的偏差实现实时补偿。

sentences.en: To further reveal the internal regulation mechanism of DiTs, we analyze the spatio-temporal heterogeneity of their layer-wise structural sensitivity and accordingly propose a Dynamic Vital Layer (DVL) localization mechanism based on information energy.
sentences.zh: 为进一步揭示 DiT 的内部调控机制，我们分析了其逐层结构敏感性的时空异质性，并据此提出了基于信息能量的动态关键层（DVL）定位机制。

sentences.en: Furthermore, addressing the asymmetry of textual perturbations in the frequency domain distribution, we introduce a frequency-aware strategy based on tensor Singular Value Decomposition (t-SVD) to anchor (TA) high-rank structural components.
sentences.zh: 此外，针对频率域分布中文本扰动的非对称性，我们引入了一种基于张量奇异值分解（t-SVD）的频率感知策略，用于锚定（TA）高秩结构分量。

sentences.en: Experiments show that T-Edit achieves state-of-the-art performance in both semantic alignment and structural fidelity, and can be seamlessly extended to multi-step editing and video scenarios, providing a new perspective for understanding and controlling the internal stability of DiTs.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，T-Edit 在语义对齐和结构保真度方面都取得了最先进的性能，并且可以无缝扩展到多步编辑和视频场景，为理解和控制 DiT 的内部稳定性提供了新的视角。

title_en: T-GINEE: A Tensor-Based Multi-Graph Representation Learning
title_zh: T-GINEE：基于张量的多图表示学习

sentences.en: While traditional network analysis focuses on single-layer networks, real-world systems often form multilayer networks with multiple relationship types.
sentences.zh: 传统网络分析聚焦于单层网络，而现实世界的系统往往形成具有多种关系类型的多层网络。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically fail to capture complex inter-layer dependencies by treating layers independently or aggregating them.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法往往将各层独立处理或简单聚合，难以捕获复杂的层间依赖。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose T-GINEE (Tensor-Based Generalized Multilayer-graph Estimating Equation), a statistical regularization framework combining tensor-based generalized estimating equations with task-specific loss to model cross-network correlations explicitly.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了 T-GINEE（基于张量的广义多层图估计方程），一个统计正则化框架，将基于张量的广义估计方程与任务特异损失相结合，以显式建模跨网络相关性。

sentences.en: Key innovations include: (1) CP tensor decomposition capturing structural dependencies via shared latent factors; (2) a generalized estimating equation framework modeling inter-layer correlations through working covariance matrices; and (3) a flexible link function accommodating characteristics like sparsity.
sentences.zh: 关键创新包括：（1）通过共享潜在因子捕获结构依赖的 CP 张量分解；（2）通过工作协方差矩阵建模层间相关性的广义估计方程框架；以及（3）能够适应稀疏性等特征的灵活连接函数。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis establishes consistency and asymptotic normality under mild conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析在温和条件下确立了相合性和渐近正态性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate T-GINEE’s effectiveness for multilayer network analysis.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的大量实验验证了 T-GINEE 在多层网络分析中的有效性。

sentences.en: Our code is available in the \textbf{supplementary materials} to ensure reproducibility.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 \textbf{supplementary materials}\ 中获取，以确保可复现性。

title_en: T-measure: A Topology-Consistent Metric for Binary Segmentation
title_zh: T-measure：一种拓扑一致的二值分割度量

sentences.en: Evaluation metrics establish a standard assessment framework for models, playing a pivotal role in model optimization and advancement.
sentences.zh: 评估指标为模型建立了标准化的评估框架，在模型优化和进步中发挥着举足轻重的作用。

sentences.en: However, widely adopted pixel-wise metrics (e.g., IoU, Dice) rely heavily on pixel-level statistics, often failing to capture the structural integrity of predictions.
sentences.zh: 然而，广泛采用的逐像素指标（例如 IoU、Dice）严重依赖像素级统计，往往无法捕获预测的结构完整性。

sentences.en: While the S-measure (S-m) incorporates structural perception to some extent, it struggles to differentiate critical structural violations and remains insensitive to background false positives and small objects.
sentences.zh: 虽然 S-measure（S-m）在一定程度上引入了结构感知，但它难以区分关键的结构性违背，并且对背景假阳性和小目标不敏感。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose the Topology-aware measure (T-m), a novel metric designed to explicitly quantify topological consistency.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出了拓扑感知度量（T-m），一种专门用于显式量化拓扑一致性的新型指标。

sentences.en: T-m employs the Fuzzy Jaccard Index as a foundational score, integrates a Topological Integrity term (I-topo) to penalize critical structural fragmentation, and utilizes a Boundary Alignment term (A-bdy) to evaluate boundary alignment.
sentences.zh: T-m 采用模糊 Jaccard 指数作为基础得分，并整合拓扑完整性项（I-topo）以惩罚关键的结构性碎片化，同时利用边界对齐项（A-bdy）评估边界对齐程度。

sentences.en: These three components synergize to achieve robust evaluation of prediction maps at the topological level.
sentences.zh: 这三个组成部分协同作用，以实现预测图在拓扑层面的稳健评估。

sentences.en: We establish a rigorous Meta-Measure validation framework and benchmark our method against nine mainstream metrics across diverse complex scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们建立了一个严格的元度量验证框架，并在各种复杂场景下将我们的方法与九种主流指标进行对比。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that T-m performs exceptionally in downstream tasks and maintains high consistency with human visual perception.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，T-m 在下游任务中表现卓越，并与人眼视觉感知保持高度一致性。

title_en: T-POP: Test-Time Personalization with Online Preference Feedback
title_zh: T-POP：利用在线偏好反馈进行测试时个性化

sentences.en: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) to individual user preferences is a critical step beyond generating generically helpful responses.
sentences.zh: 将大型语言模型（LLM）个性化到个体用户偏好，是超越生成普遍有用响应的关键一步。

sentences.en: However, current personalization methods are ill-suited for new users, as they typically require either slow, resource-intensive fine-tuning or a substantial amount of pre-existing user data, creating a significant cold-start problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的个性化方法不适合新用户，因为它们通常需要缓慢且资源密集的微调，或需要大量预先存在的用户数据，从而造成显著的冷启动问题。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we introduce a new paradigm for real-time personalization by learning from online pairwise preference feedback collected during text generation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们引入了一种实时个性化的新范式，通过从文本生成过程中收集的在线成对偏好反馈进行学习。

sentences.en: We propose T-POP (Test-Time Personalization with Online Preference Feedback), a novel algorithm that synergistically combines test-time alignment with dueling bandits.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 T-POP（利用在线偏好反馈进行测试时个性化），一种将测试时对齐与决斗式老虎机协同结合的新算法。

sentences.en: Without updating the LLM parameters, T-POP steers the decoding process of a frozen LLM by learning a reward function online that captures user preferences.
sentences.zh: 在不更新 LLM 参数的情况下，T-POP 通过在线学习一个捕获用户偏好的奖励函数，来引导冻结 LLM 的解码过程。

sentences.en: By leveraging dueling bandits, T-POP intelligently queries the user to efficiently balance between exploring their preferences and exploiting the learned knowledge to generate personalized text.
sentences.zh: 通过利用决斗式老虎机，T-POP 智能地询问用户，以高效平衡探索用户偏好与利用所学知识生成个性化文本。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that T-POP achieves rapid and data-efficient personalization, significantly outperforming existing baselines and showing consistent improvement with more user interactions.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，T-POP 实现了快速且数据高效的个性化，显著优于现有基线，并随着更多用户交互而持续改进。

title_en: T2AV-Compass: Towards Unified Evaluation for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
title_zh: T2AV-Compass：迈向文本到音视频生成的统一评估

sentences.en: Text-to-Audio-Video (T2AV) generation aims to synthesize temporally coherent video and semantically synchronized audio from natural language, yet its evaluation remains fragmented, often relying on unimodal metrics or narrowly scoped benchmarks that fail to capture cross-modal alignment, instruction following, and perceptual realism under complex prompts.
sentences.zh: 文本到音视频（T2AV）生成旨在从自然语言合成时间连贯的视频和语义同步的音频，但其评估仍然碎片化，往往依赖单模态指标或范围狭窄的基准，无法捕获复杂提示下的跨模态对齐、指令遵循和感知真实感。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we present T2AV-Compass, a unified benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of T2AV systems, consisting of 500 diverse and complex prompts constructed via a taxonomy-driven pipeline to ensure semantic richness and physical plausibility.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出了 T2AV-Compass，一个用于全面评估 T2AV 系统的统一基准，包含通过分类学驱动的流水线构建的 500 个多样且复杂的提示，以确保语义丰富性和物理合理性。

sentences.en: Besides, T2AV-Compass introduces a dual-level evaluation framework that integrates objective signal-level metrics for video quality, audio quality, and cross-modal alignment with a subjective MLLM-as-a-Judge protocol for instruction following and realism assessment.
sentences.zh: 此外，T2AV-Compass 引入了一个双层评估框架，将用于视频质量、音频质量和跨模态对齐的客观信号级指标，与用于指令遵循和真实感评估的主观 MLLM-as-a-Judge 协议相结合。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluation of 15 representative T2AV systems reveals that even the strongest models fall substantially short of human-level realism and cross-modal consistency, with persistent failures in audio realism, fine-grained synchronization, instruction following, etc. These results indicate significant improvement room for future models and highlight the value of T2AV-Compass as a challenging and diagnostic testbed for advancing text-to-audio-video generation.
sentences.zh: 对 15 个代表性 T2AV 系统的广泛评估表明，即使是最强的模型也远未达到人类水平的真实感和跨模态一致性，在音频真实感、细粒度同步、指令遵循等方面持续存在失败。这些结果表明未来模型仍有显著改进空间，并凸显了 T2AV-Compass 作为推动文本到音视频生成发展的挑战性诊断测试平台的价值。

title_en: Tabero: Learning Gentle Manipulation with Closed-Loop Force Feedback from Vision, Touch, and Language
title_zh: Tabero：利用视觉、触觉与语言的闭环力反馈学习轻柔操作

sentences.en: Tactile sensing is essential for robots to achieve human-like gentle manipulation.
sentences.zh: 触觉传感对机器人实现类人的轻柔操作至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models struggle to exploit tactile feedback for gentle manipulation due to scarce aligned vision-tactile-language data and the lack of effective closed-loop force feedback mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型难以利用触觉反馈进行轻柔操作，原因在于对齐的视觉-触觉-语言数据稀缺，且缺乏有效的闭环力反馈机制。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce Tabero, a benchmark and model suite for gentle, language-conditioned robotic manipulation that demands fine-grained contact force perception.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们介绍了 Tabero，一个面向轻柔、语言条件化机器人操作的基准和模型套件，它要求细粒度的接触力感知。

sentences.en: First, the Tabero benchmark addresses the scarcity of tactile data by presenting a data-efficient pipeline that repurposes open-source robot manipulation trajectories to generate diverse vision-tactile-language tasks, and establishes a multidimensional evaluation protocol that measures task success alongside physical interaction quality.
sentences.zh: 首先，Tabero 基准通过提出一条数据高效的流水线来解决触觉数据稀缺问题，该流水线重新利用开源的机器人操作轨迹来生成多样化的视觉-触觉-语言任务，并建立了一个多维评估协议，在衡量任务成功的同时评估物理交互质量。

sentences.en: Second, we propose Tabero-VTLA, an architecture with a decoupled force-position command interface; the resulting force-position commands are executed by a fixed hybrid controller to enable real-time, force-aware manipulation.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们提出了 Tabero-VTLA，一种具有解耦力-位置命令接口的架构；所得力-位置命令由固定的混合控制器执行，从而实现实时的力感知操作。

sentences.en: Evaluated on Tabero, our model maintains high task success while reducing average grip force by over 70\% under gentle instructions, demonstrating its ability to modulate interaction forces based on multimodal experience.
sentences.zh: 在 Tabero 上的评估表明，我们的模型在保持高任务成功率的同时，在轻柔指令下将平均抓取力降低了 70\% 以上，展示了其基于多模态经验调节交互力的能力。

title_en: TabICLv2: A Better, Faster, Scalable, and Open Tabular Foundation Model
title_zh: TabICLv2：一个更好、更快、可扩展且开放的表格基座模型

sentences.en: Tabular foundation models, such as TabPFNv2 and TabICL, have recently dethroned gradient-boosted trees at the top of predictive benchmarks, demonstrating the value of in-context learning for tabular data.
sentences.zh: 诸如 TabPFNv2 和 TabICL 之类的表格基座模型，近期已在预测基准的顶端取代了梯度提升树，证明了上下文学习对表格数据的价值。

sentences.en: We introduce TabICLv2, a new state-of-the-art foundation model for regression and classification built on three pillars: (1) a novel synthetic data generation engine designed for high pretraining diversity; (2) various architectural innovations, including a new scalable softmax in attention improving generalization to larger datasets without prohibitive long-sequence pretraining; and (3) optimized pretraining protocols, notably replacing AdamW with the Muon optimizer.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 TabICLv2，一个用于回归和分类的新的最先进基座模型，它建立在三大支柱之上：（1）一个为高预训练多样性而设计的新型合成数据生成引擎；（2）各种架构创新，包括一种新的可扩展注意力 softmax，能够无需代价高昂的长序列预训练就泛化到更大的数据集；以及（3）优化的预训练协议，特别是用 Muon 优化器取代 AdamW。

sentences.en: On the TabArena and TALENT benchmarks, TabICLv2 without any tuning surpasses the performance of the current state of the art, RealTabPFN-2.5 (hyperparameter-tuned, ensembled, and fine-tuned on real data).
sentences.zh: 在 TabArena 和 TALENT 基准上，未经任何调优的 TabICLv2 就超越了当前最先进的 RealTabPFN-2.5（经过超参数调优、集成并在真实数据上微调）。

sentences.en: With only moderate pretraining compute, TabICLv2 generalizes effectively to million-scale datasets under 50GB GPU memory while being markedly faster than RealTabPFN-2.5. We provide extensive ablation studies to quantify these contributions and foster open research by releasing code for inference, pretraining, and synthetic data generation at https://github.com/soda-inria/tabicl.
sentences.zh: 仅凭适度的预训练算力，TabICLv2 就能在 50GB GPU 内存下有效地泛化到百万规模数据集，同时明显快于 RealTabPFN-2.5。我们提供了广泛的消融研究来量化这些贡献，并在 https://github.com/soda-inria/tabicl 发布了推理、预训练和合成数据生成的代码，以促进开放研究。

title_en: TabMGP: Martingale Posterior with TabPFN
title_zh: TabMGP：基于 TabPFN 的鞅后验

sentences.en: Bayesian inference provides principled uncertainty quantification but is often limited by the challenges of prior and likelihood elicitation.
sentences.zh: 贝叶斯推断提供了有原则的不确定性量化，但常常受到先验与似然选取难题的限制。

sentences.en: The martingale posterior (MGP) (Fong et al., 2023) offers an alternative by replacing these requirements with a predictive rule.
sentences.zh: 鞅后验（MGP）（Fong 等人，2023）通过用预测规则取代这些要求，提供了一种替代方案。

sentences.en: In addition, the MGP focuses inference on parameters defined through a loss function.
sentences.zh: 此外，MGP 使推断聚焦于通过损失函数定义的参数。

sentences.en: This framework is especially resonant in the era of foundation transformers; practitioners increasingly leverage models like TabPFN for their state-of-the-art capabilities, yet often require epistemic uncertainty for a scientific estimand $\theta$ that need not parameterise the implicit latent model.
sentences.zh: 这一框架在基础 Transformer 时代尤其引人共鸣；从业者越来越多地利用像 TabPFN 这样的模型来获取其最先进的能力，却往往需要对科学估计量 $\theta$ 的认知不确定性，而该估计量无需参数化隐式潜在模型。

sentences.en: The MGP provides a mechanism to recover these posterior distributions.
sentences.zh: MGP 提供了一种恢复这些后验分布的机制。

sentences.en: We introduce TabMGP, an MGP built on TabPFN for tabular data.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 TabMGP，一个为表格数据构建在 TabPFN 之上的 MGP。

sentences.en: TabMGP produces credible sets with near-nominal coverage and often outperforms both handcrafted MGP constructions and standard Bayesian baselines.
sentences.zh: TabMGP 生成的置信集具有接近标称的覆盖率，并且通常优于手工构建的 MGP 构造和标准贝叶斯基线。

title_en: TabPack: Efficient Hyperparameter Ensembles for Tabular Deep Learning
title_zh: TabPack：面向表格深度学习的高效超参集成

sentences.en: Deep learning models for supervised learning on tabular data are rapidly improving.
sentences.zh: 用于表格数据监督学习的深度学习模型正在快速改进。

sentences.en: Notably, ensembles (mixtures of multiple models) often play an important role in achieving top performance, which motivates designing _ensemble-first_ systems rather than treating ensembling as an ad hoc trick.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，集成（多个模型的混合）在取得顶尖性能方面往往发挥重要作用，这促使人们设计_集成优先_的系统，而不是把集成当作临时技巧。

sentences.en: In this work, we present TabPack — a new ensembling approach that packs many base model–optimizer pairs with different hyperparameters into a single neural network and a single optimizer.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们介绍 TabPack——一种新的集成方法，它将许多具有不同超参数的基础模型-优化器配对打包进一个单一的神经网络和一个单一优化器中。

sentences.en: The base model and optimizer hyperparameters are sampled randomly, after which all base models are trained in parallel, and the final ensemble is built on the fly during training.
sentences.zh: 基础模型和优化器的超参数被随机采样，随后所有基础模型并行训练，最终集成在训练过程中即时构建。

sentences.en: As a result, TabPack produces powerful ensembles in a single run, with substantial efficiency gains over traditional approaches.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，TabPack 在单次运行中就能产生强大的集成，相比传统方法具有可观的效率提升。

sentences.en: With its remarkable efficiency, strong performance on medium-to-large datasets, and reduced reliance on traditional hyperparameter tuning, TabPack is an appealing solution for practitioners and researchers that makes tabular DL more accessible on consumer-grade hardware and suggests a new avenue for designing better tabular deep learning systems.
sentences.zh: 凭借其卓越的效率、在中小型到大型数据集上的强劲表现，以及对传统超参数调优依赖的降低，TabPack 对从业者和研究者而言都是一个颇具吸引力的解决方案，它使表格深度学习在消费级硬件上更易用，并为设计更好的表格深度学习系统开辟了新途径。

title_en: TabularBERT: Binning-Based Self-Supervised Learning for Tabular Representation
title_zh: TabularBERT：基于分箱的自监督表格表示学习

sentences.en: Tabular data is one of the most fundamental and widely used formats for representing structured information.
sentences.zh: 表格数据是表示结构化信息最基本、最广泛使用的格式之一。

sentences.en: Classical machine learning algorithms continue to achieve substantial success in extracting predictive patterns and constructing accurate models from structured data; however, representation learning approaches that extend language-model-based methods to the tabular setting have opened new opportunities.
sentences.zh: 经典机器学习算法在从结构化数据中提取预测模式和构建准确模型方面持续取得巨大成功；然而，将基于语言模型的方法扩展到表格领域的表示学习方法，已经开辟了新的机遇。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, conventional tokenization procedures and token embedding mechanisms are not well-suited to numerical variables, as they fail to preserve key numerical properties, including proximity structure and ordinal relationships.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，传统的分词流程和词元嵌入机制并不适合数值变量，因为它们无法保留关键的数值属性，包括邻近结构和序数关系。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose TabularBERT, a Transformer-based model that discretizes numerical variables via binning-based tokenization and learns representations that account for numerical proximity and ordinal information while capturing conditional dependencies among variables through masked self-supervised pretraining.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出了 TabularBERT，一种基于 Transformer 的模型，它通过基于分箱的分词对数值变量进行离散化，并在捕获变量间条件依赖的同时，通过掩码自监督预训练学习考虑数值邻近性和序数信息的表示。

sentences.en: We empirically demonstrate the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed approach, highlighting the benefits of language-model-based representation learning in the tabular domain.
sentences.zh: 我们实证展示了所提方法的有效性和可解释性，凸显了基于语言模型的表示学习在表格领域中的优势。

title_en: TABX: A High-Throughput Sandbox Battle Simulator for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: TABX：用于多智能体强化学习的高吞吐沙盒对战模拟器

sentences.en: The design of environments plays a critical role in shaping the development and evaluation of cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithms.
sentences.zh: 环境的设计在塑造协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法的发展与评估方面发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: While existing benchmarks highlight critical challenges, they often lack the modularity required to design custom evaluation scenarios.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有基准凸显了关键挑战，但它们往往缺乏设计自定义评估场景所需的模块化。

sentences.en: We introduce the Totally Accelerated Battle Simulator in JAX (TABX), a high-throughput sandbox designed for reconfigurable multi-agent tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们介绍了 JAX 中的全加速对战模拟器（TABX），一个为可重构多智能体任务而设计的高吞吐量沙盒。

sentences.en: TABX provides granular control over environmental parameters, permitting a systematic investigation into emergent agent behaviors and algorithmic trade-offs across a diverse spectrum of task complexities.
sentences.zh: TABX 提供对环境参数的细粒度控制，允许在一系列多样化的任务复杂度中对涌现的智能体行为和算法权衡进行系统研究。

sentences.en: Leveraging JAX for hardware-accelerated execution on GPUs, TABX enables massive parallelization and significantly reduces computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 凭借利用 JAX 在 GPU 上实现硬件加速执行，TABX 支持大规模并行化，并显著降低计算开销。

sentences.en: By providing a fast, extensible, and easily customized framework, TABX facilitates the study of MARL agents in complex structured domains and serves as a scalable foundation for future research.
sentences.zh: 通过提供一个快速、可扩展且易于定制的框架，TABX 促进了对复杂结构化领域中 MARL 智能体的研究，并作为未来研究的可扩展基础。

sentences.en: Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TABX-00CA.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TABX-00CA 获取。

title_en: Tackling Fake Forgetting through Uncertainty Quantification
title_zh: 通过不确定性量化应对虚假遗忘

sentences.en: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of specified data from a trained model.
sentences.zh: 机器遗忘旨在从已训练模型中移除指定数据的影响。

sentences.en: While the unlearning accuracy provides a widely used metric for assessing unlearning performance, it falls short in assessing the reliability of forgetting.
sentences.zh: 虽然遗忘准确率提供了广泛使用的遗忘性能评估指标，但在评估遗忘的可靠性方面仍有所不足。

sentences.en: In this paper, we find that the forgetting data points misclassified by unlearning accuracy still have their ground truth labels included in the conformal prediction set from the uncertainty quantification perspective, leading to a phenomenon we term fake forgetting.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们发现被遗忘准确率误分类的遗忘数据点，其真实标签仍会从不确定性量化的角度被包含在共形预测集中，从而导致我们称之为虚假遗忘的现象。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose a novel metric CR, inspired by conformal prediction, that offers a more reliable assessment of forgetting quality.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们受共形预测启发，提出了一种新指标 CR，为遗忘质量提供更可靠的评估。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we further propose an unlearning framework CPU that incorporates conformal prediction into the Carlini & Wagner adversarial attack loss, enabling the ground truth label to be effectively removed from the conformal prediction set.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们进一步提出了一种遗忘框架 CPU，它将共形预测融入 Carlini & Wagner 对抗攻击损失，从而能够有效地将真实标签从共形预测集中移除。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments on image classification tasks, we demonstrate both the effectiveness of our proposed metric and the superior forgetting quality achieved by our framework.
sentences.zh: 通过在图像分类任务上的大量实验，我们证明了所提指标的有效性，以及我们的框架所实现的卓越遗忘质量。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/TIML-Group/Conformal-Prediction-Unlearning.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/TIML-Group/Conformal-Prediction-Unlearning 获取。

title_en: Tackling Length Inflation Without Trade-offs: Group Relative Reward Rescaling for Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 无权衡地应对长度膨胀：用于强化学习的组相对奖励重新缩放

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning significantly enhances LLM capabilities but suffers from a critical issue: length inflation, where models adopt verbosity or inefficient reasoning to maximize rewards.
sentences.zh: 强化学习显著增强了 LLM 的能力，但饱受一个关键问题的困扰：长度膨胀，即模型采用冗长或低效的推理来最大化奖励。

sentences.en: Prior approaches struggle to address this challenge in a general and lossless manner, primarily because additive penalties introduce a compensatory effect that creates optimization shortcuts, while heuristic gating strategies lack generality beyond binary feedback.
sentences.zh: 先前的方法在以一种通用且无损失的方式应对这一挑战方面存在困难，主要是因为加性惩罚会引入补偿效应，造成优化捷径，而启发式门控策略在二元反馈之外缺乏通用性。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we present Group Relative Reward Rescaling (GR$^3$), which reframes length control as a multiplicative rescaling paradigm, effectively establishing a generalized, continuous, and reward-dependent gating mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了组相对奖励重新缩放（GR$^3$），它将长度控制重新表述为一种乘法重新缩放范式，有效建立起一种通用、连续且依赖于奖励的门控机制。

sentences.en: To further ensure lossless optimization, we incorporate group-relative regularization and advantage-aware calibration, which dynamically adapt length budgets to instance difficulty and preserve the advantage signal of high-quality trajectories.
sentences.zh: 为进一步确保无损失的优化，我们引入了组相对正则化和优势感知校准，它们动态调整长度预算以适应实例难度，并保留高质量轨迹的优势信号。

sentences.en: Empirically, across both RLHF and RLVR settings, GR$^3$ maintains training dynamics and downstream performance comparable to standard GRPO while significantly mitigating length inflation, outperforming state-of-the-art length-regularized baselines.
sentences.zh: 实证上，在 RLHF 和 RLVR 两种设定下，GR$^3$ 都保持了与标准 GRPO 相当的训练动态和下游性能，同时显著缓解长度膨胀，优于最先进的长度正则化基线。

title_en: TACTIC: Task-Aware Sparse Coordination Graphs for Multi-Task Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: TACTIC：多任务多智能体强化学习的任务感知稀疏协调图

sentences.en: Value factorization eases non-stationarity in MARL, but its static coordination assumptions hinder generalization on long-horizon tasks with shifting dependencies.
sentences.zh: 价值分解缓解了 MARL 中的非平稳性，但其静态的协调假设阻碍了在依赖关系不断变化的长视界任务上的泛化。

sentences.en: Prior VQ-VAE methods abstract trajectories yet miss time-varying inter-agent dependencies.
sentences.zh: 先前的 VQ-VAE 方法抽象了轨迹，却忽视了随时间变化的智能体间依赖。

sentences.en: We present TACTIC, a CTDE framework with three components: (i) VQ-VAE-based trajectory abstraction that learns discrete task-semantic classes; (ii) semantic-conditioned sparse coordination graphs that adapt dependencies by pruning edges according to variance-based pairwise payoff sensitivity; and (iii) a pretrained, frozen trajectory-class predictor that conditions local policies while decoupling task recognition from control.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 TACTIC，一个包含三个组件的 CTDE 框架：（i）基于 VQ-VAE 的轨迹抽象，学习离散的任务语义类别；（ii）语义条件化的稀疏协调图，根据基于方差的成对收益敏感性剪枝边来适配依赖关系；以及（iii）一个预训练且冻结的轨迹类别预测器，在将任务识别与控制解耦的同时，对局部策略施加条件。

sentences.en: On SMAC and SUMO, TACTIC shows strong overall competitiveness and adaptive coordination under sparse rewards and dynamic task structures.
sentences.zh: 在 SMAC 和 SUMO 上，TACTIC 在稀疏奖励和动态任务结构下展现出强大的总体竞争力和自适应的协调能力。

title_en: TadA-Bench: A Million-Variant Benchmark for Future-Round Discovery Toward Agentic Protein Engineering
title_zh: TadA-Bench：面向智能体蛋白质工程的未来轮次发现的百万变体基准

sentences.en: AI for scientific discovery is entering an agentic era, where protein-engineering systems are expected to prioritize future wet-lab experiments rather than merely fit static measurements.
sentences.zh: 面向科学发现的人工智能正步入智能体时代，在此背景下，蛋白质工程系统被期望优先规划未来的湿实验，而不仅仅是拟合静态测量数据。

sentences.en: We introduce TadA-Bench, a million-variant wet-lab replay benchmark from 31 TadA directed-evolution rounds for future-round discovery toward agentic protein engineering.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 TadA-Bench，一个来自 31 轮 TadA 定向进化、包含百万变体的湿实验回放基准，用于面向智能体蛋白质工程的未来轮次发现。

sentences.en: TadA-Bench preserves the campaign chronology and defines a fixed-data replay task: given earlier experimental rounds, models rank variants that appear only in later rounds.
sentences.zh: TadA-Bench 保留了活动的编年顺序，并定义了一个固定数据回放任务：给定更早期的实验轮次，模型对仅出现在更晚轮次中的变体进行排序。

sentences.en: It provides aligned DNA, RNA, and protein views, and uses Seq2Graph, a graph-based label-unification pipeline, to reconcile noisy enrichment measurements into consistent cross-round activity labels.
sentences.zh: 它提供对齐的 DNA、RNA 和蛋白视图，并使用 Seq2Graph（一种基于图的标签统一流水线）将带噪的富集测量数据协调为跨轮次一致的活动标签。

sentences.en: Random-split controls show strong interpolation, but future-round ranking and finite-budget candidate selection are much weaker.
sentences.zh: 随机划分的对照显示强插值能力，但未来轮次的排序和有限预算的候选选择则要弱得多。

sentences.en: Controlled analyses suggest that evolutionary coverage is more informative than local data density, positioning TadA-Bench as a reproducible wet-lab replay substrate for future-round discovery toward agentic protein engineering; the data and code are released on Hugging Face and GitHub.
sentences.zh: 对照分析表明，进化覆盖度比局部数据密度更具信息量，这使得 TadA-Bench 成为面向智能体蛋白质工程未来轮次发现的可复现湿实验回放基质；数据和代码已在 Hugging Face 和 GitHub 上发布。

title_en: TAG: Tangential Amplifying Guidance for Hallucination-Resistant Sampling
title_zh: TAG：用于抗幻觉采样的切向放大引导

sentences.en: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art image generation but often produce semantic inconsistencies, or *hallucinations*.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型实现了最先进的图像生成，但常常产生语义不一致，即*幻觉*。

sentences.en: Existing inference-time guidance methods rely on external signals or architectural modifications, adding computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 现有的推断时引导方法依赖外部信号或架构修改，增加了计算开销。

sentences.en: We propose **T**angential **A**mplifying **G**uidance **(TAG)**, a training-free, architecture-agnostic, plug-and-play guidance method that operates purely on trajectory signals.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 **切向放大引导（TAG）**，一种免训练、与架构无关、即插即用的引导方法，它完全基于轨迹信号运作。

sentences.en: TAG uses an intermediate sample as a projection basis and amplifies the tangential components of the estimated score to correct the sampling trajectory.
sentences.zh: TAG 将中间样本用作投影基，并放大估计分数的切向分量，以纠正采样轨迹。

sentences.en: A first-order Taylor analysis shows that this steers the state toward higher-probability regions of the data manifold, reducing inconsistencies and improving fidelity while adding negligible overhead to existing samplers.
sentences.zh: 一阶 Taylor 分析表明，这会将状态引导到数据流形中概率更高的区域，从而减少不一致并提升保真度，同时对现有采样器仅增加可忽略不计的开销。

sentences.en: Code is available at our Project Page (https://hyeon-cho.github.io/TAG/).
sentences.zh: 代码可在我们的项目页面（https://hyeon-cho.github.io/TAG/）获取。

title_en: TAGRPO: Boosting GRPO on Image-to-Video Generation with Direct Trajectory Alignment
title_zh: TAGRPO：通过直接轨迹对齐提升图像到视频生成的 GRPO

sentences.en: Recent studies have demonstrated the efficacy of integrating Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) into flow matching models, particularly for text-to-image and text-to-video generation.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，将组相对策略优化（GRPO）集成到流匹配模型中卓有成效，尤其是在文本到图像和文本到视频生成方面。

sentences.en: However, we find that directly applying these techniques to image-to-video (I2V) models often fails to yield consistent reward improvements.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们发现将这些技术直接应用于图像到视频（I2V）模型，往往无法产生一致的奖励提升。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we present TAGRPO, a robust post-training framework for I2V models inspired by contrastive learning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出了 TAGRPO，一个受对比学习启发的稳健 I2V 模型后训练框架。

sentences.en: Our approach is grounded in the observation that rollout videos generated from identical initial noise provide superior guidance for optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法基于这样的观察：从相同初始噪声生成的 rollout 视频为优化提供了更优的指导。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we propose a novel GRPO loss applied to intermediate latents, encouraging direct alignment with high-reward trajectories while maximizing distance from low-reward counterparts.
sentences.zh: 借助这一洞见，我们提出了一种应用于中间潜在表示的 GRPO 损失，鼓励与高奖励轨迹直接对齐，同时最大化与低奖励对应轨迹的距离。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a memory bank for rollout videos to enhance diversity and reduce computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们为 rollout 视频引入了一个记忆库，以增强多样性并降低计算开销。

sentences.en: Despite its simplicity, TAGRPO achieves significant improvements over DanceGRPO in I2V generation.
sentences.zh: 尽管方法简单，TAGRPO 在 I2V 生成上相较于 DanceGRPO 取得了显著改进。

title_en: Tail Annealing for Heavy-Tailed Flow Matching
title_zh: 重尾流匹配的尾部退火

sentences.en: Standard generative models struggle with heavy-tailed data: Lipschitz architectures cannot produce power-law tails from Gaussian noise, and interpolating between heavy-tailed data and Gaussians is ill-posed.
sentences.zh: 标准生成模型难以处理重尾数据：Lipschitz 架构无法从高斯噪声产生幂律尾部，而在重尾数据与高斯分布之间插值也是不适定的。

sentences.en: We propose a simple fix: apply the soft-log transform $\phi(x) = \mathrm{sign}(x)
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个简单的修复方案：在训练前逐坐标地对数据应用软对数变换 $\phi(x) = \mathrm{sign}(x)

sentences.en: \cdot \log(1 + |x|)$ coordinate-wise to data before training, then exponentiate samples after generation.
sentences.zh: \cdot \log(1 + |x|)$ 逐坐标地应用，然后在生成后对样本取指数。

sentences.en: A Hill diagnostic decides per-coordinate whether to transform, leaving light-tailed margins untouched at no added complexity.
sentences.zh: Hill 诊断会逐坐标决定是否进行变换，在不增加复杂度的前提下保留轻尾边缘不变。

sentences.en: This compresses heavy tails into a range where standard flow matching succeeds, without heavy-tailed base distributions or architectural modifications.
sentences.zh: 这将重尾压缩到一个标准流匹配能够成功的范围内，而无需重尾基分布或架构修改。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical intuition for why this works: the log-transform maps Pareto tails to exponentials, and the induced dynamics implement a form of tail annealing via power transformations.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了这一做法为何有效的理论直觉：对数变换将 Pareto 尾部映射为指数分布，而由此诱导的动力学通过幂变换实现了一种尾部退火的形式。

sentences.en: On a 144-configuration multivariate benchmark (3 copulas, $d$ up to 100, 4 tail indices), Log-FM dominates specialized baselines on $W_1$, CVaR$_{99}$, and extreme-quantile metrics, and is the only method with zero severe divergences across 2{,}880 runs.
sentences.zh: 在一个包含 144 种配置的多元基准（3 种 copula、$d$ 最高达 100、4 个尾部指数）上，Log-FM 在 $W_1$、CVaR$_{99}$ 和极值分位数指标上优于专门的基线，并且是在 2,880 次运行中唯一一个没有严重发散的方法。

title_en: Tailoring Strictly Proper Scoring Rules for Downstream Tasks: An Application to Causal Inference
title_zh: 为下游任务定制严格合适的评分规则：因果推断中的应用

sentences.en: Probabilistic models are typically trained using task-agnostic objectives like log-loss, which can lead to significant errors in downstream estimation.
sentences.zh: 概率模型通常使用与任务无关的目标（如对数损失）进行训练，这可能导致下游估计中的显著误差。

sentences.en: This disconnect is especially critical in Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) for causal inference, where propensity score errors near $0$ and $1$ often lead to high bias and variance.
sentences.zh: 这种脱节在用于因果推断的逆概率加权（IPW）中尤为关键，因为在 0 和 1 附近的倾向得分误差常常导致高偏差和高方差。

sentences.en: We propose a principled framework for deriving task-specific strictly proper scoring rules by matching the local curvature of the downstream error metric.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个原理性框架，通过匹配下游误差度量的局部曲率来推导任务特异的严格合适评分规则。

sentences.en: We apply this to the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) estimation, deriving a closed-form loss and its corresponding canonical probability mapping that can be readily integrated with any model like a neural network or a gradient boosting algorithm.
sentences.zh: 我们将其应用于平均处理效应（ATE）估计，推导出一个闭式损失及其相应的标准概率映射，可以轻松地与任何模型（如神经网络或梯度提升算法）集成。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on causal inference benchmarks demonstrate that our tailored objective consistently outperforms standard likelihood-based and covariate-balancing approaches.
sentences.zh: 对因果推断基准的大量评估表明，我们定制的目标始终优于标准的基于似然的方法和协变量平衡方法。

title_en: Tailoring the Training: Difficulty-Aware Learning Strategy Allocation for Large Language Models
title_zh: 定制训练：面向大型语言模型的难度感知学习策略分配

sentences.en: Although reinforcement learning (RL) enhances the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), it is primarily learned from the model's self-generated distribution, limiting its ability to acquire reasoning skills beyond its initial knowledge.
sentences.zh: 尽管强化学习（RL）增强了大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但它主要从模型自身生成的分布中学习，这限制了其在初始知识之外获取推理技能的能力。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we propose a Difficulty-Aware Learning Strategy Allocation (DALSA) framework, which adaptively assigns appropriate learning strategies to samples based on their difficulty signals.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一问题，我们提出了难度感知学习策略分配（DALSA）框架，它根据样本的难度信号自适应地为其分配合适的学习策略。

sentences.en: DALSA is built on the key insight that samples beyond models' knowledge scope are better addressed through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while those within the boundary but insufficiently mastered benefit more from RL, and well-learned samples are discarded to avoid redundant updates.
sentences.zh: DALSA 建立在这样一个关键洞见之上：超出模型知识范围的样本更适合通过监督微调（SFT）来处理，而在边界之内但掌握不充分的样本则从 RL 中获益更多，已充分学习的样本则被丢弃以避免冗余更新。

sentences.en: To realize this principle, we extract a series of difficulty-aware training characteristics and employ a learnable strategy allocator to dynamically determine the optimal learning strategy for each sample based on its training dynamics.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一原则，我们提取一系列难度感知的训练特征，并采用一个可学习的策略分配器，根据每个样本的训练动态动态确定其最优学习策略。

sentences.en: The allocator and the LLM are alternately optimized, enabling adaptive strategy allocation.
sentences.zh: 分配器与 LLM 交替优化，从而实现自适应的策略分配。

sentences.en: Furthermore, two regularization techniques, anti-curriculum weighting and adversarial label smoothing, are integrated to alleviate the inherent limitations of RL and SFT, backed by comprehensive theoretical analyses.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们集成了两种正则化技术，反向课程加权和对抗性标签平滑，以缓解 RL 和 SFT 固有的局限，并有全面的理论分析作为支撑。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on ten LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 70B across various tasks indicate that DALSA consistently outperforms baselines under both full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning settings.
sentences.zh: 在从 1.5B 到 70B 的十个 LLM 和各类任务上的大量实验表明，在全量微调和参数高效微调两种设定下，DALSA 均持续优于基线。

title_en: Taking the GP Out of the Loop
title_zh: 让高斯过程退出循环

sentences.en: Bayesian optimization (BO) has traditionally solved black-box problems where function evaluation is expensive and, therefore, observations are few.
sentences.zh: 贝叶斯优化（BO）传统上用于解决函数评估昂贵、因而观测较少的黑盒问题。

sentences.en: Recently, however, there has been growing interest in applying BO to problems where function evaluation is cheaper and observations are more plentiful.
sentences.zh: 然而，近来人们日益关注将 BO 应用于函数评估更廉价、观测更充分的问题。

sentences.en: In this regime, scaling to many observations $N$ is impeded by Gaussian-process (GP) surrogates: GP hyperparameter fitting scales as $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ (reduced to roughly $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in modern implementations), and it is repeated at every BO iteration.
sentences.zh: 在这一模式下，扩展到大量观测 $N$ 会受到高斯过程（GP）代理的阻碍：GP 超参数拟合的计算复杂度为 $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$（在现代实现中约降至 $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$），并且在每次 BO 迭代中都会重复进行。

sentences.en: Many methods improve scaling at acquisition time, but hyperparameter fitting still scales poorly, making it the bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 许多方法在获取阶段改善了扩展性，但超参数拟合的扩展性仍然不佳，使其成为瓶颈。

sentences.en: We propose Epistemic Nearest Neighbors (ENN), a lightweight alternative to GPs that estimates function values and uncertainty (epistemic and aleatoric) from $K$-nearest-neighbor observations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了认知最近邻（ENN），一种 GP 的轻量级替代方案，它从 $K$ 近邻观测中估计函数值和不确定性（认知性和偶然性）。

sentences.en: ENN scales as $\mathcal{O}(N)$ for both fitting and acquisition.
sentences.zh: ENN 在拟合和获取两方面的扩展性都为 $\mathcal{O}(N)$。

sentences.en: Our BO method, TuRBO-ENN, replaces the GP surrogate in TuRBO with ENN and its Thompson-sampling acquisition with $\mathrm{UCB} = \mu(x) + \sigma(x)$.
sentences.zh: 我们的 BO 方法 TuRBO-ENN，用 ENN 替换 TuRBO 中的 GP 代理，并用 $\mathrm{UCB} = \mu(x) + \sigma(x)$ 替换其汤普森采样获取。

sentences.en: For the special case of noise-free problems, we can omit fitting altogether by replacing $\mathrm{UCB}$ with a non-dominated sort over $\mu(x)$ and $\sigma(x)$.
sentences.zh: 对于无噪声问题的特例，我们可以完全省略拟合，方法是把 $\mathrm{UCB}$ 换成对 $\mu(x)$ 和 $\sigma(x)$ 的非支配排序。

sentences.en: We show empirically that TuRBO-ENN reduces proposal time (i.e., fitting time + acquisition time) by one to two orders of magnitude compared to TuRBO at up to 50,000 observations without sacrificing solution quality.
sentences.zh: 我们实证表明，在多达 50,000 个观测的情况下，与 TuRBO 相比，TuRBO-ENN 将提议时间（即拟合时间加获取时间）降低了一到两个数量级，同时不牺牲解的质量。

title_en: Talk, Judge, Cooperate: Gossip-Driven Indirect Reciprocity in Self-Interested LLM Agents
title_zh: 谈论、评判、合作：自利 LLM 智能体中的语言驱动间接互惠

sentences.en: Indirect reciprocity, which means helping those who have helped others, is difficult to sustain among decentralized, self-interested LLM agents without reliable reputation systems.
sentences.zh: 间接互惠，即帮助那些帮助过他人的人，在没有可靠声誉系统的去中心化、自利 LLM 智能体之间难以维系。

sentences.en: We address this challenge with the Agentic LInguistic Gossip Network (ALIGN), an automated framework that enables decentralized agents to form reputations, evaluate trustworthiness, and coordinate social norms by strategically sharing open-ended gossip with hierarchical tones.
sentences.zh: 我们借助智能体语言八卦网络（ALIGN）来应对这一挑战，这是一个自动化框架，使去中心化的智能体能够通过策略性地分享具有层级语气的开放式八卦，来形成声誉、评估可信度并协调社会规范。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that ALIGN consistently improves indirect reciprocity and resists malicious entrants by identifying and ostracizing defectors.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，ALIGN 能够持续改善间接互惠，并通过识别和驱逐背离者来抵御恶意进入者。

sentences.en: Notably, we find that stronger reasoning capabilities in LLMs lead to more incentive-aligned cooperation, whereas chat models often over-cooperate even when strategically suboptimal.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们发现 LLM 更强的推理能力会带来更符合激励的合作，而聊天模型往往即使在策略上并非最优时也会过度合作。

sentences.en: These results suggest that leveraging LLM reasoning through decentralized gossip is a promising path for maintaining social welfare in agentic ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，通过去中心化八卦来利用 LLM 推理，是维持智能体生态系统社会福祉的一条有前景的路径。

sentences.en: Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/shuhui-zhu/ALIGN}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 \url{https://github.com/shuhui-zhu/ALIGN}\ 获取。

title_en: Taming Aleatoric Impulse in Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 驯服离策略强化学习中的偶然性冲动

sentences.en: Off-policy reinforcement learning is vulnerable to overestimation bias, which is rooted in the total value uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 离策略强化学习容易受到高估偏误的影响，其根源在于总价值不确定性。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically misaddress this by targeting the epistemic component, neglecting the aleatoric component.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常错误地将此归因于认知分量并加以处理，而忽视了偶然分量。

sentences.en: We identify for the first time that this oversight fails to contain a massive bias surge, termed **Aleatoric Impulse**.
sentences.zh: 我们首次识别出，这种疏忽无法遏制一次巨大的偏差激增，我们称之为**偶然性冲动**。

sentences.en: Although transient, this impulse fundamentally derails the learning trajectory, permanently locking the agent into suboptimal policies.
sentences.zh: 尽管这种冲动是短暂的，它却从根本上破坏学习轨迹，将智能体永久锁定在次优策略上。

sentences.en: To counteract this, we propose **A**leatoric **I**mpulse **D**amping **(AID)**, the first mechanism that models total value uncertainty by disentangling the return variance into epistemic and aleatoric components, followed by their adaptive weighted recombination.
sentences.zh: 为了对此加以反制，我们提出了**偶然性冲动阻尼（AID）**，这是第一个通过将回报方差解耦为认知分量和偶然分量，随后对它们进行自适应加权重组，从而对总价值不确定性建模的机制。

sentences.en: Leveraging this derived uncertainty, the critic constructs a pessimistic lower confidence bound to surgically suppress the impulse.
sentences.zh: 借助所推导的不确定性，评论家构造一个悲观的下置信界，以精准抑制这种冲动。

sentences.en: Complementing this, the actor utilizes a symmetrical upper confidence bound to drive optimistic exploration, ensuring that the necessary pessimism does not compromise exploration efficiency.
sentences.zh: 作为补充，行动者利用一个对称的上置信界驱动乐观探索，确保必要的悲观不会损害探索效率。

sentences.en: We integrate this mechanism into the Distributional Soft Actor-Critic algorithm to establish **DSAC-AID**.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一机制整合进分布软行动者-评论家算法，从而构建了 **DSAC-AID**。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the high-dimensional Gym-MuJoCo and DeepMind Control Suite benchmarks demonstrate that it achieves state-of-the-art results in final performance.
sentences.zh: 在高维 Gym-MuJoCo 和 DeepMind Control Suite 基准上的大量实验表明，它在最终性能方面取得了最先进的结果。

title_en: Taming I2V models for Image HOI Editing:  A Cognitive Benchmark and Agentic Self-Correcting Framework
title_zh: 驯服 I2V 模型用于图像人类-物体交互编辑：认知基准与智能体自纠正框架

sentences.en: Current image editing methods excels at static attributes but fails at complex Human-Object Interactions (HOI), a critical challenge unaddressed by existing benchmarks that conflate HOI with static attributes, relying on global metrics incapable of simultaneously assessing dynamic interaction validity and entangled human-object pair preservation.
sentences.zh: 当前图像编辑方法擅长处理静态属性，却在复杂的人类-物体交互（HOI）上力不从心，而现有基准未解决这一关键挑战——它们将 HOI 与静态属性混为一谈，依赖无法同时评估动态交互有效性和纠缠的人类-物体对保持的全局指标。

sentences.en: Thus, we first introduce HOI-Edit, a comprehensive benchmark with three progressive cognitive levels, which features an automated metric HOI-Eval that first reliably evaluates instance-level interaction by letting VLM Q&A after thinking with images containing grounded Human-Object pair.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们首先引入 HOI-Edit，一个具有三个递进认知层级的综合基准，它配有一个自动化指标 HOI-Eval，该指标在包含被锚定的人类-物体对的图像上，先让 VLM 在思考后进行问答，从而首个可靠地评估实例级交互。

sentences.en: Considering the task's essence of remodeling dynamic relationships, we benchmark Image-to-Video (I2V) models, finding them inherently suited for dynamic editing due to their temporal generation capabilities.
sentences.zh: 考虑到该任务重塑动态关系的本质，我们对图像到视频（I2V）模型进行了基准测试，发现由于其时间生成能力，它们天然适合动态编辑。

sentences.en: Crucially, beyond superior performance, this capability provides a "replay of the failure process", offering unique diagnosability into why errors occur.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，除更优的性能外，这一能力还提供了“失败过程的重放”，为理解错误产生的成因带来了独特的可诊断性。

sentences.en: We thus propose SCPE (Self-Correcting Process Editing), a novel, agentic self-correcting framework that constrains the generation of I2V models through iteratively refined prompts, enabling the generated videos to more accurately present the target HOI.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了 SCPE（自纠错过程编辑），一种新颖的智能体自纠错框架，它通过迭代精化的提示约束 I2V 模型的生成，使生成的视频更准确地呈现目标 HOI。

sentences.en: Extracted frames from these videos are the final editing results.
sentences.zh: 从这些视频中提取的帧即为最终的编辑结果。

sentences.en: On HOI-Edit, SCPE achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art (SOTA) editing models like Nano Banana on interaction.
sentences.zh: 在 HOI-Edit 上，SCPE 在交互方面取得了与 Nano Banana 等最先进（SOTA）编辑模型相当的性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/HOI-Edit.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/HOI-Edit 获取。

title_en: Taming Stochastic Gradient Descent: Almost Sure Convergence and Saddle-Point Avoidance under $(L_{0},L_{1})$-Smoothness
title_zh: 驯服随机梯度下降：$(L_{0},L_{1})$-光滑性下的几乎必然收敛与鞍点回避

sentences.en: Many optimization problems in machine learning and data science—from deep neural networks to Bayesian inference and beyond—fall outside the standard Lipschitz smoothness framework that underpins  the convergence theory of stochastic gradient descent (SGD).
sentences.zh: 机器学习和数据科学中的许多优化问题——从深度神经网络到贝叶斯推断等——都超出了支撑随机梯度下降（SGD）收敛理论的标准 Lipschitz 光滑性框架。

sentences.en: Motivated by this theory-practice disconnect, we examine the almost sure convergence of the trajectories of SGD in non-convex landscapes under a generalized $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness condition which allows for gradients with superlinear growth (even exponential).
sentences.zh: 受这种理论与实践的脱节所驱动，我们考察了在广义 $(L_0,L_1)$-光滑性条件下，非凸地形中 SGD 轨迹的几乎必然收敛，该条件允许梯度具有超线性增长（甚至指数增长）。

sentences.en: We begin by proposing a taming scheme for SGD that achieves almost sure convergence under a generalized ABC-type condition on the gradient noise.
sentences.zh: 我们首先提出一种 SGD 的驯服方案，在关于梯度噪声的广义 ABC 型条件下实现几乎必然收敛。

sentences.en: Subsequently, to relax this requirement, we introduce a more flexible, dissipative taming scheme which converges almost surely under less restrictive moment bound conditions for the stochastic gradients entering the process.
sentences.zh: 随后，为放宽这一要求，我们引入一种更灵活、耗散的驯服方案，在对进入过程的随机梯度具有较弱的矩有界条件时几乎必然收敛。

sentences.en: For both taming schemes, we show that the generated trajectories avoid strict saddle points (and/or manifolds thereof) with probability 1 so, generically, both methods only converge to local minimizers.
sentences.zh: 对于这两种驯服方案，我们都表明所生成的轨迹以概率 1 避开严格鞍点（和/或它们的流形），因此一般情况下，两种方法只会收敛到局部极小值点。

title_en: Taming the Loss Landscape of PINNs with Noisy Feynman–Kac Supervision: Operator Preconditioning and Non-Asymptotic Error Bounds
title_zh: 用含噪声的 Feynman-Kac 监督驯服 PINN 的损失地形：算子预处理与非渐近误差界

sentences.en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) often train slowly or fail to converge on challenging partial differential equations (PDEs), a behavior recently linked to severely ill-conditioned loss landscapes inherited from the underlying differential operator.
sentences.zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）在面对具有挑战性的偏微分方程（PDE）时往往训练缓慢或无法收敛，这种行为近期被归因于继承自底层微分算子的严重病态损失地形。

sentences.en: We study PINNs augmented with a pointwise data-fidelity term, added at a few points in the domain to the standard residual and boundary losses.
sentences.zh: 我们研究向 PINN 增加逐点数据保真项，在域内少数点处将该项添加到标准残差损失和边界损失之上。

sentences.en: We show that this supervision term acts as an operator-level preconditioner: for suitable weights, our comparison bounds guarantee a substantially smaller condition number than under the standard PINN loss, independently of how the pointwise labels are obtained.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这一监督项起到算子级预处理器的作用：在合适的权重下，我们的比较界保证条件数显著小于标准 PINN 损失下的条件数，且与逐点标签的获取方式无关。

sentences.en: For a broad class of PDEs admitting a Feynman-Kac (FK) representation, we generate such labels by Monte Carlo averages of the FK functional, resulting in what we call "FK-PINNs", and using the excess risk decomposition approach, we derive non-asymptotic $L^2(\Omega)$-error bounds for FK-PINNs with $\tanh$ activation trained by finitely many steps of gradient descent.
sentences.zh: 对于一大类允许 Feynman-Kac（FK）表示的 PDE，我们通过 FK 泛函的蒙特卡洛均值生成此类标签，从而得到我们所说的 FK-PINN，并利用超额风险分解方法，为用 $\tanh$ 激活、经有限步梯度下降训练的 FK-PINN 推导出非渐近的 $L^2(\Omega)$-误差界。

sentences.en: Along the way, we establish pseudo-dimension bounds for first- and second-order derivatives of $\tanh$ neural networks, which are of independent interest and, to the best of our knowledge, new.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，我们为 $\tanh$ 神经网络的一阶和二阶偏导建立了伪维数界，这些结果具有独立价值，并且据我们所知是全新的。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments on Poisson, Schrödinger, mean exit time, and committor problems corroborate the theory, and show that FK-PINNs can successfully solve PDEs for which standard PINNs exhibit severe failure modes.
sentences.zh: 对 Poisson、Schrödinger、平均退出时间和 committor 问题的数值实验印证了该理论，并表明 FK-PINN 能够成功求解标准 PINN 会严重失效的 PDE。

title_en: Taming the Recent-Data Bias: Towards Robust Time Series Forecasting with Global Context
title_zh: 驯服近期数据偏差：借助全局上下文实现强健的时间序列预测

sentences.en: Time series forecasting plays a vital role in numerous domains.
sentences.zh: 时间序列预测在众多领域中发挥着重要作用。

sentences.en: However, real-world time series are frequently contaminated by noise, missing values, and anomalies, posing significant challenges to reliable forecasting.
sentences.zh: 然而，真实世界的时间序列常常受到噪声、缺失值和异常值的污染，给可靠预测带来重大挑战。

sentences.en: In this work, we first systematically investigate a fundamental limitation prevalent in existing forecasting methods: an excessive reliance on the most recent observations---termed "recent-data bias".
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们首先系统地考察现有预测方法中普遍存在的一个根本局限：对最近观测的过度依赖——即“近期数据偏差”。

sentences.en: This bias renders forecasts highly vulnerable to perturbations in recent data, severely undermining prediction reliability.
sentences.zh: 这种偏差使预测极易受到近期数据扰动的冲击，严重损害预测可靠性。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose TameR, a novel approach for robust time series forecasting that effectively mitigates recent-data bias via enhancing the utilization of global context.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 TameR，一种强健时间序列预测的新方法，通过增强全局上下文的利用来有效缓解近期数据偏差。

sentences.en: Specifically, it employs a basis-aligned randomized sampling strategy to reduce dependence on any specific recent data.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，它采用一种基于基对齐的随机采样策略，以降低对任何特定近期数据的依赖。

sentences.en: Furthermore, TameR incorporates a learnable periodicity extraction module coupled with a two-stage learning protocol to robustly separate periodic patterns from the sampled residual components.
sentences.zh: 此外，TameR 结合了一个可学习的周期性提取模块和一种两阶段学习协议，以强健地将周期模式从采样后的残差分量中分离出来。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that TameR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in robustness against diverse perturbation scenarios, while achieving comparable accuracy on clean data.
sentences.zh: 综合实验表明，TameR 在多样扰动场景下的强健性方面显著优于最先进的方法，同时在干净数据上取得相当的准确率。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/NetManAIOps/TameR.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/NetManAIOps/TameR 获取。

title_en: TAMPO: Task- and Model-Aware Automatic Prompt Optimization for Auto-Routing in LLM-based Systems
title_zh: TAMPO：面向 LLM 系统自动路由的任务与模型感知自动提示优化

sentences.en: Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt to specific tasks while minimizing manual engineering costs.
sentences.zh: 自动提示优化（APO）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够适应特定任务，同时将手工工程成本降至最低。

sentences.en: However, since existing APO approaches either rely solely on multi-round iterative procedures or use model-specific generators tailored to optimizing prompts for a single model and objective, they are not readily applicable to auto-routing scenarios, which require operating over diverse LLMs and juggling multiple, often competing, trade-offs.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于现有的 APO 方法要么只依赖多轮迭代流程，要么使用为优化单一模型和目标而定制的模型专用生成器，它们难以直接应用于自动路由场景——这类场景需要在多个不同的 LLM 上运作，并兼顾多个往往相互竞争的权衡。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose TAMPO, a novel task- and model-aware APO framework for auto-routing in LLM-based systems.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 TAMPO，一种新颖的、任务与模型感知的 APO 框架，用于 LLM 系统中的自动路由。

sentences.en: Specifically, to capture performance variation across a broad range of tasks and models, we construct a comprehensive, heterogeneity-aware dataset to train an uncertainty-aware reward model.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，为捕获跨广泛任务和模型的性能差异，我们构建了一个全面的、感知异质性的数据集，用于训练一个不确定性感知的奖励模型。

sentences.en: Serving as an offline proxy, this reward model can greatly mitigate reward hacking, allowing TAMPO to learn an optimal multi-objective conditional policy for robust prompt generation.
sentences.zh: 作为离线代理，该奖励模型能够大幅缓解奖励欺骗，从而使 TAMPO 学习到一种最优的多目标条件策略，用于稳健的提示生成。

sentences.en: Based on the user requirements encoded in our defined preference vector, this policy enables flexible control over prompt generation and supports a cost-effective deployment strategy.
sentences.zh: 基于我们定义的偏好向量中所编码的用户需求，该策略能够灵活控制提示生成，并支持一种经济高效的部署策略。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across 86 tasks demonstrate that TAMPO effectively maintains performance stability across diverse tasks and models, providing a robust, controllable solution for auto-routing in various LLM-based systems.
sentences.zh: 跨 86 个任务的大量实验表明，TAMPO 能有效维持跨任务和模型的性能稳定性，为各种 LLM 系统中的自动路由提供一种稳健、可控的解决方案。

title_en: TapSampling: Inference-Time Sampling with a Task-Progress-Understanding Verifier for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: TapSampling：面向机器人操作的带任务进展理解验证器的推断时采样

sentences.en: Existing embodied control research demonstrates remarkable performance improvements by scaling training data and model size.
sentences.zh: 现有的具身控制研究通过扩展训练数据和模型规模展现了显著的性能提升。

sentences.en: We instead explore inference-time strategy as an alternative axis.
sentences.zh: 我们转而将推断时策略探索为另一条轴。

sentences.en: Non-deterministic generative models, such as diffusion and autoregressive models, have been widely adopted in the field of embodied control.
sentences.zh: 非确定性的生成模型，例如扩散模型和自回归模型，已在具身控制领域得到广泛采用。

sentences.en: However, the single-shot inference paradigm limits their performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，单次推断范式限制了它们的性能。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose **TapSampling**, a plug-and-play framework for inference-time sampling.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 **TapSampling**，一个用于推断时采样的即插即用框架。

sentences.en: First, we introduce an Action-VAE that represents actions in a low-dimensional latent space by mapping policy-generated initial actions into a compressed posterior distribution, from which any number of latent samples can be drawn and decoded into candidate actions that approximate the true action distribution.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们引入一个 Action-VAE，它将策略生成的初始动作映射到压缩后验分布来在低维潜在空间中表示动作，从而可以从中抽取任意数量的潜在样本，并将其解码为接近真实动作分布的候选动作。

sentences.en: Second, we formulate action verification as task-progress outcome prediction, using the intrinsic sequential structure of robotic datasets to train a semantically grounded verifier for interpretable action selection.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们将动作验证表述为任务进展结果预测，利用机器人数据集固有的序列结构来训练一个具有语义基础的验证器，用于可解释的动作选择。

sentences.en: Furthermore, TapSampling is a policy-agnostic framework.
sentences.zh: 此外，TapSampling 是一个与策略无关的框架。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that our method substantially improves multiple generalist policies without further policy finetuning.
sentences.zh: 在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，我们的方法在无需进一步策略微调的情况下，显著提升了多个通用策略的性能。

sentences.en: Code and models are available at the **project page** (https://aipixel.github.io/TapSampling/).
sentences.zh: 代码和模型可在**项目页面**（https://aipixel.github.io/TapSampling/）获取。

title_en: TarGATE: Target-Aware Data Selection via Token-Attenuation Gates
title_zh: TarGATE：通过词元衰减门进行目标感知的数据选择

sentences.en: Targeted instruction tuning requires selecting pertinent samples from massive mixed *candidate datasets* guided by a small *reference dataset* reflecting the desired capability, yet efficiently identifying high-quality data amidst noise remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 定向的指令微调要求在规模庞大的混合*候选数据集*中，借助一个反映所期望能力的小型*参考数据集*来选择相关样本，然而在噪声中高效识别高质量数据仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **TarGATE**
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 **TarGATE**。

sentences.en: (**Tar**get-aware **GATE**s, a simple yet effective data selection framework that leverages the model's inherent data understanding.
sentences.zh: **Tar**get-aware（目标感知的 **GATE**s（门），一个简单而有效的数据选择框架，利用了模型内在的数据理解能力。

sentences.en: TarGATE computes a token-level Information Retention Ratio (**IRR**) to scale the output of the feed-forward network, where the instance-level average IRR serves as a quantitative metric for data quality.
sentences.zh: TarGATE 计算词元级的信息保留比率（**IRR**）来缩放前馈网络的输出，其中实例级的平均 IRR 作为数据质量的量化指标。

sentences.en: To align gates' preferences with the target task, we employ a joint optimization strategy utilizing the reference set and a subset of candidate data, which encourages the gates to assign higher IRRs to reference-aligned data while suppressing low-quality samples.
sentences.zh: 为使门的偏好与目标任务对齐，我们采用一种联合优化策略，利用参考集和部分候选数据，促使门为与参考对齐的数据分配更高的 IRR，同时抑制低质量样本。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across noisy and real-world scenarios demonstrate that TarGATE outperforms related baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨噪声场景和真实世界场景的大量实验表明，TarGATE 优于相关基线。

sentences.en: Furthermore, TarGATE exhibits superior computational efficiency and strong cross-model transferability, enabling smaller selector to effectively curate high-quality fine-tuning data for larger foundation models.
sentences.zh: 此外，TarGATE 展现出卓越的计算效率和强大的跨模型迁移能力，使较小的选择器能够有效地为较大的基座模型筛选高质量微调数据。

sentences.en: The code is available at [here](https://github.com/FGinfinite/TarGATE).
sentences.zh: 代码可在[此处](https://github.com/FGinfinite/TarGATE)获取。
