title_en: Target-Agnostic Calibration under Distribution Shift with Frequency-Aware Gradient Rectification
title_zh: 分布偏移下借助频率感知梯度修正进行与目标无关的校准

sentences.en: Real-world model deployments inevitably encounter distribution shifts, rendering the confidence estimates of deep neural networks highly unreliable, posing severe risks in safety-critical applications.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的模型部署不可避免地会遇到分布偏移，使深度神经网络的置信度估计变得极为不可靠，在安全关键型应用中构成严重风险。

sentences.en: Existing methods improve calibration via training-time regularization or post-hoc adjustment, but often rely on access to (or simulation of) target domains, limiting practicality.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通过训练时正则化或事后调整来改善校准，但往往依赖对目标领域的访问（或模拟），限制了实用性。

sentences.en: We propose Frequency-aware Gradient Rectification (FGR), a target-agnostic training framework for robust calibration.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了频率感知梯度修正（FGR），一个用于鲁棒校准的与目标无关的训练框架。

sentences.en: From a frequency perspective, FGR applies low-pass filtering to a subset of training images to diminish spurious high-frequency cues and encourage the learning of domain-invariant features.
sentences.zh: 从频率视角来看，FGR 对一部分训练图像应用低通滤波，以削弱虚假的高频线索，并鼓励学习域不变特征。

sentences.en: However, the associated information loss can degrade In-Distribution (ID) calibration.
sentences.zh: 然而，相关的信息损失可能会降低分布内（ID）校准的质量。

sentences.en: To resolve this trade-off, FGR treats ID calibration as a hard constraint and rectifies conflicting parameter updates via geometric projection.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一权衡，FGR 将 ID 校准视为硬约束，并通过几何投影修正相互冲突的参数更新。

sentences.en: This ensures a first-order non-increase in the ID calibration objective without introducing an additional loss-balancing coefficient.
sentences.zh: 这保证了 ID 校准目标的一阶不增性，而无需引入额外的损失平衡系数。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic, real-world, and semantic shift datasets demonstrate that FGR significantly improves calibration under diverse shifts while preserving ID performance, and it remains compatible with post-hoc calibration methods.
sentences.zh: 在合成、真实世界和语义偏移数据集上的大量实验表明，FGR 在各类偏移下显著改善校准，同时保持 ID 性能，并且与事后校准方法兼容。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/YilinZhang107/FGR-Calib.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/YilinZhang107/FGR-Calib 获取。

title_en: Target-Aware Bandit Allocation for Scalable Surrogate Optimization in Chemical Space
title_zh: 面向化学空间中可扩展代理优化的目标感知老虎机分配

sentences.en: Identifying high-utility candidates from massive discrete spaces under expensive evaluations is a recurring challenge across the sciences, with structure-based drug discovery as a prominent example.
sentences.zh: 在昂贵评估条件下，从大规模离散空间中识别高效用候选，是贯穿各科学领域的反复出现的挑战，基于结构的药物发现就是其中的突出例子。

sentences.en: While surrogate-based optimization can increase sample efficiency by reducing the number of expensive evaluations, modern molecular libraries have reached billions to trillions of compounds, making full-library surrogate inference itself a major computational bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于代理的优化可以通过减少昂贵评估的次数来提高样本效率，但现代分子库已发展到数十亿乃至数万亿化合物，使得全库代理推断本身成为主要的计算瓶颈。

sentences.en: We introduce BOBA, a bandit-guided surrogate optimization framework that eliminates full-library inference by adaptively allocating computation across partitions of the action space.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 BOBA，一个老虎机引导的代理优化框架，它通过跨动作空间的分区自适应地分配计算，从而省去全库推断。

sentences.en: By treating partitions as arms in a multi-armed bandit, BOBA concentrates inference and evaluations on empirically promising partitions while maintaining principled exploration.
sentences.zh: 通过将各个分区视为多臂老虎机中的臂，BOBA 将推断和评估集中于经验上有前景的分区，同时保持有原则的探索。

sentences.en: Experiments on real-world synthesis-on-demand libraries demonstrate that optimism-under-uncertainty bandits, combined with meaningful action space partitioning, are essential for effective allocation of inference and evaluations.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界的按需合成库上的实验表明，不确定性下的乐观老虎机与有意义的动作空间分区相结合，对于有效分配推断和评估至关重要。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal a tunable tradeoff between screening performance and surrogate inference cost, which supports practical optimization over current libraries, and establishes a viable route to ultra-large library virtual screening.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示了筛选性能与代理推断成本之间可调的权衡，这既支持对当前库进行实用的优化，也为超大规模库的虚拟筛选确立了可行的路径。

title_en: Target-Driven Policy Optimization for Sequential Counterfactual Outcome Control
title_zh: 用于序列反事实结果控制的目标驱动策略优化

sentences.en: Identifying optimal intervention sequences from offline data to guide temporal systems toward target outcomes is a critical challenge with profound implications for fields like personalized medicine.
sentences.zh: 从离线数据中识别最优干预序列，以引导时序系统朝向目标结果，是一项关键挑战，对个性化医疗等领域具有深远影响。

sentences.en: While existing methods are mostly evaluated in offline settings, practical applications demand online, adaptive strategies that can respond in real-time.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有方法大多在离线设定下评估，但实际应用要求能够实时响应的在线自适应策略。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose \textbf{G}oal-conditioned \textbf{I}ntervention via \textbf{F}actual-\textbf{T}argeted Training (\textbf{GIFT}), a novel framework for learning sequential intervention policies from observational data.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了\textbf{G}oal-conditioned \textbf{I}ntervention via \textbf{F}actual-\textbf{T}argeted Training（\textbf{GIFT}），一种从观测数据中学习序列干预策略的新框架。

sentences.en: GIFT learns a goal-conditioned policy by rescaling rewards with clipped importance weights, stabilizing learning and steering toward the target.
sentences.zh: GIFT 通过用截断的重要性权重重新缩放奖励来学习目标条件化策略，从而稳定学习并引导向目标。

sentences.en: Under standard assumptions, the induced operator has a unique fixed point and our procedure converges to it.
sentences.zh: 在标准假设下，所诱导的算子具有唯一不动点，我们的过程能够收敛到该不动点。

sentences.en: We also bound the bias from clipping and approximation via the gap to the policy’s true value.
sentences.zh: 我们还通过策略真实价值的差距，界定了截断和近似所带来的偏差。

sentences.en: Experiments show GIFT significantly outperforms existing methods in creating goal-conditioned policies for online deployment.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在为在线部署创建目标条件化策略方面，GIFT 显著优于现有方法。

title_en: Target-Oriented Pretraining Data Selection via Neuron-Activated Graph
title_zh: 通过神经元激活图进行面向目标的预训练数据选择

sentences.en: Everyday tasks come with a target, and pretraining models around this target is what turns them into experts.
sentences.zh: 日常任务都伴随一个明确目标，围绕该目标对模型进行预训练，正是将其转变为专家的关键。

sentences.en: In this paper, we study target-oriented language model (LM) pretraining by introducing ***N**euron-**A**ctivated **G**raph Ranking* (NAG-based Ranking), a training-free and interpretable framework for target pretraining data selection.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过引入***N**euron-**A**ctivated **G**raph Ranking*（基于 NAG 的排序），一个免训练且可解释的面向目标预训练数据选择框架，来研究面向目标的语言模型（LM）预训练。

sentences.en: Rather than using black-box representations, our approach directly characterizes each target input by a sparse set of high-impact neurons in any off-the-shelf LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法不采用黑盒表示，而是用任意现成 LLM 中一组稀疏的高影响力神经元直接刻画每个目标输入。

sentences.en: Concretely, we quantify neuron impact and select the most influential neurons across layers into a compact ***N**euron-**A**ctivated **G**raph* (NAG), and rank candidate data by NAG similarity to target examples.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们量化神经元影响力，跨层选取最具影响力的神经元，构成一个紧凑的***N**euron-**A**ctivated **G**raph*（NAG），并按候选数据与目标示例的 NAG 相似度对它们排序。

sentences.en: We conduct experiments across six benchmarks, where our NAG-based Ranking improves target-oriented pretraining by 4.9\% on average over random sampling, and also outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by 5.3\% accuracy on HellaSwag.
sentences.zh: 我们在六个基准上开展实验，我们的基于 NAG 的排序相较随机抽样将面向目标的预训练平均提升了 4.9\%，并在 HellaSwag 上以 5.3\% 的准确率优势胜过最先进的基线。

sentences.en: It also remains effective under a more applicable multi-target setting, where our best setup surpasses two baselines by 1.1\% and 4.1\%, respectively.
sentences.zh: 它在更贴近实际的多目标设定下也仍然有效，我们的最优设置在两个基线上分别超越 1.1\% 和 4.1\%。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive analysis on *why* and *how* our NAG works, e.g., deactivating NAG-selected neurons (only 0.12\% of all) causes a 23.5\% performance collapse, and restricting NAG to the final layer incurs a 4.1\% average drop, indicating that NAG captures a sparse ``functional backbone'' for learning target features.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们对 NAG *为何*以及*如何*生效提供了全面分析，例如，停用 NAG 选出的神经元（仅占全部神经元的 0.12\%）会导致 23.5\% 的性能崩溃，而将 NAG 限制在最后一层会造成平均 4.1\% 的下降，这表明 NAG 捕获了用于学习目标特征的稀疏“功能骨干”。

sentences.en: We release the code at https://github.com/asillycat/NAG.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/asillycat/NAG 发布代码。

title_en: Task-and-Model-Aware Fractal-Consistency for Efficient LLM Reasoning
title_zh: 面向高效 LLM 推理的任务与模型感知的分形一致性

sentences.en: While self-consistency methods have emerged as a promising approach to enhance the correctness of large language model (LLM) outputs by aggregating multiple stochastic samples, they suffer from two critical limitations, resulting in high computation cost.
sentences.zh: 虽然自一致性方法已作为一种通过聚合多个随机样本来增强大型语言模型（LLM）输出正确性的有前景的方法出现，但它们仍受两个关键局限的困扰，导致计算成本高昂。

sentences.en: First, they evaluate output consistency monolithically, failing to efficiently combine partially correct answers across multiple samples.
sentences.zh: 首先，它们以整体方式评估输出一致性，无法有效组合多个样本中的部分正确答案。

sentences.en: Second, they use static stopping criteria that cannot adapt to varying task complexities and model capabilities, resulting in suboptimal computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 其次，它们使用静态的停止准则，无法适应不同的任务复杂度和模型能力，导致计算效率次优。

sentences.en: In this work, we present Task-and-Model-Aware Fractal-Consistency (TMAFC), a novel self-consistency framework that addresses these limitations through two key innovations: (1) Fractal-Consistency, which evaluates output consistency at the granularity of output components to effectively combine partial correct answers across samples, and (2) Adaptive Stopping Criteria Calibration (ASCC), which dynamically adjusts sampling stopping criteria based on real-time assessment of both task difficulty and LLM capability.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了任务与模型感知的分形一致性（TMAFC），一种新颖的自一致性框架，通过两项关键创新解决这些局限：（1）分形一致性，它在输出组件的粒度上评估输出一致性，从而有效组合跨样本的部分正确答案；以及（2）自适应停止准则校准（ASCC），它基于对任务难度和 LLM 能力的实时评估，动态调整采样停止准则。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments on diverse question-answering benchmarks, we demonstrate that TMAFC achieves superior efficiency-accuracy trade-offs, reducing sample cost by up to 55% while maintaining competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 通过在多样的问答基准上的大量实验，我们证明 TMAFC 实现了更优的效率-准确率权衡，在保持与最先进基线相当的准确率的同时，将样本成本降低多达 55%。

title_en: Task-Aware Exploration via a Predictive Bisimulation Metric
title_zh: 通过预测双模拟度量进行任务感知的探索

sentences.en: Accelerating exploration in visual reinforcement learning under sparse rewards remains challenging due to the substantial task-irrelevant variations.
sentences.zh: 由于存在大量的与任务无关的变异，在稀疏奖励下加速视觉强化学习的探索仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Despite advances in intrinsic exploration, many methods either assume access to low-dimensional states or lack task-aware exploration strategies, thereby rendering them fragile in visual domains.
sentences.zh: 尽管内在探索已取得进展，但许多方法要么假设可访问低维状态，要么缺乏任务感知的探索策略，从而在视觉领域中显得脆弱。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we present TEB, a Task-aware Exploration approach that tightly couples task-relevant representations with exploration through a predictive Bisimulation metric.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 TEB，一种任务感知的探索方法，通过预测双模拟度量将任务相关表示与探索紧密结合。

sentences.en: Specifically, TEB leverages the metric not only to learn behaviorally grounded task representations but also to measure global intrinsic novelty over the learned latent space.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，TEB 不仅利用该度量来学习具有行为基础的任务表示，还用它来衡量所学潜在空间上的全局内在新颖性。

sentences.en: To realize this, we first theoretically mitigate the representation collapse of degenerate bisimulation metrics under sparse rewards by internally introducing a simple but effective predicted reward differential term.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，我们首先在理论上缓解了稀疏奖励下退化双模拟度量的表示坍缩，方法是在内部引入一个简单而有效的预测奖励差分项。

sentences.en: Building on this robust metric, we further introduce potential-based global exploration bonuses over anchor states, which measure the relative novelty between observations over the latent space.
sentences.zh: 在这一稳健度量的基础上，我们进一步引入基于势的锚定状态全局探索奖励，用于衡量潜在空间上观测之间的相对新颖性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on MetaWorld and Maze2D show that TEB achieves superior exploration ability and outperforms recent baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 MetaWorld 和 Maze2D 上的大量实验表明，TEB 展现出更强的探索能力，并优于近期基线。

title_en: Task-Aware Mechanism: Hybrid MoE Vision Tower Towards Holistic Video Understanding
title_zh: 任务感知机制：面向整体视频理解的混合 MoE 视觉塔

sentences.en: Should an LVLM use the same video processing pipeline for \emph{comprehending the main idea of a 2-hour movie} and \emph{counting the birds appearing in a 15-second clip}?
sentences.zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）是否应该对\emph{理解一部两小时电影的主旨}\和\emph{数出 15 秒片段中出现的鸟的数量}\使用相同的视频处理流水线？

sentences.en: We present Task-Aware Mechanism (TAM), a hybrid-gated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision tower that adapts frame count and resolution to the user query and video length.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了任务感知机制（TAM），一种混合门控的专家混合（MoE）视觉塔，它根据用户查询和视频长度自适应地调整帧数和分辨率。

sentences.en: TAM introduces a compact 0.1B text-only \emph{Inductor} trained on our TA-116K dataset to infer task types, enabling task-aware visual budgeting and routing: a soft-gated MoE vision encoder for stability, and hard-gated resolution-specific projectors/pipelines for efficient specialization.
sentences.zh: TAM 引入了一个紧凑的 0.1B 纯文本\emph{Inductor}\，在我们构建的 TA-116K 数据集上训练以推断任务类型，从而支持任务感知的视觉预算分配与路由：一个软门控的 MoE 视觉编码器用于稳定性，以及硬门控的、分辨率特异的投影器/流水线用于高效专业化。

sentences.en: The explicit budget also separates task classification from downstream visual-language reasoning, making routing decisions easier to inspect and helping diagnose when fixed visual pipelines under-sample temporal or spatial evidence.
sentences.zh: 显式的预算还将任务分类与下游视觉-语言推理分离开来，使路由决策更易于检查，并有助于诊断固定视觉流水线在何时欠采样时间或空间证据。

sentences.en: Built on Qwen2-7B, TallVA-8B-A7B achieves state-of-the-art performance among models with comparable LLMs on most video benchmarks and remains competitive against stronger-LLM baselines, showing that task-aware visual budgeting makes video understanding more holistic.
sentences.zh: 基于 Qwen2-7B 构建的 TallVA-8B-A7B，在大多数视频基准上，于使用相当 LLM 的模型中取得了最先进的性能，并且与更强 LLM 的基线相比仍具有竞争力，这表明任务感知的视觉预算使视频理解更加整体。

title_en: Task-Aware Preference Calibration for Direct Preference Optimization
title_zh: 面向直接偏好优化的任务感知偏好校准

sentences.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a predominant approach for aligning large language models with human preferences.
sentences.zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为将大型语言模型与人类偏好对齐的主流方法。

sentences.en: Recent work has used perplexity differentials to identify unreliable preference labels, but these methods apply uniform calibration strategies across all samples.
sentences.zh: 近期工作利用困惑度差值来识别不可靠的偏好标签，但这些方法对所有样本应用统一的校准策略。

sentences.en: We observe that the reliability of perplexity signals varies substantially across task types: perplexity differentials strongly correlate with preference quality for factual tasks but provide weak signals for creative tasks where novelty is valued.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，困惑度信号的可靠性在不同任务类型之间差异显著：对于事实性任务，困惑度差值与偏好质量强相关，而在重视新颖性的创意任务中，它提供的信号则很弱。

sentences.en: Based on this observation, we propose Task-Aware Preference Calibration (TAPC), which learns task-conditioned calibration functions that adapt to the characteristics of different prompt types.
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们提出了任务感知偏好校准（TAPC），它学习任务条件化的校准函数，以适应不同提示类型的特征。

sentences.en: TAPC employs a task encoder to extract prompt representations and learns task-specific slope and bias parameters for mapping perplexity signals to confidence targets.
sentences.zh: TAPC 采用任务编码器提取提示表示，并学习任务特异的斜率和偏置参数，将困惑度信号映射到置信度目标。

sentences.en: Through meta-learning on a small reference dataset, TAPC discovers how to weight perplexity signals appropriately for each task category.
sentences.zh: 通过在小型参考数据集上进行元学习，TAPC 发现了如何为每个任务类别适当地加权困惑度信号。

sentences.en: Experiments on Llama-3-8B and Qwen2-7B demonstrate that TAPC outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks, with particularly large improvements on creative and open-ended tasks where uniform calibration strategies fail.
sentences.zh: 在 Llama-3-8B 和 Qwen2-7B 上的实验表明，TAPC 在多个基准上优于现有方法，在统一校准策略失效的创意和开放式任务上提升尤为显著。

title_en: Task-Aware Structured Memory for Dynamic Multi-modal In-Context Learning
title_zh: 面向动态多模态上下文学习的任务感知结构化记忆

sentences.en: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) depend on in-context learning (ICL) for rapid task adaptation, but their scalability is severely limited by finite context windows and the growing cost of key–value (KV) caches in long multi-modal sequences.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）依靠上下文学习（ICL）实现快速的任务适应，但其可扩展性严重受限于有限的上下文窗口，以及在长多模态序列中不断增长的键-值（KV）缓存成本。

sentences.en: Existing memory compression approaches typically rely on rigid token removal or sample-dependent importance estimation, which introduces bias, disrupts semantic structure—particularly for visual representations—and yields static memories that cannot adapt to new queries.
sentences.zh: 现有的记忆压缩方法通常依赖僵化的词元移除或依赖于样本的重要性估计，这会引入偏差、破坏语义结构（尤其是对视觉表示而言），并产生无法适应新查询的静态记忆。

sentences.en: We introduce TASM (Task-Aware Structured Memory), a training-free framework that addresses these limitations through task-aware, structure-preserving, and dynamically accessible memory construction.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 TASM（任务感知结构化记忆），一个免训练框架，通过任务感知、结构保持和动态可访问的记忆构建来解决这些局限。

sentences.en: TASM employs Task-Vector Guided Compression to replace sample-specific signals with a task-level direction that captures shared relevance across demonstrations.
sentences.zh: TASM 采用任务向量引导的压缩，用捕获演示间共享相关性的任务级方向来取代样本特异的信号。

sentences.en: To preserve the underlying information manifold, it further applies Semantics-Aware Token Merging, formulating compression as a Bipartite Graph Matching problem that merges tokens without destructive pruning.
sentences.zh: 为保持底层信息流形，它进一步应用语义感知的词元合并，将压缩形式化为一个二分图匹配问题，在无破坏性剪枝的情况下合并词元。

sentences.en: Finally, TASM organizes compressed representations into a multi-resolution hierarchy consisting of a compact Core Memory and a Latent Bank, enabling Query-Adaptive Dynamic Activation and Dynamic Retrieval at inference time.
sentences.zh: 最后，TASM 将压缩后的表示组织成一个由紧凑的核心记忆和潜在库组成的多分辨率层级结构，从而在推理时支持查询自适应的动态激活和动态检索。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations show that TASM sustains strong multi-modal ICL performance under high compression ratios, demonstrating an effective balance between efficiency, adaptability, and semantic fidelity.
sentences.zh: 实证评估表明，TASM 在高压缩比下仍能维持强劲的多模态 ICL 性能，在效率、适应性和语义保真度之间实现了有效平衡。

title_en: Task-Awareness Improves LLM Generations and Uncertainty
title_zh: 任务感知可以改进 LLM 的生成与不确定性

sentences.en: In many applications of LLMs, natural language responses often have an underlying structure such as representing discrete labels, numerical values, or graphs.
sentences.zh: 在 LLM 的许多应用中，自然语言响应往往具有底层结构，例如表示离散标签、数值或图。

sentences.en: Yet, existing decoding and uncertainty estimation methods operate only in language space and largely disregard structural information.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的解码和不确定性估计方法仅在语言空间中运作，在很大程度上忽视了结构信息。

sentences.en: We address this by modeling LLM outputs directly in a task-dependent latent structure.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在任务相关的潜在结构中对 LLM 输出直接建模来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: By equipping this structure with a dissimilarity measure, we can compute Bayes-optimal responses.
sentences.zh: 通过为这一结构配备相异度度量，我们可以计算贝叶斯最优响应。

sentences.en: These are not selected from sampled generations but are newly synthesized by combining individual responses in the latent space.
sentences.zh: 这些响应不是从采样生成中选择出来的，而是在潜在空间中组合各个响应而全新合成的。

sentences.en: Across different tasks, Bayes-optimal responses consistently outperform standard decoding methods like beam search.
sentences.zh: 在不同的任务中，贝叶斯最优响应始终优于光束搜索等标准解码方法。

sentences.en: Moreover, quantifying uncertainty via the induced Bayesian risk captures variations in terms of the latent structure and improves alignment with output quality and correctness.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过诱导的贝叶斯风险来量化不确定性，能够捕获潜在结构层面的变化，并改善与输出质量和正确性的对齐。

sentences.en: Our decision-theoretic framework is applicable to any problem that admits a latent response structure and enables reliable task-aware LLM predictions.
sentences.zh: 我们的决策理论框架适用于任何允许潜在响应结构的问题，并能实现可靠的任务感知 LLM 预测。

title_en: Task-Driven Subspace Decomposition for Knowledge Sharing and Isolation in LoRA-based Continual Learning
title_zh: 基于 LoRA 的持续学习中用于知识共享与隔离的任务驱动子空间分解

sentences.en: Continual Learning (CL) requires models to sequentially adapt to new tasks without forgetting old knowledge.
sentences.zh: 持续学习（CL）要求模型在不遗忘旧知识的情况下顺序适应新任务。

sentences.en: Recently, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a representative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) method, has gained increasing attention in CL.
sentences.zh: 近期，低秩自适应（LoRA），一种具有代表性的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法，在 CL 中受到日益广泛的关注。

sentences.en: Several LoRA-based CL methods reduce interference across tasks by separating their update spaces, typically building the new space from the estimated null space of past tasks.
sentences.zh: 几种基于 LoRA 的 CL 方法通过分离各任务的更新空间来减少任务间干扰，通常从过去任务估计的零空间中构建新空间。

sentences.en: However, they (i) overlook task-shared directions, which suppresses knowledge transfer, and (ii) fail to capture truly effective task-specific directions since these ``null bases" of old tasks can remain nearly inactive for new task under correlated tasks.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们（i）忽视了任务共享方向，从而抑制了知识迁移；（ii）无法捕获真正有效的任务特异方向，因为在相关任务下，旧任务的这些“零基”对新任务可能几乎处于非激活状态。

sentences.en: To address this, we study LoRA learning capability from a projection energy perspective, and propose Low-rank Decomposition and Adaptation (LoDA).
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们从投影能量的角度研究 LoRA 的学习能力，并提出了低秩分解与自适应（LoDA）。

sentences.en: It performs a task-driven decomposition to build general and truly task-specific LoRA subspaces by solving two energy-based objectives, decoupling directions for knowledge sharing and isolation.
sentences.zh: 它通过求解两个基于能量的目标来执行任务驱动的分解，构建通用且真正任务特异的 LoRA 子空间，从而解耦知识共享与隔离的方向。

sentences.en: LoDA fixes LoRA down-projections on two subspaces and learns robust up-projections via a Gradient-Aligned Optimization (GAO) approach.
sentences.zh: LoDA 在两个子空间上固定 LoRA 的下投影，并通过梯度对齐优化（GAO）方法学习稳健的上投影。

sentences.en: After each task, before integrating the LoRA updates into the backbone, LoDA derives a closed-form recalibration for the general update, approximating a feature-level joint optimum along this task-shared direction.
sentences.zh: 在每个任务之后、将 LoRA 更新整合进骨干网络之前，LoDA 为通用更新推导出一个闭式重新校准，沿着这一任务共享方向逼近特征层面的联合最优。

sentences.en: Experiments indicate that LoDA outperforms existing CL methods.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，LoDA 优于现有的 CL 方法。

title_en: TaskLoom: Weaving Knowledge Across Tasks in World Models
title_zh: TaskLoom：在世界模型中穿织跨任务的知识

sentences.en: World models have significantly improved the sample efficiency of model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) by enabling policy learning in imagination, thereby reducing the need for direct interaction with the real environment.
sentences.zh: 世界模型通过在想象中进行策略学习，显著提升了基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）的样本效率，从而减少了对真实环境直接交互的需求。

sentences.en: However, most existing world model methods are trained independently for each task or perform multi-task learning using offline datasets, failing to fully exploit the latent relationships among tasks in online interactive scenarios.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有的世界模型方法为每个任务独立训练，或使用离线数据集进行多任务学习，未能充分利用在线交互场景中任务之间的潜在关系。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose TaskLoom, a knowledge-sharing world model architecture for online RL.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出了 TaskLoom，一种面向在线 RL 的知识共享世界模型架构。

sentences.en: TaskLoom adopts a grouped two-stage training paradigm: first, the tasks are divided into several groups based on the similarity of world model gradients,   and fine-grained knowledge is shared among tasks within each group; second, coarse-grained knowledge is exchanged across groups, enabling hierarchical knowledge transfer and reuse.
sentences.zh: TaskLoom 采用分组的两阶段训练范式：首先，根据世界模型梯度的相似性将任务划分为若干组，组内任务之间共享细粒度知识；其次，在组间交换粗粒度知识，从而实现层级化的知识迁移与复用。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that TaskLoom outperforms baseline methods on widely used benchmarks such as Proprio Control, Visual Control and Meta-World, validating the effectiveness of the proposed knowledge-sharing mechanism for both low-dimensional state and high-dimensional visual inputs.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，TaskLoom 在 Proprio Control、Visual Control 和 Meta-World 等广泛使用的基准上优于基线方法，验证了所提出的知识共享机制对低维状态和高维视觉输入均有效。

title_en: Taylor-Gaussians-Flow: Towards Non-uniform Motion for Novel View Synthesis from Monocular Video
title_zh: Taylor-Gaussians-Flow：面向单目视频新视角合成的非均匀运动

sentences.en: Long-term non-uniform motion poses a significant challenge for Novel View Synthesis (\textbf{NVS}), as it requires modeling higher-order motion, such as acceleration.
sentences.zh: 长期的非均匀运动对新颖视角合成（\textbf{NVS}）构成了重大挑战，因为它需要建模高阶运动，例如加速度。

sentences.en: Existing methods primarily rely on deformation fields or scene flow, which are limited to first-order approximations.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要依赖形变场或场景流，这些局限于一阶近似。

sentences.en: Due to neglecting higher-order motion representations and supervision, these approaches suffer from long-term non-uniform motion scenarios.
sentences.zh: 由于忽视了高阶运动表示和监督，这些方法在长期非均匀运动场景中表现不佳。

sentences.en: Inspired by Taylor’s theorem, we propose Taylor-Gaussians-Flow (\textbf{TGsF}) to represent and supervise non-uniform motion through first-order and second-order motion components.
sentences.zh: 受泰勒定理启发，我们提出了 Taylor-Gaussians-Flow（\textbf{TGsF}），通过一阶和二阶运动分量来表示和监督非均匀运动。

sentences.en: TGsF comprises two key modules: Taylor-Gaussians (\textbf{TGs}) and Taylor-Gaussians-Flow (\textbf{TGs-Flow}).
sentences.zh: TGsF 包含两个关键模块：Taylor-Gaussians（\textbf{TGs}）和 Taylor-Gaussians-Flow（\textbf{TGs-Flow}）。

sentences.en: TGs represent motion using Gaussian means with a quadratic temporal term and time-dependent opacity.
sentences.zh: TGs 使用带有二次时间项的高斯均值和与时间相关的不透明度来表示运动。

sentences.en: Unlike previous methods, TGs-Flow decouples scene-flow supervision into separate depth and 2D optical-flow constraints.
sentences.zh: 与先前方法不同，TGs-Flow 将场景流监督解耦为独立的深度约束和 2D 光流约束。

sentences.en: This approach effectively mitigates error propagation from either depth or motion estimation while circumventing the scarcity of labeled scene flow data.
sentences.zh: 这种方法有效缓解了深度或运动估计所带来的误差传播，同时绕开了标注场景流数据稀缺的问题。

sentences.en: Guided by the above analysis, we develop the Feed-Forward Taylor-Gaussians-Flow framework, which sets a new state-of-the-art on four dynamic benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在上述分析的指导下，我们开发了前馈 Taylor-Gaussians-Flow 框架，它在四个动态基准上树立了新的最先进水平。

title_en: TCAP: Tri-Component Attention Profiling for Unsupervised Backdoor Detection in MLLM Fine-Tuning
title_zh: TCAP：面向 MLLM 微调中无监督后门检测的三分量注意力画像方法

sentences.en: Fine-Tuning-as-a-Service (FTaaS) facilitates the customization of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) but introduces critical backdoor risks via poisoned data.
sentences.zh: 微调即服务（FTaaS）便利了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的定制化，但也通过投毒数据引入了严重的后门风险。

sentences.en: Existing defenses either rely on supervised signals or fail to generalize across diverse trigger types and modalities.
sentences.zh: 现有防御要么依赖有监督信号，要么难以跨多样的触发器类型和模态泛化。

sentences.en: In this work, we uncover a universal backdoor fingerprint—attention allocation divergence—where poisoned samples disrupt the balanced attention distribution across three functional components: system instructions, vision inputs, and user textual queries, regardless of trigger morphology.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们揭示了一个通用的后门指纹——注意力分配分歧，即投毒样本破坏了三个功能组件（系统指令、视觉输入和用户文本查询）之间的平衡注意力分布，而与触发器的形态无关。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose Tri-Component Attention Profiling (TCAP), an unsupervised defense framework to filter backdoor samples.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞见的启发，我们提出了三分量注意力画像（TCAP），一个用于过滤后门样本的无监督防御框架。

sentences.en: TCAP decomposes cross-modal attention maps into the three components, identifies trigger-responsive attention heads via Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) statistical profiling, and isolates poisoned samples through EM-based vote aggregation.
sentences.zh: TCAP 将跨模态注意力图分解为三个分量，通过高斯混合模型（GMM）统计画像识别对触发器敏感的注意力头，并通过 EM 投票聚合隔离投毒样本。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse MLLM architectures and attack methods demonstrate that TCAP achieves consistently strong performance, establishing it as a robust and practical backdoor defense in MLLMs.
sentences.zh: 跨多样 MLLM 架构和攻击方法的大量实验表明，TCAP 持续取得强劲性能，确立了其作为 MLLM 中稳健实用后门防御方案的地位。

title_en: TD-VAD: Breaking Visual Dependence in Video Anomaly Detection with Text-Driven Learning
title_zh: TD-VAD：利用文本驱动学习打破视频异常检测中的视觉依赖

sentences.en: Visual data is typically a prerequisite for training existing video anomaly detection (VAD) methods.
sentences.zh: 视觉数据通常是训练现有视频异常检测（VAD）方法的前提条件。

sentences.en: However, obtaining sufficient annotated anomaly data for training is challenging and not scalable due to the rarity of anomaly data and the wide variety of abnormal events.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于异常数据的稀有性和异常事件类型的多样性，为训练获取充足的标注异常数据具有挑战性且难以扩展。

sentences.en: In this work, we advocate that the effectiveness of treating texts as video sequences for the VAD model and propose a novel Text-Driven Video Anomaly Detection (TD-VAD) approach to break visual dependence.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们主张将文本视为视频序列对 VAD 模型是有效的，并提出了新颖的文本驱动视频异常检测（TD-VAD）方法，以打破视觉依赖。

sentences.en: In contrast to the anomaly video data, text descriptions of abnormal events are easy to collect, and their class labels can be directly derived.
sentences.zh: 与异常视频数据不同，异常事件的文本描述很容易收集，且其类标签可以直接推导得出。

sentences.en: Specifically, our method utilizes video-like text descriptions with temporal characteristics generated by LLM to train a VAD model, without any reliance on target-domain anomaly data.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的方法利用由 LLM 生成的、具有时间特征的类视频文本描述来训练 VAD 模型，而完全不需要目标域的异常数据。

sentences.en: To capture the long and short-range temporal logic of events, we design the event evolution causal attention module to model contextual dependencies across time.
sentences.zh: 为捕获事件的长短程时间逻辑，我们设计了事件演化因果注意力模块，用于跨时间建模上下文依赖。

sentences.en: During inference, considering the domain gap between the texts and video sequences, we use the frozen CLIP encoder to extract embeddings of video frames to align the text modality while retaining crucial visual information.
sentences.zh: 在推断阶段，考虑到文本与视频序列之间的领域差距，我们使用冻结的 CLIP 编码器提取视频帧的嵌入，以对齐文本模态，同时保留关键视觉信息。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on two large-scale VAD datasets, XD-Violence and UCF-Crime, demonstrate that our method outperforms prior one-class and unsupervised VAD methods by a large margin.
sentences.zh: 在两个大规模 VAD 数据集 XD-Violence 和 UCF-Crime 上的综合实验表明，我们的方法大幅优于先前的一类和无人监督 VAD 方法。

title_en: TD3B: Transition-Directed Discrete Diffusion for Allosteric Binder Generation
title_zh: TD3B：面向变构结合体生成的转移定向离散扩散

sentences.en: Protein function is often controlled by ligands that bias the direction of state transitions, such as agonists and antagonists, rather than stabilizing a single conformation.
sentences.zh: 蛋白质功能往往受配体控制，这些配体（如激动剂和拮抗剂）偏向状态转移的方向，而非稳定单一的构象。

sentences.en: This is especially important for clinically relevant G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), where therapeutic efficacy depends on functional directionality.
sentences.zh: 这对于临床相关的 G 蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）尤为重要，因为其治疗功效取决于功能方向性。

sentences.en: Structure-based design methods optimize binding to static conformations and cannot represent non-reversible, directional effects or systematically distinguish agonist from antagonist behavior.
sentences.zh: 基于结构的设计方法优化与静态构象的结合，无法表示不可逆的、方向性的效应，也无法系统地区分激动剂与拮抗剂的行为。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce **T**ransition-**D**irected **D**iscrete **D**iffusion for allosteric **B**inder design (**TD3B**), a sequence-based generative framework that designs binders with specified agonist or antagonist behavior via a directional transition control objective.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们引入了用于变构结合体设计的**转**移-**定**向**离**散**扩**散（**TD3B**），一个基于序列的生成框架，通过方向性转移控制目标来设计具有指定激动剂或拮抗剂行为的结合体。

sentences.en: TD3B combines a target-aware Direction Oracle, a soft binding-affinity gate, and amortized fine-tuning of a pre-trained discrete diffusion model, enabling targeted agonist and antagonist generation decoupled from binding affinity and unattainable by equilibrium-based or inference-only guidance baselines.
sentences.zh: TD3B 结合了一个目标感知的方向预言机、一个软结合亲和力门控，以及对预训练离散扩散模型的摊销微调，从而能够与结合亲和力解耦地实现定向的激动剂和拮抗剂生成，这是基于平衡或仅推理引导的基线所无法实现的。

title_en: TDM-R1: Reinforcing Few-Step Diffusion Models with Non-Differentiable Reward
title_zh: TDM-R1：用不可微奖励强化少步扩散模型

sentences.en: While few-step generative models have enabled powerful image and video generation at significantly lower cost, generic reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms for few-step models remain an unsolved problem.
sentences.zh: 虽然少步生成模型已经以显著更低的成本实现了强大的图像和视频生成，但面向少步模型的通用强化学习（RL）范式仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: Existing RL approaches for few-step diffusion models strongly rely on back-propagating through differentiable reward models, thereby excluding the majority of important real-world reward signals, e.g., non-differentiable rewards such as humans' binary likeness, object counts, etc.  To properly incorporate non-differentiable rewards to improve few-step generative models, we introduce TDM-R1, a novel reinforcement learning paradigm built upon a leading few-step model, Trajectory Distribution Matching (TDM).
sentences.zh: 现有的少步扩散模型 RL 方法强烈依赖通过可微奖励模型进行反向传播，从而排除了大多数重要的真实世界奖励信号，例如人类二元喜好、物体计数等不可微奖励。为恰当地纳入不可微奖励以改进少步生成模型，我们引入了 TDM-R1，一种构建在领先少步模型轨迹分布匹配（TDM）之上的新颖强化学习范式。

sentences.en: TDM-R1 decouples the learning process into surrogate reward learning and generator learning.
sentences.zh: TDM-R1 将学习过程解耦为代理奖励学习和生成器学习。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we developed practical methods to obtain per-step reward signals along the deterministic generation trajectory of TDM, resulting in a unified RL post-training method that significantly improves few-step models' ability with generic rewards.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们开发了实用方法，沿着 TDM 的确定性生成轨迹获取逐步奖励信号，从而形成一种统一的 RL 后训练方法，显著提升了少步模型利用通用奖励的能力。

sentences.en: We conduct extensive experiments ranging from text-rendering, visual quality, and preference alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们开展了涵盖文本渲染、视觉质量和偏好对齐的大量实验。

sentences.en: All results demonstrate that TDM-R1 is a powerful reinforcement learning paradigm for one- and few-step text-to-image models, scaling from 0.6B to 6B parameters while achieving state-of-the-art performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain metrics.
sentences.zh: 所有结果都表明，TDM-R1 是一种面向单步和少步文本到图像模型的强大强化学习范式，可从 0.6B 扩展到 6B 参数，并在域内和域外指标上均取得最先进性能。

title_en: Teaching Models to Teach Themselves: Reasoning at the Edge of Learnability
title_zh: 教会模型自我教学：在可学习性边缘进行推理

sentences.en: RL methods for finetuning large reasoning models stall on datasets with low initial success rates, and thus little training signal.
sentences.zh: 用于微调大型推理模型的 RL 方法往往在初始成功率较低、因而训练信号很少的数据集上会陷入停滞。

sentences.en: We investigate a fundamental question: Can a pretrained LLM leverage latent knowledge to generate an automated curriculum  for problems it cannot solve?
sentences.zh: 我们研究一个根本性问题：预训练 LLM 能否利用潜在知识，为它无法解决的问题自主生成一个自动课程？

sentences.en: We explore this with SOAR: A self-improvement framework designed to surface these pedagogical signals through meta-RL.
sentences.zh: 我们通过 SOAR 来探索这一点：一个旨在通过元 RL 浮现这些教学信号的自改进框架。

sentences.en: A teacher model proposes synthetic problems for a student model, and is rewarded with its improvement on a subset of hard problems, thus grounding the curriculum in real student progress rather than proxy rewards.
sentences.zh: 教师模型为学生模型提出合成问题，并以学生在一部分难题上的进步作为奖励，从而使课程扎根于真实的进步，而非代理奖励。

sentences.en: Our study on the hardest subsets of math benchmarks (0/128 success) reveal three core findings.
sentences.zh: 我们在数学基准最难的子集（0/128 成功率）上的研究揭示了三项核心发现。

sentences.en: First, it is possible to realize bi-level meta-RL that unlocks learning under sparse, binary rewards by sharpening a latent capacity of pretrained models to generate useful problems.
sentences.zh: 首先，在稀疏二元奖励下，可以实现双层元 RL，通过磨砺预训练模型生成有用问题的潜在能力，来解锁学习。

sentences.en: Second, grounded rewards outperform intrinsic rewards used in prior LLM self-play, reliably avoiding the typical instability and diversity collapse modes.
sentences.zh: 其次，有根基的奖励优于先前 LLM 自博弈中使用的内在奖励，可靠地避免了典型的不稳定性和多样性坍缩模式。

sentences.en: Third, the structure and well-posedness of questions are more critical for learning progress than solution correctness.
sentences.zh: 第三，问题的结构和良构性对学习进展更为关键，而非答案的正确性。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that the ability to generate useful stepping stones does not require the preexisting ability to solve the hard problems, paving a principled path to escape reasoning plateaus without additional curated data.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，生成有用踏脚石的能力并不需要预先具备解决难题的能力，这为在没有额外精选数据的情况下摆脱推理平台期奠定了一条有原则的路径。

title_en: Teaching Molecular Dynamics to a Non-Autoregressive Ionic Transport Predictor
title_zh: 教非自回归离子输运预测器学习分子动力学

sentences.en: Unlike most static material properties widely studied in the machine learning literature, ionic transport properties are inherently dynamic, making their fast and accurate prediction from static atomic structures challenging.
sentences.zh: 与机器学习文献中广泛研究的多数静态材料性质不同，离子输运性质本质上是动态的，这使得从静态原子结构对其进行快速、准确的预测具有挑战性。

sentences.en: The current standard approach, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, suffers from prohibitively high computational cost.
sentences.zh: 当前的标准方法，分子动力学（MD）模拟，饱受计算成本高得难以承受之苦。

sentences.en: Recent autoregressive learning-based MD acceleration methods requiring sequential inference remain slow and prone to error accumulation; in contrast, existing non-autoregressive material property prediction models are less accurate because they fail to exploit dynamics.
sentences.zh: 近期的基于学习的自回归 MD 加速方法需要序列推断，仍然缓慢且容易发生误差累积；相比之下，现有的非自回归材料性质预测模型因未能利用动力学而不够准确。

sentences.en: Moreover, existing methods typically benefit from datasets either with or without atomic trajectories, but not both.
sentences.zh: 此外，现有方法通常要么受益于带有原子轨迹的数据集，要么受益于不带的，而非两者兼得。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose a non-autoregressive learning framework based on auxiliary modality learning, which treats atomic trajectories as an auxiliary modality during training but does not require them at inference.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出了一个基于辅助模态学习的非自回归学习框架，它在训练时将原子轨迹视为辅助模态，但在推断时并不需要它们。

sentences.en: This enables the predictor to learn dynamics without sequential inference while benefiting from both types of datasets.
sentences.zh: 这使预测器能够学习动力学而无需序列推断，同时受益于两类数据集。

sentences.en: As a result, our framework achieves over 200 times speedup compared to autoregressive models on the dataset with atomic trajectories while substantially reducing prediction error relative to non-autoregressive benchmarks across both types of datasets.
sentences.zh: 其结果是，我们的框架在带原子轨迹的数据集上相比自回归模型实现了 200 倍以上的加速，同时在两类数据集上相对非自回归基准大幅降低了预测误差。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/jykim-git/MD.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/jykim-git/MD 获取。

title_en: TEAM: Temporal–Spatial Consistency Guided Expert Activation for MoE Diffusion Language Model Acceleration
title_zh: TEAM：时间-空间一致性引导的专家激活用于 MoE 扩散语言模型加速

sentences.en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently gained significant attention due to their inherent support for parallel decoding.
sentences.zh: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLM）近来因其对并行解码的内在支持而受到广泛关注。

sentences.en: Building on this paradigm, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs with autoregressive (AR) initialization have further demonstrated strong performance competitive with mainstream AR models.
sentences.zh: 在这一范式的基础上，具有自回归（AR）初始化的专家混合（MoE）dLLM 进一步展现了与主流 AR 模型相竞争的强劲性能。

sentences.en: However, we identify a fundamental mismatch between MoE architectures and diffusion-based decoding.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们识别出 MoE 架构与基于扩散的解码之间存在根本性的不匹配。

sentences.en: Specifically, a large number of experts are activated at each denoising step, while only a small subset of tokens is ultimately accepted, resulting in substantial inference overhead and limiting their deployment in latency-sensitive applications.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，每个去噪步骤都会激活大量专家，而最终只有一小部分词元被接受，这导致可观的推理开销，并限制了它们在延迟敏感应用中的部署。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose **TEAM**, a plug-and-play framework that accelerates MoE dLLMs by enabling more accepted tokens with fewer activated experts.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 **TEAM**，一个即插即用的框架，通过以更少的激活专家实现更多被接受的词元，来加速 MoE dLLM。

sentences.en: TEAM is motivated by the observation that expert routing decisions exhibit strong temporal consistency across denoising levels as well as spatial consistency across token positions.
sentences.zh: TEAM 的动机源于这样一个观察：专家路由决策在跨去噪层级间表现出强的时间一致性，并在跨词元位置上表现出空间一致性。

sentences.en: Leveraging these properties, TEAM employs three complementary expert activation and decoding strategies, conservatively selecting necessary experts for decoded and masked tokens and simultaneously performing aggressive speculative exploration across multiple candidates.
sentences.zh: 利用这些性质，TEAM 采用了三种互补的专家激活与解码策略，为解码词元和掩码词元保守地选取必要专家，同时跨多个候选进行积极的投机式探索。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that TEAM achieves up to 2.2× speedup over vanilla MoE dLLM, with negligible performance degradation.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，TEAM 相较 vanilla MoE dLLM 实现了高达 2.2 倍的加速，且性能下降可忽略不计。

sentences.en: Code is released at https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/TEAM-MoE-dLLM.
sentences.zh: 代码已在 https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/TEAM-MoE-dLLM 发布。

title_en: TeamTR: Trust-Region Fine-Tuning for Multi-Agent LLM Coordination
title_zh: TeamTR：面向多智能体 LLM 协调的信赖域微调

sentences.en: Multi-agent LLM systems can improve reasoning and tool use, yet recent evidence shows their gains are often unstable and sensitive to interaction design.
sentences.zh: 多智能体 LLM 系统可以改进推理和工具使用，但最近有证据表明，其收益往往不稳定，且对交互设计敏感。

sentences.en: A promising direction is to train collaboration, but team post-training introduces a moving-target effect: when agents interact through a shared context, updating one agent shifts the context distribution faced by the others, which can regress coordination under naive sequential updates.
sentences.zh: 一个有前景的方向是训练协作能力，但团队后训练会引入移动目标效应：当智能体通过共享上下文交互时，更新一个智能体会改变其他智能体所面对的上下文分布，这在朴素的顺序更新下可能使协调发生回退。

sentences.en: We propose TeamTR, a trust-region framework for fine-tuning heterogeneous LLM teams that explicitly controls this occupancy shift.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 TeamTR，一个用于微调异构 LLM 团队的信赖域框架，它显式控制这种占据率偏移。

sentences.en: TeamTR evaluates each agent update on rollouts from the intermediate team induced by partially applied updates, and enforces per-agent trust regions via a token-decomposed reverse KL that is directly monitorable from those rollouts.
sentences.zh: TeamTR 在由部分应用的更新诱导的中间团队所产生的 rollout 上评估每个智能体的更新，并通过一种可从这些 rollout 直接监控的词元分解反向 KL 来强制每个智能体的信赖域。

sentences.en: This yields population-level per-update and per-stage improvement lower bounds whose functional form applies to any realized update order, and motivates a practical certificate proxy computed from logged surrogates and KL terms.
sentences.zh: 这产生了种群级、逐更新和逐阶段的改进下界，其函数形式适用于任何实际实现的更新顺序，并催生了一个由记录的代理项和 KL 项计算得到的实用证书代理。

sentences.en: We instantiate TeamTR for router-based text handoff with sequence-level returns and bounded group-normalized advantages, and show empirically that it mitigates coordination regressions, improves training stability across heterogeneous teams, and supports modular component replacement via a trust-region alignment step.
sentences.zh: 我们将 TeamTR 实例化为基于路由器的文本交接，采用序列级回报和有界的组归一化优势，并实证表明它能缓解协调回退、提升异构团队的训练稳定性，并通过信赖域对齐步骤支持模块化组件替换。

title_en: TeamWork: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Asymmetric Role-aware Channel Modeling
title_zh: TeamWork：通过非对称角色感知通道建模进行多元时间序列异常检测

sentences.en: Multivariate time series anomaly detection remains challenging as it requires the joint modeling of variable relationships and temporal dependencies.
sentences.zh: 多元时间序列异常检测仍然具有挑战性，因为它要求对变量关系和时序依赖进行联合建模。

sentences.en: Existing methods often struggle to balance channel relationship modeling and overlook the relative importance of different variables within multivariate time series.
sentences.zh: 现有方法往往难以平衡通道关系建模，并忽视多元时间序列中不同变量的相对重要性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose TeamWork, an asymmetric role-aware channel modeling framework that decouples variables into dominant and auxiliary roles according to their contributions to uncertainty reduction.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了 TeamWork，一个非对称的角色感知通道建模框架，它根据变量对不确定性降低的贡献，将变量解耦为主导角色和辅助角色。

sentences.en: Dominant variables drive system evolution and their deviations more strongly disrupt normal patterns, while auxiliary variables provide complementary cues.
sentences.zh: 主导变量驱动系统演化，其偏差会更强地扰乱正常模式，而辅助变量则提供互补的线索。

sentences.en: These variables with different roles are integrated through a role-aware gated interaction module.
sentences.zh: 这些具有不同角色的变量通过一个角色感知的门控交互模块进行整合。

sentences.en: Moreover, point and subsequence anomalies can exist in multiple periodic systems, and the same anomaly type may behave differently across short- and long-period series.
sentences.zh: 此外，点和子序列异常可以存在于多个周期系统中，且相同的异常类型在短周期和长周期序列中可能表现不同。

sentences.en: To capture such variations, we introduce a period-aware masked modeling mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为捕获此类差异，我们引入了一个周期感知的掩码建模机制。

sentences.en: It employs multiple specialized masking mechanisms spanning short to long periods to facilitate comprehensive temporal dependency learning.
sentences.zh: 它采用多种跨短到长周期的专门掩码机制，以促进全面的时序依赖学习。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that TeamWork achieves superior performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，TeamWork 取得了优越的性能。

title_en: TEFormer: Structured Bidirectional Temporal Enhancement Modeling in Spiking Transformers
title_zh: TEFormer：脉冲 Transformer 中的结构化双向时间增强建模

sentences.en: In recent years, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have achieved remarkable progress, with Spiking Transformers emerging as a promising architecture for energy-efficient sequence modeling.
sentences.zh: 近年来，脉冲神经网络（SNN）取得了显著进展，脉冲 Transformer 正成为一种面向节能序列建模的有前景架构。

sentences.en: However, existing Spiking Transformers still lack a principled mechanism for effective temporal fusion, limiting their ability to fully exploit spatiotemporal dependencies.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的脉冲 Transformer 仍缺乏有效时间融合的原理性机制，限制了它们充分利用时空依赖的能力。

sentences.en: Inspired by feedforward–feedback modulation in the human visual pathway, we propose **TEFormer**, the first Spiking Transformer framework that achieves bidirectional temporal fusion by decoupling temporal modeling across its core components.
sentences.zh: 受人类视觉通路中前馈-反馈调制的启发，我们提出了 **TEFormer**，第一个通过在其核心组件间解耦时间建模来实现双向时间融合的脉冲 Transformer 框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, TEFormer employs a lightweight and hyperparameter-free **forward temporal fusion mechanism in the attention module**, enabling fully parallel computation, while incorporating a **backward gated recurrent structure in the MLP** to aggregate temporal information in reverse order and reinforce temporal consistency.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，TEFormer 在注意力模块中采用一种轻量级且无需超参数的前向时间融合机制，实现完全并行的计算，同时在 MLP 中引入反向门控循环结构，以逆序聚合时间信息并强化时间一致性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across a wide range of benchmarks demonstrate that TEFormer consistently and significantly outperforms strong SNN and Spiking Transformer baselines under diverse datasets.
sentences.zh: 跨广泛基准的大量实验表明，TEFormer 在多样数据集上持续且显著地优于强 SNN 和脉冲 Transformer 基线。

sentences.en: Moreover, through the first systematic evaluation of Spiking Transformers under different neural encoding schemes, we show that the performance gains of TEFormer remain stable across encoding choices, indicating that the improved temporal modeling directly translates into reliable accuracy improvements across varied spiking representations.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过首次在不同神经编码方案下对脉冲 Transformer 进行系统评估，我们表明 TEFormer 的性能增益在不同编码选择下保持一致，说明改进的时间建模直接转化为跨各种脉冲表示中可靠的准确率提升。

sentences.en: These results collectively establish TEFormer as an effective and general framework for temporal modeling in Spiking Transformers.
sentences.zh: 这些结果共同确立了 TEFormer 作为脉冲 Transformer 中时间建模的有效且通用框架。

sentences.en: Code is available [here](https://github.com/Fancyssc/TEFormer).
sentences.zh: 代码可在[此处](https://github.com/Fancyssc/TEFormer)获取。

title_en: TelecomTS: A Multi-Modal Observability Dataset for Time Series and Language Analysis
title_zh: TelecomTS：用于时间序列与语言分析的多模态可观测性数据集

sentences.en: Modern enterprises generate vast streams of time series metrics when monitoring complex systems, known as observability data.
sentences.zh: 现代企业在监控复杂系统时会生成海量时间序列指标流，这些数据被称为可观测性数据。

sentences.en: Unlike conventional time series from domains such as climate, observability data are zero-inflated, highly stochastic, and exhibit minimal temporal structure.
sentences.zh: 与来自气候等领域的时间序列不同，可观测性数据具有零膨胀、高度随机且时序结构极少的特征。

sentences.en: Despite their importance, observability datasets remain underrepresented in public benchmarks due to proprietary restrictions and privacy concerns.
sentences.zh: 尽管它们非常重要，但由于专有限制和隐私顾虑，可观测性数据集在公开基准中仍未得到充分代表。

sentences.en: Existing datasets are often anonymized and normalized, removing scale information and limiting their use for tasks such as anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and multi-modal reasoning.
sentences.zh: 现有数据集往往经过匿名化和归一化处理，丢失了尺度信息，限制了它们在异常检测、根因分析和多模态推理等任务中的用途。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce TelecomTS, a large-scale observability dataset derived from a 5G telecommunications network.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们引入了 TelecomTS，一个源自 5G 电信网络的大规模可观测性数据集。

sentences.en: TelecomTS features heterogeneous, de-anonymized covariates with explicit absolute scale information and provides a diverse suite of downstream tasks, including anomaly detection, root cause analysis, and multi-modal question-answering.
sentences.zh: TelecomTS 具有异构、去匿名化的协变量，携带明确的绝对尺度信息，并提供多样的下游任务套件，包括异常检测、根因分析和多模态问答。

sentences.en: Benchmarking state-of-the-art time series, language, reasoning, and multi-modal foundation models reveals that existing approaches struggle with the abrupt, noisy, and high-variance dynamics characteristic of observability data.
sentences.zh: 对最先进的时间序列、语言、推理和多模态基础模型的基准测试表明，现有方法难以应对可观测性数据所特有的突变、嘈杂和高方差动态。

sentences.en: Our experiments further underscore the importance of preserving covariates’ absolute scale, emphasizing the need for foundation time series models that natively leverage scale information for practical real-world observability applications.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验进一步强调了保留协变量绝对尺度的重要性，凸显了基础时间序列模型原生利用尺度信息以用于实际真实世界可观测性应用的必要性。

sentences.en: The code is available at: \url{https://github.com/Ali-maatouk/TelecomTS}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在：\url{https://github.com/Ali-maatouk/TelecomTS}。

title_en: Telescope: Improving Zero Shot Detection of LLM Generated Content By Measuring Token Repetition Probability
title_zh: Telescope：通过测量词元重复概率改进 LLM 生成内容的零样本检测

sentences.en: Distinguishing Large Language Model (LLM) generated text from human writing is a critical and difficult challenge.
sentences.zh: 区分大型语言模型（LLM）生成的文本与人类写作，是一项关键且困难的挑战。

sentences.en: While LLMs are trained to write like humans, we hypothesize that this training leaves an indelible mark.
sentences.zh: 虽然 LLM 被训练成像人类一样写作，但我们假设这种训练会留下一个不可磨灭的印记。

sentences.en: LLMs develop a particularly strong aversion to token repetition very early in training.
sentences.zh: LLM 在训练的早期就会形成对词元重复的特别强烈的厌恶。

sentences.en: This bias persists as a ``Vestigial Heuristic'' (a developmental artifact) that is activated in LLM-generated text, separating LLM from human writing.
sentences.zh: 这种偏差作为一种“残留启发式”（一种发育产物）持续存在，并在 LLM 生成的文本中被激活，从而将 LLM 与人类写作区分开。

sentences.en: To probe this phenomenon, we introduce Telescope Perplexity, a metric that evaluates the token repetition of the model, $P(s_i | s_{1:i})$.
sentences.zh: 为探测这一现象，我们引入了 Telescope 困惑度，一种评估模型词元重复的指标，$P(s_i | s_{1:i})$。

sentences.en: Our empirical investigation reveals that the Telescope Perplexity signature emerges early in pre-training, and Telescope Perplexity empirically enables highly effective zero-shot LLM detection.
sentences.zh: 我们的实证调查揭示，Telescope 困惑度特征在预训练早期就已出现，而 Telescope 困惑度在实证上能够实现高效的零样本 LLM 检测。

sentences.en: We show state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse datasets (including modern evaluation sets we introduce), reference models, and perturbation schemes with greater efficiency than other methods.
sentences.zh: 我们在多样的数据集（包括我们引入的现代评估集）、参考模型和扰动方案上展现了最先进或具有竞争力的性能，且效率高于其他方法。

title_en: Temper-Then-Tilt: Principled Unlearning for Generative Models through Tempering and Classifier Guidance
title_zh: 调和再倾斜：通过调和与分类器引导实现生成模型的原理性遗忘

sentences.en: We study machine unlearning in large generative models by framing the task as density ratio estimation to a target distribution rather than supervised fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将任务表述为到目标分布的密度比估计，而非监督微调，来研究大型生成模型中的机器遗忘。

sentences.en: While classifier guidance is a standard approach for approximating this ratio and can succeed in general, we show it can fail to faithfully unlearn with finite samples when the forget set represents a sharp, concentrated data distribution.
sentences.zh: 虽然分类器引导是近似这一比值的标准方法，并且通常能够成功，但我们表明当遗忘集代表一个尖锐、集中的数据分布时，它在有限样本下可能无法忠实地完成遗忘。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce **Temper-Then-Tilt Unlearning (T3-Unlearning)**, which freezes the base model and applies a two-step inference procedure: (i) *tempering* the base distribution to flatten high-confidence spikes, and (ii) *tilting* the tempered distribution using a lightweight classifier trained to distinguish retain from forget samples.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们引入了**调和再倾斜遗忘（T3-Unlearning）**，它冻结基础模型并应用一个两步推断流程：（i）*调和*基础分布以抹平高置信尖峰，以及（ii）*倾斜*调和后的分布，使用一个训练用于区分保留样本与遗忘样本的轻量级分类器。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis provides finite-sample guarantees linking the surrogate classifier's risk to unlearning quality, proving that tempering is necessary to successfully unlearn for concentrated distributions.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析提供了将代理分类器风险与遗忘质量联系起来的有限样本保证，证明了对于集中分布，调和是成功遗忘所必需的。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations on the TOFU benchmark demonstrate that T3-Unlearning improves forget quality and generative utility over existing baselines, while training only a fraction of the parameters with a minimal runtime.
sentences.zh: 在 TOFU 基准上的实证评估表明，T3-Unlearning 在遗忘质量和生成效用方面优于现有基线，同时仅训练一小部分参数且运行时开销极低。

title_en: Temperature Scaling in Discrete Sequence (Language) Models
title_zh: 离散序列（语言）模型中的温度缩放

sentences.en: Temperature scaling is widely used to control generation behavior and improve reasoning performance in discrete sequence models.
sentences.zh: 温度缩放被广泛用于控制离散序列模型的生成行为并提升推理性能。

sentences.en: However, temperature scaling at the sequence level is particularly challenging since the partition function of the model is typically not tractable and naive *token-wise* temperature scaling induces bias in the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimates.
sentences.zh: 然而，序列层面的温度缩放尤为具有挑战性，因为模型的配分函数通常不可处理，而朴素的*逐词元*温度缩放会在最大后验（MAP）估计中引入偏差。

sentences.en: Discrete diffusion settings exacerbate this issue: enhanced flexibility due to multiple potential orderings for generating tokens complicates likelihood computation and incurs high variance.
sentences.zh: 离散扩散设定加剧了这一问题：由于生成词元可能存在多种顺序而带来的更高灵活性，使似然计算变得复杂，并带来高方差。

sentences.en: We propose and investigate fine-tuning objectives for sequence-level temperature scaling, along with metrics to quantify the success of a given temperature scaling procedure.
sentences.zh: 我们提出并研究了用于序列层面温度缩放的微调目标，以及用于量化给定温度缩放过程成功程度的度量。

sentences.en: Specifically, our contributions are threefold.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的贡献有三个方面。

sentences.en: First, we introduce our objective across a wide class of sequence models through a novel formalism that unifies autoregressive and diffusion-based language models.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们通过一种新颖的形式体系在广泛的序列模型类别上引入我们的目标，该形式体系统一了自回归和基于扩散的语言模型。

sentences.en: Second, we design two metrics that quantify temperature scaling based on likelihood *ratios* and thus obviate access to the partition function.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们设计了两个基于似然*比值*来量化温度缩放的度量，从而无需访问配分函数。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce fine-tuning objectives that reliably achieve the desired change in model temperature.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入了能够可靠实现模型温度期望变化的微调目标。

sentences.en: Our experiments with language models (GPT2, BD3LM) show that the proposed approach leads to more consistent generation with lower perplexity.
sentences.zh: 我们在语言模型（GPT2、BD3LM）上的实验表明，所提方法带来了更低困惑度、更一致的生成。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we provide empirical evidence that it can enhance the reasoning performance in language models.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提供实证证据表明，它可以增强语言模型中的推理性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at [github.com/Aalto-QuML/temp_lm](https://github.com/Aalto-QuML/temp_lm).
sentences.zh: 代码可在[github.com/Aalto-QuML/temp_lm](https://github.com/Aalto-QuML/temp_lm)获取。

title_en: Tempora: Characterising the Time-Contingent Utility of Online Test-Time Adaptation
title_zh: Tempora：刻画在线测试时自适应的依时而变效用

sentences.en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a compelling remedy for machine learning (ML) models that degrade under domain shifts, improving generalisation *on-the-fly* with only unlabelled samples.
sentences.zh: 测试时自适应（TTA）为在领域偏移下性能退化的机器学习（ML）模型提供了一种引人注目的补救方案，仅借助无标注样本就能*即时*改进泛化。

sentences.en: This flexibility suits real deployments, yet conventional evaluations unrealistically assume unbounded processing time, overlooking the accuracy-latency trade-off.
sentences.zh: 这种灵活性契合真实部署，但传统评估不切实际地假设处理时间无限制，忽视了准确率-延迟权衡。

sentences.en: As ML increasingly underpins latency-sensitive and user-facing use-cases, temporal pressure constrains the viability of adaptable inference; predictions arriving too late to act on are futile.
sentences.zh: 随着 ML 日益支撑延迟敏感和面向用户的应用，时间压力制约了自适应推理的可行性；迟到来不及据此行动所做的预测是徒劳的。

sentences.en: We introduce *Tempora*, a framework for evaluating TTA under this pressure.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 *Tempora*，一个在这种压力下评估 TTA 的框架。

sentences.en: It consists of temporal scenarios that model deployment constraints, evaluation protocols that operationalise measurement, and time-contingent utility metrics that quantify the accuracy-latency trade-off.
sentences.zh: 它由建模部署约束的时间场景、使测量可操作化的评估协议，以及量化准确率-延迟权衡的依时而变效用指标组成。

sentences.en: We instantiate the framework with three such metrics: (1) *discrete* utility for asynchronous streams with hard deadlines, (2) *continuous* utility for interactive settings where value decays with latency, and (3) *amortised* utility for budget-constrained deployments.
sentences.zh: 我们用三个这样的指标来实例化该框架：（1）面向具有硬截止时间的异步流的*离散*效用，（2）面向效用随延迟衰减的交互式设定的*连续*效用，以及（3）面向预算受限部署的*摊销*效用。

sentences.en: By applying Tempora to 11 TTA methods, we find that *rank instability* persists across 750+ temporal evaluations spanning diverse datasets, models, and hardware platforms;
sentences.zh: 通过将 Tempora 应用于 11 种 TTA 方法，我们发现*排序不稳定性*在横跨多样数据集、模型和硬件平台的 750 余次时间评估中持续存在；

sentences.en: *i.e.,* conventional rankings do not predict rankings under temporal pressure.
sentences.zh: *即*，传统排序无法预测时间压力下的排序。

sentences.en: The highest-utility method varies with the shift and temporal pressure, with no clear winner.
sentences.zh: 效用最高的方法随偏移和时间压力而变化，没有明确的赢家。

sentences.en: By enabling systematic evaluation across diverse temporal constraints for the first time, Tempora reveals when and why rankings change, offering practitioners a lens for method selection and researchers a target for deployable adaptation.
sentences.zh: 通过首次实现跨多样时间约束的系统评估，Tempora 揭示了排序在何时以及为何发生变化，为从业者提供了方法选择的视角，也为研究者提供了可部署自适应的目标。

sentences.en: Code: https://github.com/sudotensor/tempora.
sentences.zh: 代码：https://github.com/sudotensor/tempora。

title_en: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
title_zh: 时间上下文重建驱动长上下文语言模型中的类情景式顺序记忆

sentences.en: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans.
sentences.zh: 人类情景记忆支持对跨较长时间尺度展开的经历的检索，然而，由于人类长期记忆实验中的机制可及性有限，支撑这一能力的计算机制仍存在争议。

sentences.en: Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval.
sentences.zh: 长上下文 LLM 可能为揭示驱动此类检索的合理计算机制提供有前景的途径。

sentences.en: Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal order memory task.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们通过一个时间顺序记忆任务，研究 LLM 是否以及如何捕获情景记忆的核心行为特征。

sentences.en: Using a new dataset of human behavior based on memory of a full-length novel, we show that models exhibit the same characteristic distance effect observed in humans on this task.
sentences.zh: 利用一个基于对整部小说记忆的人类行为新数据集，我们表明模型在该任务上表现出与人类观察到的相同特征性距离效应。

sentences.en: We next apply long-context mechanistic interpretability analyses to uncover how models solve this task, and find that model performance relies on a one-dimensional temporal code that is reinstated during retrieval by a single time-reinstatement attention head.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来应用长上下文的机制性可解释性分析来揭示模型如何解决该任务，并发现模型性能依赖于一个一维时间编码，该编码在检索过程中由一个单一的时间重建注意力头重建。

sentences.en: These findings support temporal context reinstatement as an important mechanism for episodic-like temporal-order memory in LLMs, offering new insights into how temporal aspects of long-term episodic memory may be instantiated in both artificial and biological systems.
sentences.zh: 这些发现支持时间上下文重建作为 LLM 中类情景式时间顺序记忆的重要机制，为长期情景记忆的时间方面如何在人工和生物系统中实例化提供了新的见解。
