title_en: Temporal Difference Calibration in Sequential Tasks: Application to Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: 序列任务中的时序差分校准：应用于视觉-语言-行动模型

sentences.en: Recent advances in vision-language-action (VLA) models for robotics have highlighted the importance of reliable uncertainty quantification in sequential tasks.
sentences.zh: 机器人视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型的近期进展，凸显了序列任务中可靠不确定性量化的重要性。

sentences.en: However, assessing and improving calibration in such settings remains mostly unexplored, especially when only partial trajectories are observed.
sentences.zh: 然而，在此类设定中评估和改进校准在很大程度上仍未得到探索，尤其是在仅观察到部分轨迹时。

sentences.en: In this work, we formulate *sequential calibration* for episodic tasks, where task-success confidence is produced along an episode, while success is determined at the end of it.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们为情节式任务形式化了*序列校准*，其中任务成功置信度在一个情节中生成，而成功在情节结束时才确定。

sentences.en: We introduce a sequential extension of the Brier score and show that, for binary outcomes, its risk minimizer coincides with the VLA policy’s value function.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 Brier 分数的序列扩展，并表明对于二元结果，其风险最小化器与 VLA 策略的价值函数一致。

sentences.en: This connection bridges uncertainty calibration and reinforcement learning, enabling the use of temporal-difference (TD) value estimation as a principled calibration mechanism over time.
sentences.zh: 这一联系架起了不确定性校准与强化学习之间的桥梁，使得能够将时序差分（TD）价值估计作为一种有原则的随时间校准机制。

sentences.en: We empirically show that TD calibration improves performance relative to the state-of-the-art on simulated and real-robot data.
sentences.zh: 我们实证表明，在仿真和真实机器人数据上，TD 校准相对最先进方法提升了性能。

sentences.en: Interestingly, we show that when calibrated using TD, the VLA's single-step action probabilities can yield competitive uncertainty estimates, in contrast to recent findings that employed different calibration techniques.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我们表明，当使用 TD 进行校准时，VLA 的单步动作概率能够产生具有竞争力的不确定性估计，这与采用不同校准技术的近期发现形成对比。

title_en: Temporal Difference Learning for Diffusion Models
title_zh: 用于扩散模型的时序差分学习

sentences.en: Diffusion models are typically trained with objectives that focus on local denoising targets at individual time steps (or adjacent pairs), which do not enforce consistency between predictions along the denoising trajectory.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型通常使用聚焦于单个时间步（或相邻对）局部去噪目标的损失函数进行训练，这些目标并不强制去噪轨迹上各预测之间的一致性。

sentences.en: This lack of cross-time consistency can degrade performance, especially for few-step samplers.
sentences.zh: 这种缺乏跨时间一致性会损害性能，尤其是对少步采样器而言。

sentences.en: We introduce a temporal difference (TD) objective that penalizes inconsistency of the model’s \emph{multi-step} progress along the denoising path.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个时序差分（TD）目标，惩罚模型沿去噪路径的\emph{多步}\进展中的不一致。

sentences.en: By reformulating the diffusion process as a Markov reward process and casting denoising as a policy evaluation problem in reinforcement learning, we derive a unified TD approach that applies to both discrete- and continuous-time diffusion formulations.
sentences.zh: 通过将扩散过程重新表述为马尔可夫奖励过程，并把去噪视为强化学习中的策略评估问题，我们推导出一种统一的 TD 方法，适用于离散时间和连续时间两种扩散公式。

sentences.en: We further propose a principled sample-based reweighting method that stabilizes training.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出一种有原则的基于样本的重加权方法，以稳定训练。

sentences.en: Empirically, we show that using our TD training can significantly improve sample quality measured by FID, with stronger advantages when the number of sampling steps is small, highlighting its practical utility under low-computation-budget scenarios.
sentences.zh: 实证上，我们表明使用我们的 TD 训练能够显著改善以 FID 衡量的样本质量，并且在采样步数较少时优势更强，凸显了其在低算力预算场景下的实用价值。

sentences.en: We provide ablation studies to justify our design choices, including pairwise loss reweighting, regularization weight, and one-step stride.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了消融研究来论证我们的设计选择，包括成对损失重加权、正则化权重和单步跨度。

sentences.en: Overall, our TD approach can be a general drop-in that enforces cross-time consistency and improves generation quality across different diffusion generative models.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的 TD 方法可以作为一种通用的即插即用组件，强制跨时间一致性并提升不同扩散生成模型的生成质量。

authors.name: Victor Prisacariu
authors.institution: University of Oxford and Niantic Spatial

title_en: Temporal Difference Learning with Compressed Updates: Error-Feedback meets Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 带压缩更新的时序差分学习：误差反馈遇见强化学习

sentences.en: In large-scale distributed machine learning, recent works have studied the effects of compressing gradients in stochastic optimization to alleviate the communication bottleneck.
sentences.zh: 在大规模分布式机器学习中，近期工作研究了在随机优化中压缩梯度以缓解通信瓶颈的效果。

sentences.en: These works have collectively revealed that stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is robust to structured perturbations such as quantization, sparsification, and delays.
sentences.zh: 这些工作共同揭示，随机梯度下降（SGD）对诸如量化和稀疏化、延迟等结构化扰动具有鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Perhaps surprisingly, despite the surge of interest in multi-agent reinforcement learning, almost nothing is known about the analogous question: \textit{Are common reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms also robust to similar perturbations?}
sentences.zh: 也许令人惊讶的是，尽管对多智能体强化学习的兴趣陡增，但关于类似问题几乎一无所知：\textit{常见的强化学习（RL）算法是否也对类似的扰动具有鲁棒性？}

sentences.en: We investigate this question by studying a variant of the classical temporal difference (TD) learning algorithm with a perturbed update direction, where a general compression operator is used to model the perturbation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过研究经典时序差分（TD）学习算法的一个变体来调查这一问题，该变体使用受扰动的更新方向，并用一个通用压缩算子来建模扰动。

sentences.en: Our work makes three important technical contributions.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作做出了三项重要的技术贡献。

sentences.en: First, we prove that compressed TD algorithms, coupled with an error-feedback mechanism used widely in optimization, exhibit the same non-asymptotic theoretical guarantees as their SGD counterparts.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们证明，与优化中广泛使用的误差反馈机制相结合的压缩 TD 算法，具有与其 SGD 对应算法相同的非渐近理论保证。

sentences.en: Second, we show that our analysis framework extends seamlessly to nonlinear stochastic approximation schemes that subsume Q-learning.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们表明我们的分析框架可以无缝扩展到涵盖 Q-learning 的在线非线性随机逼近方案。

sentences.en: Third, we prove that for multi-agent TD learning, one can achieve linear convergence speedups with respect to the number of agents while communicating just $\tilde{O}(1)$ bits per iteration.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们证明对于多智能体 TD 学习，可以在每轮迭代仅通信 $\tilde{O}(1)$ 比特的情况下，实现关于智能体数量的线性收敛加速。

sentences.en: Notably, these are the first finite-time results in RL that account for general compression operators and error-feedback in tandem with linear function approximation and Markovian sampling.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，这些是强化学习中首批同时考虑通用压缩算子与误差反馈，并结合线性函数逼近和马尔可夫采样的有限时间结果。

sentences.en: Our proofs hinge on the construction of novel Lyapunov functions that capture the dynamics of a memory variable introduced by error-feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们的证明关键在于构造新颖的 Lyapunov 函数，以刻画误差反馈引入的记忆变量的动力学。

title_en: Temporal Preference Optimization for Unsupervised Retrieval
title_zh: 无监督检索的时间偏好优化

sentences.en: Unsupervised dense retrievers offer scalability by learning semantic similarity from unlabeled documents via contrastive learning, but they struggle to capture the temporal relevance, retrieving semantically related but temporally misaligned documents-an important aspect when a document collection spans multiple time periods (*e.g.,* retrieving documents from 2018-2025 for "Who is the president in 2019?" introduces temporal ambiguity).
sentences.zh: 无监督稠密检索器通过在无标注文档上利用对比学习学习语义相似性，从而提供可扩展性，但它们难以捕获时间相关性，会检索出语义相关但时间错位的文档——当文档集合跨越多个时间段时这是一个重要方面（*例如*，为“2019 年的总统是谁？”检索 2018-2025 年的文档会引入时间歧义）。

sentences.en: Existing methods rely on supervised training with explicit timestamps, which are not always feasible.
sentences.zh: 现有方法依赖带显式时间戳的监督训练，而这并不总是可行。

sentences.en: We propose TPOUR (*Temporal Preference Optimization for Unsupervised Retriever*), which uses our novel training method *Temporal Retrieval Preference Optimization* (TRPO).
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 TPOUR（无监督检索器的时间偏好优化），它使用我们新颖的训练方法*时间检索偏好优化*（TRPO）。

sentences.en: TRPO reinterprets preference learning in the temporal dimension, guiding the retriever to favor temporally aligned documents.
sentences.zh: TRPO 在时间维度上重新诠释了偏好学习，引导检索器偏向时间对齐的文档。

sentences.en: TPOUR further generalizes to unseen time periods via interpolation in a learned time embedding, enabling continuous temporal alignment.
sentences.zh: TPOUR 进一步通过在所学时间嵌入中进行插值，泛化到未见的时间段，从而实现连续的时间对齐。

sentences.en: Experiments on temporal information retrieval (T-IR), TPOUR outperforms both unsupervised and supervised baselines.
sentences.zh: 在时间信息检索（T-IR）上的实验中，TPOUR 优于无监督和有监督基线。

sentences.en: Compared to Qwen-Embedding-8B, despite being about 72.7$\times$ smaller, TPOUR Contriever improves average nDCG@5 by +4.04 (+12.15%) on explicit and +4.98 (+15.21%) on implicit queries.
sentences.zh: 与 Qwen-Embedding-8B 相比，尽管 TPOUR Contriever 大约小 72.7$\times$ 倍，它在显式查询上平均 nDCG@5 提升了 +4.04（+12.15%），在隐式查询上提升了 +4.98（+15.21%）。

sentences.en: We provide our code at https://github.com/agwaBom/TPOUR.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/agwaBom/TPOUR 提供代码。

title_en: Temporal Score Rescaling for Temperature Sampling in Diffusion and Flow Models
title_zh: 扩散与流模型中温度采样的时间分数重新缩放

sentences.en: We present a mechanism to steer the sampling diversity of denoising diffusion and flow matching models, allowing users to sample from a sharper or broader distribution than the training distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种调控去噪扩散和流匹配模型采样多样性的机制，允许用户从比训练分布更尖锐或更宽泛的分布中进行采样。

sentences.en: We build on the observation that these models leverage (learned) score functions of noisy data distributions for sampling and show that rescaling these allows one to effectively control a 'local' sampling temperature.
sentences.zh: 我们基于这样一个观察：这些模型利用含噪数据分布的（习得的）分数函数进行采样，并表明重新缩放这些分数可以有效地控制一个“局部”采样温度。

sentences.en: Notably, this approach does not require any finetuning or alterations to training strategy, and can be applied to any off-the-shelf model and is compatible with both deterministic and stochastic samplers.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，这种方法不需要任何微调或对训练策略的修改，可以应用于任何现成模型，并且与确定性和随机采样器都兼容。

sentences.en: We first validate our framework on toy 2D data, and then demonstrate its application for diffusion models trained across five disparate tasks -- image generation, pose estimation, depth prediction, robot manipulation, and protein design.
sentences.zh: 我们首先在玩具 2D 数据上验证我们的框架，随后展示其对跨五个不同任务训练的扩散模型的应用——图像生成、姿态估计、深度预测、机器人操作和蛋白质设计。

sentences.en: We find that across these tasks, our approach allows sampling from sharper (or flatter) distributions, yielding performance gains e.g., depth prediction models benefit from sampling more likely depth estimates, whereas image generation models perform better when sampling a slightly flatter distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在这些任务中，我们的方法允许从更尖锐（或更平坦）的分布中采样，从而带来性能提升，例如深度预测模型受益于采样更可能的深度估计，而图像生成模型在采样略平坦的分布时表现更好。

title_en: Temporal Self-Rewarding Language Models: Decoupling Chosen-Rejected via Past-Future
title_zh: 时间性自奖励语言模型：通过过去-未来解耦被选与被拒

sentences.en: Self-Rewarding Language Models propose an architecture in which the Large Language Models(LLMs) both generates responses and evaluates its own outputs via LLM-as-a-Judge prompting, dynamically improving its generative capabilities through iterative Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
sentences.zh: 自奖励语言模型提出了一种架构，其中大型语言模型（LLM）既生成响应，又通过 LLM-as-a-Judge 提示评估自身的输出，并通过迭代式直接偏好优化（DPO）动态提升其生成能力。

sentences.en: However, our analysis reveals a critical limitation in existing self-rewarding paradigms: the synchronized improvement of chosen and rejected responses progressively narrows the representational difference between contrasting samples, undermining effective preference learning.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的分析揭示了现有自奖励范式中的一个关键局限：被选与被拒响应的同步改进会逐步缩小对比样本之间的表示差异，从而削弱有效的偏好学习。

sentences.en: We propose Temporal Self-Rewarding Language Models that strategically coordinate past, present, and future model generations to sustain learning signals.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了时间性自奖励语言模型，策略性地协调过去、现在和未来的模型生成，以维持学习信号。

sentences.en: Our dual-phase framework introduces: (1) Anchored Rejection - fixing rejected responses using the past initial model's outputs and (2) Future-Guided Chosen - dynamically curating chosen samples using next-generation model predictions.
sentences.zh: 我们的双阶段框架引入了：（1）锚定拒绝——使用过去初始模型的输出来固定被拒响应；以及（2）未来引导的被选——使用下一代模型的预测动态策展被选样本。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across three model families (Llama, Qwen, Mistral) and different model sizes (Llama3B/8B/70B) demonstrate significant improvements when trained with our method compared to self-rewarding using same computation resources.
sentences.zh: 跨三个模型家族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral）和不同模型规模（Llama3B/8B/70B）的大量实验表明，在相同计算资源下，使用我们的方法训练相比自奖励方法带来了显著改进。

sentences.en: For example, Llama3.1-8B reaches a 29.44 win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0 with our method, outperforming the self-rewarding baseline (19.69) by 9.75. Notably, our method also demonstrates superior out-of-distribution generalization across mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), knowledge-based QA (ARC, TruthfulQA), and code generation (HumanEval) tasks, even though we do not specifically collect such training data.
sentences.zh: 例如，Llama3.1-8B 使用我们的方法在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上达到了 29.44 的胜率，比自奖励基线（19.69）高出 9.75。值得注意的是，尽管我们没有专门收集此类训练数据，我们的方法在数学推理（GSM8K）、基于知识的问答（ARC、TruthfulQA）和代码生成（HumanEval）任务上也展现了卓越的分布外泛化能力。

sentences.en: The generality of our temporal strategy is further validated by its benefits when extended to online reinforcement learning settings on mathematical reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们时间性策略的通用性还通过其在数学推理任务的在线强化学习设定中的收益得到进一步验证。

title_en: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning
title_zh: 潜在规划的时间拉直

sentences.en: Learning good representations is essential for latent planning with world models.
sentences.zh: 学习良好的表示对使用世界模型的潜在规划至关重要。

sentences.en: While pretrained visual encoders produce strong semantic visual features, they are not tailored to planning and contain information irrelevant---or even detrimental---to planning.
sentences.zh: 虽然预训练的视觉编码器能产生强大的语义视觉特征，但它们并非为规划而定制，包含与规划无关甚至有害的信息。

sentences.en: Inspired by the perceptual straightening hypothesis in human visual processing, we introduce temporal straightening to improve representation learning for latent planning.
sentences.zh: 受人类视觉处理中知觉拉直假说的启发，我们引入时间拉直来改进潜在规划的表示学习。

sentences.en: Using a curvature regularizer that encourages locally straightened latent trajectories, we jointly learn an encoder and a predictor of a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model.
sentences.zh: 利用一个鼓励局部拉直潜在轨迹的曲率正则化器，我们联合学习一个联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型的编码器和预测器。

sentences.en: We show that reducing curvature this way makes the Euclidean distance in latent space a better proxy for the geodesic distance and improves the conditioning of the planning objective.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，以此方式降低曲率，可以使潜在空间中的欧氏距离成为测地距离更好的近似，并改善规划目标的条件性。

sentences.en: We demonstrate empirically that temporal straightening makes gradient-based planning more stable and yields significantly higher success rates across a suite of goal-reaching tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们实证表明，时间拉直使基于梯度的规划更加稳定，并在整套目标到达任务上取得了显著更高的成功率。

sentences.en: Our code is in https://agenticlearning.ai/temporal-straightening.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码位于 https://agenticlearning.ai/temporal-straightening。

title_en: Temporal Weighted Encoding: Towards Maximal-Capacity Spike Coding for ANN–SNN Conversion
title_zh: 时间加权编码：面向 ANN-SNN 转换的最大容量脉冲编码

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) emulate the spiking behavior of biological neurons and are promising for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing.
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）模仿生物神经元的脉冲行为，有望实现节能的类脑计算。

sentences.en: A widely used strategy to train SNNs is to convert pretrained Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), where the accuracy and efficiency are determined by the spike encoding scheme.
sentences.zh: 一种广泛使用的训练 SNN 的策略是转换预训练的人工神经网络（ANN），其准确率和效率取决于脉冲编码方案。

sentences.en: Traditional methods based on spike count or timing severely underutilize the available encoding space, leading to large accuracy degradation under low-timestep constraints.
sentences.zh: 基于脉冲计数或时序的传统方法严重未能充分利用可用的编码空间，在低时间步约束下会导致较大的准确率下降。

sentences.en: More expressive alternatives involve complex dynamics, which hinder scalability and practical deployment.
sentences.zh: 更具表达力的替代方案涉及复杂动力学，这阻碍了可扩展性和实际部署。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Temporal Weighted Encoding (TWE).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了时间加权编码（TWE）。

sentences.en: Spikes are implicitly assigned exponentially decaying weights through a recursive integration, drawing an analogy to a temporal bit sequence.
sentences.zh: 通过递归积分，脉冲被隐式地分配指数衰减的权重，这类似于时间比特序列。

sentences.en: We systematically analyze the temporal mismatch caused by this weight pattern and propose temporal relaxation and threshold relaxation to resolve this issue, enabling fast and accurate activation encoding.
sentences.zh: 我们系统地分析了这种权重模式所造成的时间不匹配，并提出时间松弛和阈值松弛来解决这一问题，从而实现快速且准确的激活编码。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that TWE achieves negligible conversion loss with significantly fewer timesteps, offering a scalable and efficient solution for SNN deployment.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，TWE 以显著更少的时间步实现了可忽略的转换损失，为 SNN 部署提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案。

title_en: Temporal-aware Flow Matching for Video Generation with Temporally Coherent Motion
title_zh: 面向时间一致运动视频生成的时域感知流匹配

sentences.en: Despite rapid advances in text-to-video generation, state-of-the-art generative models still suffer from producing temporally incoherent and unrealistic motion for videos.
sentences.zh: 尽管文本到视频生成取得了快速进展，但最先进的生成模型仍然存在生成时间上不连贯、不真实的视频运动的问题。

sentences.en: The key weakness of existing works is that they commonly treat videos as frame sequences and directly adopt Flow Matching (FM) objectives, which are originally designed for images.
sentences.zh: 现有工作的关键弱点是，它们通常将视频视为帧序列，并直接采用最初为图像设计的流匹配（FM）目标。

sentences.en: This practice fails to explicitly model motion priors or temporal dependencies, resulting in suboptimal dynamics that may appear incoherent and unrealistic.
sentences.zh: 这种做法未能显式建模运动先验或时间依赖，导致出现的动力学可能显得不连贯且不真实。

sentences.en: To solve this problem, we propose Temporal-aware Flow Matching (TFM), a novel training paradigm that embeds inter-frame constraints into the flow objective, leading to temporally coherent motion modeling in video generation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了时域感知流匹配（TFM），一种新颖的训练范式，它将帧间约束嵌入流目标中，从而在视频生成中实现时间一致的运动建模。

sentences.en: More specifically, the proposed TFM enforces temporal correlations across frames while retaining the desirable properties of FM, and further introduces a residual-type loss that aligns naturally with this new flow.
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，所提出的 TFM 在保留 FM 理想性质的同时，强制跨帧的时间相关性，并进一步引入一种与该新流自然对齐的残差型损失。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove that models trained with TFM are able to exhibit remarkably enhanced temporal perception ability.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上证明，使用 TFM 训练的模型能够展现出显著增强的时域感知能力。

sentences.en: Notably, TFM imposes no additional cost during inference and is applicable to any model using FM.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，TFM 在推断时不增加任何额外成本，并适用于任何使用 FM 的模型。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our TFM can significantly improve motion realism across diverse motion types.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的 TFM 能够在多样运动类型中显著提升运动真实感。

sentences.en: Generated videos are presented at https://pzrain.github.io/tfm.
sentences.zh: 生成的视频见 https://pzrain.github.io/tfm。

authors.name: Yipeng Zhang
authors.institution: Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University, Tsinghua University

title_en: Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization for Video Temporal Grounding
title_zh: 面向视频时间定位的时域感知推理优化

sentences.en: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video temporal grounding with reinforcement learning for generating reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）借助强化学习在视频时间定位和生成推理路径方面取得了显著进展。

sentences.en: However, existing models often produce superficial reasoning, which offers limited guidance for precise temporal localization.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有模型往往产生表面化的推理，对精确的时间定位指导有限。

sentences.en: This limitation stems from (1) inefficient random exploration and (2) reward functions that focus solely on the answer correctness while ignoring reasoning quality.
sentences.zh: 这一局限源于（1）低效的随机探索，以及（2）仅聚焦于答案正确性而忽视推理质量的奖励函数。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose TaRO (Temporal-Aware Reasoning Optimization), a framework that explicitly enhances the model’s ability of thinking with time.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 TaRO（时域感知推理优化），一个显式增强模型“随时间的思考”能力的框架。

sentences.en: First, we introduce a Constructive Reasoning Exploration that leverages pre-generated dense captions to construct reasoning paths grounded in explicit visual cues and timestamps, enabling efficient exploration of high-quality time-aware reasoning.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们引入建设性推理探索，利用预生成的密集描述来构建扎根于显式视觉线索和时间戳的推理路径，从而实现对高质量时域感知推理的高效探索。

sentences.en: Second, to evaluate reasoning quality, we design a Temporal-Sensitivity Reward.
sentences.zh: 其次，为评估推理质量，我们设计了一个时间敏感度奖励。

sentences.en: High-quality reasoning should be anchored to specific events and timestamps.
sentences.zh: 高质量的推理应当锚定在具体事件和时间戳上。

sentences.en: If the event boundary under thinking is disrupted, such reasoning should become invalid, leading to a drop in the logit of the reasoning path.
sentences.zh: 如果思考中的事件边界被破坏，此类推理应被视为无效，从而引发推理路径 logit 的下降。

sentences.en: We utilize this drop as a critique of reasoning quality.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这一下降作为对推理质量的批评信号。

sentences.en: Finally, TaRO follows a progressive curriculum, which starts by utilizing this reward to select better constructed reasoning paths, and evolves to a free exploration phase where the model autonomously generates effective reasoning.
sentences.zh: 最后，TaRO 遵循递进式课程：它首先利用该奖励选择更好的构建推理路径，然后演进到自由探索阶段，在此阶段模型自主生成有效的推理。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that TaRO achieves state-of-the-art performance on VTG benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，TaRO 在 VTG 基准上取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/TaRO.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/TaRO 获取。

title_en: Temporal-Emerged Prompting for Segment Anything in Multiframe Infrared Small Target Detection
title_zh: 多帧红外小目标检测中面向 Segment Anything 的时间涌现提示

sentences.en: Accurately localizing and segmenting small targets in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) infrared sequences remains a challenging task.
sentences.zh: 在低信噪比（SNR）红外序列中精确定位和分割小目标，仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。

sentences.en: Since targets are often indistinguishable from the background in individual frames, existing methods, even when equipped with advanced foundation model and powerful inter-frame association mechanisms, still fail to detect them.
sentences.zh: 由于目标在单帧中往往与背景难以区分，现有方法即使配备先进的基础模型和强大的帧间关联机制，仍然无法检测到它们。

sentences.en: Motivated by the observation that targets tend to emerge gradually from the background over time and become distinguishable, we propose Temporal-Emerged Prompting for Segment Anything Model (TEP-SAM), a principled framework designed to explicitly exploit such temporal-emerged cues to modulate and prompt SAM.
sentences.zh: 受目标随时间逐渐从背景中涌现并变得可区分的观察启发，我们提出了面向 Segment Anything Model 的时间涌现提示（TEP-SAM），一个旨在显式利用此类时间涌现线索来调控和提示 SAM 的原理性框架。

sentences.en: TEP-SAM operates by jointly modeling global motion patterns and local motion deviations to locate potential targets.
sentences.zh: TEP-SAM 通过联合建模全局运动模式和局部运动偏差来定位潜在目标。

sentences.en: It further enhances target region features by leveraging motion discrepancy, thereby generating temporal-emerged cues for SAM and enabling non-interactive segmentation.
sentences.zh: 它进一步利用运动差异增强目标区域特征，从而为 SAM 生成时间涌现线索，并实现非交互式分割。

sentences.en: By bridging large-scale semantic pretraining with task-specific temporal modeling, TEP-SAM effectively adapts SAM to the challenging multiframe infrared small target detection task.
sentences.zh: 通过将大规模语义预训练与任务特异的时域建模相结合，TEP-SAM 有效地将 SAM 适配到具有挑战性的多帧红外小目标检测任务。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, particularly under severely low-SNR conditions and in complex dynamic background.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性，尤其是在严重低信噪比条件和复杂动态背景下。

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: Tensor Train Diffusion: Leveraging Low-Rank Structures for High-Dimensional Score-Based Sampling
title_zh: 张量列扩散：利用低秩结构实现高维基于分数的采样

sentences.en: Diffusion models offer a powerful framework for sampling from complex probability densities by learning to reverse a noising process.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型通过学习逆转一个加噪过程，为从复杂概率密度中采样提供了一种强大的框架。

sentences.en: A common approach involves solving for the time-reversed stochastic differential equation (SDE), which requires the score function of the evolving sample distribution.
sentences.zh: 一种常见的方法涉及求解时间反转的随机微分方程（SDE），这需要演化样本分布的分数函数。

sentences.en: The logarithm of this distribution's density is governed by a Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) type partial differential equation (PDE).
sentences.zh: 该分布密度的对数服从一个 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）型偏微分方程（PDE）。

sentences.en: However, current methods for solving this PDE, such as PINNs or trajectory-based techniques, often suffer from long training times and significant sensitivity to hyperparameter tuning.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前求解该 PDE 的方法，如 PINN 或基于轨迹的技术，往往存在训练时间长和对超参数调优高度敏感的问题。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a novel and efficient solver for the underlying HJB equation based on the functional tensor train (FTT) format.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了一种基于函数张量列（FTT）格式的、用于底层 HJB 方程的新颖高效求解器。

sentences.en: The FTT representation leverages latent low-rank structures to efficiently approximate high-dimensional functions, enabling both model compression and rapid computation.
sentences.zh: FTT 表示利用潜在的低秩结构高效近似高维函数，从而实现模型压缩和快速计算。

sentences.en: By integrating this efficient representation with a backward-in-time iterative scheme derived from backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs), we develop a fast, robust and accurate sampling method.
sentences.zh: 通过将该高效表示与从倒向随机微分方程（BSDE）推导出的反向迭代方案相结合，我们开发出一种快速、稳健且准确的采样方法。

sentences.en: Our approach overcomes primary bottlenecks of existing techniques, enabling high-fidelity sampling from challenging target distributions with improved efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法克服了现有技术的主要瓶颈，能以更高的效率从具有挑战性的目标分布中进行高保真采样。

authors.name: David Sommer
authors.institution: Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics

title_en: Terminal Dimension Reduction for Time Series with Applications
title_zh: 带应用的时间序列端子降维

sentences.en: Terminal embeddings have emerged as a powerful tool for dimension reduction.
sentences.zh: 端子嵌入已成为降维的有力工具。

sentences.en: Given a set of points $P\subset \mathbb{R}^d$, a terminal embedding is a mapping $f:\mathbb{R}^d\rightarrow \mathbb{R}^t$ that preserves the pairwise distance between any pair of points $p\in P$ and $q\in \mathbb{R}^d$ up to small distortion under this mapping.
sentences.zh: 给定点集 $P\subset \mathbb{R}^d$，端子嵌入是一个映射 $f:\mathbb{R}^d\rightarrow \mathbb{R}^t$，在该映射下，它把任意点对 $p\in P$ 和 $q\in \mathbb{R}^d$ 之间的成对距离保持到小的失真范围内。

sentences.en: Terminal embeddings have been particularly fruitful for constructing $k$-means and $k$-median coresets, where the objective is to find a typically weighted subset $\Omega$ of $P$ such that for any candidate solution, the cost of the clustering objective on $\Omega$ approximates the cost of the clustering objective on $P$ up to small distortion.
sentences.zh: 端子嵌入在构建 $k$-means 和 $k$-median 核心集方面尤其富有成效，其目标是找到 $P$ 的一个通常带权重的子集 $\Omega$，使得对任何候选解，$\Omega$ 上的聚类目标代价都能在小失真范围内近似 $P$ 上的聚类目标代价。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, these techniques have not been extended to more complicated structures such as clustering time-series data under common straight-line interpolation between measurements.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，这些技术尚未扩展到更复杂的结构，例如在测量点之间采用常见直线插值的时间序列数据聚类。

sentences.en: The main issue is that terminal embeddings, arguably the central technique in this line of research, cannot be linear and are thus not immediately suitable to preserve linear structures.
sentences.zh: 主要问题在于，端子嵌入——可以说是这一研究方向的核心技术——不可能是线性的，因此不立即适合保持线性结构。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop a generalization of terminal embeddings to affine line-segments that overcomes this issue.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们开发了端子嵌入到仿射线段的推广，从而克服了这一问题。

sentences.en: We showcase their applicability by using our lines-preserving terminal embeddings to obtain the first dimension-free coresets for clustering time-series under the Fréchet distance.
sentences.zh: 我们通过使用保直线的端子嵌入，首次获得 Fr\echet 距离下时间序列聚类的无维核心集，来展示其适用性。

sentences.en: The underlying dimension reduction uses Johnson-Lindenstrauss embeddings, and our experiments indicate that they compare favorably against PCA for real-world time-series.
sentences.zh: 底层降维使用 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 嵌入，我们的实验表明，针对真实世界时间序列，它们相比 PCA 具有优势。

title_en: TerraBind: Fast and Accurate Binding Affinity Prediction through Coarse Structural Representations
title_zh: TerraBind：通过粗粒度结构表示实现快速准确的结合亲和力预测

sentences.en: We present TerraBind, a foundation model for protein-ligand structure and binding affinity prediction that achieves 26$\times$ faster inference than state-of-the-art methods while improving affinity prediction accuracy by up to 20\%.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 TerraBind，一个用于蛋白质-配体结构和结合亲和力预测的基础模型，它的推断速度比最先进方法快 26$\times$ 倍，同时将亲和力预测准确率提升多达 20\%。

sentences.en: Current deep learning approaches to structure-based drug design rely on expensive all-atom diffusion to generate 3D coordinates, creating inference bottlenecks that render large-scale compound screening computationally intractable.
sentences.zh: 目前的基于结构的药物设计深度学习方法依赖昂贵的全原子扩散来生成 3D 坐标，从而造成推断瓶颈，使大规模化合物筛选在计算上难以处理。

sentences.en: We challenge this paradigm with the hypothesis: full all-atom resolution is unnecessary for accurate small molecule pose and binding affinity prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们用如下假设挑战这一范式：对于准确的小分子构象和结合亲和力预测，完整的全原子分辨率并非必要。

sentences.en: TerraBind tests this hypothesis through a coarse pocket-level representation (protein C$_\beta$ atoms and ligand heavy atoms only) within a multimodal architecture combining pretrained molecular encoders and ESM-2 protein embeddings that learns rich structural representations, which are used in a diffusion-free optimization module for pose generation and a binding affinity likelihood prediction module.
sentences.zh: TerraBind 通过一种粗粒度的口袋级表示（仅使用蛋白质 C$\beta$ 原子和配体重原子）来检验这一假设，该表示置于一种组合了预训练分子编码器和 ESM-2 蛋白质嵌入的多模态架构中，能够学习丰富的结构表示，并用于无扩散优化的构象生成模块和结合亲和力似然预测模块。

sentences.en: On structure prediction benchmarks, TerraBind matches diffusion-based baselines in ligand pose accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在结构预测基准上，TerraBind 在配体构象准确率方面与基于扩散的基线相当。

sentences.en: For binding affinity, TerraBind outperforms Boltz-2 by 16-20\% in Pearson correlation on both a public benchmark (CASP16) and a diverse private dataset (18 assays).
sentences.zh: 对于结合亲和力，TerraBind 在公开基准（CASP16）和多样化的私有数据集（18 个实验）上，均以 16-20\% 的 Pearson 相关系数优势超越 Boltz-2。

sentences.en: The affinity module also provides well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, addressing a critical gap in compound prioritization for drug discovery.
sentences.zh: 该亲和力模块还提供校准良好的不确定性估计，弥补了药物发现中化合物优先级排序的一个关键空白。

sentences.en: Furthermore, this module enables a continual learning framework and a hedged batch selection strategy that, in simulated drug discovery cycles, achieves 6$\times$ greater affinity improvement over greedy approaches.
sentences.zh: 此外，该模块支持一个持续学习框架和一种对冲式批次选择策略，在模拟的药物发现周期中，相较于贪心方法，实现了 6$\times$ 倍的亲和力提升。

title_en: Test-Time Anchoring for Discrete Diffusion Posterior Sampling
title_zh: 离散扩散后验采样的测试时锚定

sentences.en: While continuous diffusion models have achieved remarkable success, discrete diffusion offers a unified framework for jointly modeling text and images.
sentences.zh: 虽然连续扩散模型取得了显著成功，但离散扩散为联合建模文本和图像提供了统一的框架。

sentences.en: Beyond unification, discrete diffusion provides faster inference, finer control, and principled training-free guidance, making it well-suited for posterior sampling.
sentences.zh: 除统一性之外，离散扩散还提供更快的推断、更精细的控制和有原则的免训练引导，使其非常适合后验采样。

sentences.en: Existing approaches to posterior sampling using discrete diffusion face severe challenges: derivative-free guidance yields sparse signals, continuous relaxations limit applicability, and split Gibbs samplers suffer from the curse of dimensionality.
sentences.zh: 现有使用离散扩散进行后验采样的方法面临严峻挑战：免导数引导产生稀疏信号，连续松弛限制了适用性，而分裂 Gibbs 采样器则饱受维度灾难之苦。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we introduce Anchored Posterior Sampling (APS), built on two key innovations: *quantized expectation* for gradient-like guidance in discrete embedding space, and *anchored remasking* for adaptive decoding.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们引入了锚定后验采样（APS），它建立在两项关键创新之上：用于离散嵌入空间中类梯度引导的*量化期望*，以及用于自适应解码的*锚定重掩码*。

sentences.en: APS achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete diffusion samplers on both linear and nonlinear inverse problems across the standard image benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在标准图像基准上的线性和非线性逆问题中，APS 在离散扩散采样器中取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the generality of APS through training-free stylization and text-guided editing.
sentences.zh: 我们通过免训练风格化和文本引导编辑来展示 APS 的通用性。

sentences.en: We further apply APS to a large-scale diffusion language model, showing consistent improvement in question answering.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将 APS 应用于大规模扩散语言模型，显示其在问答方面的一致改进。

authors.name: Constantine Caramanis
authors.institution: The University of Texas at Austin

title_en: Test-Time Debiasing with Probabilistic Prompts via Wasserstein Distance in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 视觉-语言模型中通过 Wasserstein 距离利用概率提示进行测试时去偏

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) inherit social biases from large-scale pretraining data, and these biases can amplify in downstream tasks, leading to systematic performance disparities across sensitive groups.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）从大规模预训练数据中继承了社会偏见，这些偏见可能在下游任务中被放大，导致跨敏感群体的系统性性能差异。

sentences.en: Due to the high training cost and the risk of catastrophic forgetting, recent research has focused more on lightweight \emph{test-time} debiasing, aiming to obtain an ideal fair embedding for each query.
sentences.zh: 由于训练成本高昂且存在灾难性遗忘风险，近期研究更关注轻量级的\emph{测试时}\去偏，旨在为每个查询获取理想的公平嵌入。

sentences.en: However, such point-based corrections are often unstable and become notably weaker in multi-class settings, where group structure cannot be adequately captured by a single point.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种基于点的修正往往不稳定，在多类设定中明显减弱，因为单点无法充分捕获组结构。

sentences.en: Therefore, we propose W4D, a distributional debiasing framework that reframes fairness as aligning query embedding distributions to group reference distributions under the Wasserstein distance, which provides a geometry-aware notion of discrepancy beyond mean shifts.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了 W4D，一个分布化去偏框架，它将公平性重新表述为在 Wasserstein 距离下将查询嵌入分布对齐到组参考分布，从而提供一种超越均值偏移的、具有几何感知的差异度量。

sentences.en: To make this alignment practical at test-time, W4D introduces probabilistic prompts that induce controlled distributional perturbations and optimizes a Wasserstein-based objective to reduce cross-group disparity while preserving task-relevant semantics.
sentences.zh: 为在测试时使这一对齐可行，W4D 引入了诱导受控分布扰动的概率提示，并优化一个基于 Wasserstein 的目标，以在保留与任务相关语义的同时减少跨组差异。

sentences.en: This distributional perspective improves robustness in multi-class debiasing and yields a stronger fairness--utility trade-off across diverse VLM downstream evaluations.
sentences.zh: 这种分布化视角提升了多类去偏的鲁棒性，并在多样的 VLM 下游评估中实现了更强的公平-效用权衡。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/QDRhhhh/W4D.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/QDRhhhh/W4D 获取。

title_en: Test-Time Detoxification without Training or Learning Anything
title_zh: 无需训练或学习任何东西的测试时去毒化

sentences.en: Large language models can produce toxic or inappropriate text even for benign inputs, creating risks when deployed at scale.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型即使面对良性的输入，也可能产生有害或不恰当的文本，而这在大规模部署时会带来风险。

sentences.en: Detoxification is therefore important for safety and user trust, particularly when we want to reduce harmful content without sacrificing the model’s generation quality.
sentences.zh: 因此，去毒化对安全和用户信任至关重要，尤其当我们希望在减少有害内容的同时不牺牲模型的生成质量时。

sentences.en: Many existing approaches rely on model retraining, gradients, or learned auxiliary components, which can be costly and may not transfer across model families or to truly black-box settings.
sentences.zh: 许多现有方法依赖模型重训练、梯度或学习到的辅助组件，这些方法可能成本高昂，并且可能无法跨模型家族迁移，也无法适用于真正的黑盒设定。

sentences.en: We introduce a test-time procedure that approximates the gradient of completion toxicity with respect to the input embeddings and uses a small number of descent steps to steer generation toward less toxic continuations.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一种测试时流程，它近似完成文本毒性关于输入嵌入的梯度，并使用少量下降步骤将生成引导向毒性较低的续写。

sentences.en: This is achieved with zeroth-order optimization that requires only access to input embeddings, a toxicity scoring function, and forward evaluations of the model.
sentences.zh: 这借助零阶优化实现，仅需访问输入嵌入、一个毒性评分函数和模型的多次前向评估。

sentences.en: Empirically, the approach delivers robust toxicity reductions across models and prompts and, in most settings, achieves the best overall toxicity–quality trade-off.
sentences.zh: 实证上，该方法在跨模型和提示场景中带来了稳健的毒性降低，并且在大多数设定中实现了最佳的整体毒性-质量权衡。

sentences.en: More broadly, our work positions word embeddings as effective control variables and encourages wider use of black-box optimization to guide autoregressive language models toward scalable, safer text generation, without requiring any training or access to intermediate computations.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，我们的工作将词嵌入定位为有效的控制变量，并鼓励更广泛地使用黑盒优化来引导自回归语言模型实现可扩展、更安全的文本生成，而无需任何训练或对中间计算的访问。

title_en: Test-time Generalization for Physics through Neural Operator Splitting
title_zh: 通过神经算子拆分实现物理的测试时泛化

sentences.en: Neural operators have shown promise in learning solution maps of partial differential equations (PDEs), but they often struggle to generalize when test inputs lie outside the training distribution, such as novel initial conditions, unseen PDE coefficients or unseen physics.
sentences.zh: 神经算子在学习偏微分方程（PDE）的解映射方面显示出潜力，但当测试输入位于训练分布之外（例如新颖的初始条件、未见过的 PDE 系数或未见过的物理现象）时，它们往往难以泛化。

sentences.en: Prior works address this limitation with large scale multi physics pretraining followed by fine tuning, but this still requires examples from the new dynamics, falling short of true zero shot generalization.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作通过大规模多物理预训练后接微调来应对这一局限，但这仍然需要新动力学的示例，无法实现真正的零样本泛化。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a method to enhance generalization at test-time, i.e, without modifying pretrained weights.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种在测试时——即不修改预训练权重——增强泛化的方法。

sentences.en: Building on DISCO, which provides a dictionary of neural operators trained across different dynamics, we introduce a neural operator splitting strategy that, at test time, searches over compositions of training operators to approximate unseen dynamics.
sentences.zh: 依托 DISCO（它提供了跨不同动力学训练的神经算子字典），我们引入了一种神经算子拆分策略，在测试时搜索训练算子的组合来近似未见的动力学。

sentences.en: On challenging out-of-distribution tasks including parameter extrapolation and novel combinations of physics phenomena, our approach achieves state-of-the-art zero shot generalization results, while being able to recover the underlying PDE parameters.
sentences.zh: 在包括参数外推和新颖物理现象组合等具有挑战性的分布外任务上，我们的方法取得了最先进的零样本泛化结果，同时能够恢复底层 PDE 参数。

sentences.en: These results underscore test-time computation as a key avenue for building flexible, compositional, and generalizable neural operators.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了测试时计算作为构建灵活、组合式且可泛化神经算子的关键途径。

title_en: Test-Time Graph Search for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 目标条件强化学习的测试时图搜索

sentences.en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) often struggles with long-horizon tasks, where errors in value estimation accumulate and produce unreliable policies.
sentences.zh: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）常常在长视界任务上遇到困难，因为价值估计误差会累积并产生不可靠的策略。

sentences.en: It is typically assumed that effective long-term planning is infeasible without specialized training.
sentences.zh: 通常的假设是，没有专门的训练，有效的长期规划是不可行的。

sentences.en: In contrast, our work demonstrates that existing GCRL policies can complete long-horizon tasks when combined with a lightweight, training-free planning wrapper.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们的工作表明，现有的 GCRL 策略在与一个轻量级、免训练的规划包装器结合时，能够完成长视界任务。

sentences.en: We find that standard goal-conditioned value functions encode locally consistent geometric structure sufficient for planning.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，标准的目标条件价值函数编码了足以用于规划的局部一致几何结构。

sentences.en: Our approach, Test-Time Graph Search (TTGS), constructs a graph over the offline dataset and employs an adaptive subgoal selection strategy.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法，测试时图搜索（TTGS），在离线数据集上构建图，并采用自适应的子目标选择策略。

sentences.en: To address unreliable value estimates during shortest-path search, we propose a novel mechanism that softly penalizes long-distance transitions.
sentences.zh: 为应对最短路径搜索中不可靠的价值估计，我们提出了一种新机制，对长距离转移进行软惩罚。

sentences.en: Our method incurs negligible computational overhead and requires no additional supervision or parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法带来的计算开销可忽略不计，不需要额外的监督或参数更新。

sentences.en: On the OGBench benchmark, TTGS significantly boosts success rates across multiple base learners and tasks, with primary gains on challenging long-horizon locomotion tasks where some success rates are improved from near-zero to over 90\%, often matching or outperforming methods that require complex auxiliary training.
sentences.zh: 在 OGBench 基准上，TTGS 在多个基础学习器和任务上显著提升了成功率，主要增益体现在具有挑战性的长视界移动任务上，其中一些成功率从接近零提升到 90\% 以上，往往匹敌或超越需要复杂辅助训练的方法。

sentences.en: Code and videos can be found at https://ktolnos.github.io/ttgs.
sentences.zh: 代码和视频可见 https://ktolnos.github.io/ttgs。

authors.name: Junwei Quan
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Toronto

authors.name: Claas Voelcker
authors.institution: University of Toronto, Queer in AI

title_en: Test-Time Guidance for Flow-Based Generative Models via Parallel Tempering on Source Distributions
title_zh: 通过源分布上的并行退火实现基于流的生成模型的测试时引导

sentences.en: Generative models that transport a simple source distribution to a complex data distribution—such as diffusion and flow-based models—are central to high‑fidelity data generation.
sentences.zh: 将简单源分布输送到复杂数据分布的生成模型——例如扩散和基于流的模型——是高保真数据生成的核心。

sentences.en: Test-time guidance can further steer pretrained models toward user-specified high-reward regions without costly retraining.
sentences.zh: 测试时引导还可以在不进行昂贵重训练的情况下，将预训练模型进一步引向用户指定的高奖励区域。

sentences.en: However, existing guidance methods face critical limitations: they struggle with non-differentiable rewards, fail to navigate complex landscapes, and often lack theoretical guarantees on generation performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有引导方法面临关键局限：它们难以处理不可微的奖励，无法驾驭复杂的景观，并且往往缺乏关于生成性能的理论保证。

sentences.en: We propose {\it Source Parallel Tempering (SPT)}, a gradient‑free test‑time guidance framework that operates entirely in source space, leveraging its simpler geometry to avoid the complexities of the data manifold.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 {\it Source Parallel Tempering (SPT)}（源并行退火），一个完全在源空间中运作的无梯度测试时引导框架，利用其更简单的几何结构来避开数据流形的复杂性。

sentences.en: SPT couples a local exploration kernel with parallel tempering, enabling efficient barrier crossing and robust discovery of high‑reward modes.
sentences.zh: SPT 将局部探索核与并行退火相结合，从而实现高效的势垒穿越和对高奖励模态的稳健发现。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we provide a new error bound linking training-time approximation error to test-time guidance performance.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们提供了一个新的误差界，将训练时近似误差与测试时引导性能联系起来。

sentences.en: Empirically, SPT significantly improves over state-of-the-art methods on benchmark tasks in conditional image synthesis and dynamical system trajectory sampling.
sentences.zh: 实证上，SPT 在条件图像合成和动力学系统轨迹采样的基准任务上显著优于最先进的方法。

title_en: Test-Time Learning of Causal Structure from Interventional Data
title_zh: 从干预数据进行测试时因果结构学习

sentences.en: Supervised Causal Learning has shown promise in causal discovery, yet it often struggles with generalization across diverse interventional settings, particularly when intervention targets are unknown.
sentences.zh: 监督式因果学习已在因果发现中展现出潜力，但它常常难以跨多样的干预设定进行泛化，尤其是当干预目标未知时。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose TICL (Test-time Interventional Causal  Learning), a novel method that synergizes Test-Time Training with Joint Causal Inference (JCI).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了 TICL（测试时干预因果学习），一种将测试时训练与联合因果推断（JCI）协同起来的新方法。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design a self-augmentation strategy to generate instance-specific training data at test time, effectively avoiding distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计了一种自增强策略，在测试时为每个实例生成训练数据，从而有效避免分布偏移。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by integrating JCI, we developed a PC-inspired two-phase supervised learning scheme, which effectively leverages self-augmented data while ensuring theoretical identifiability.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过集成 JCI，我们开发了一种受 PC 启发的两阶段监督学习方案，该方案有效利用自增强数据，同时确保理论上的可辨识性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on bnlearn benchmarks demonstrate TICL's superiority in multiple aspects of causal discovery and intervention target detection.
sentences.zh: 在 bnlearn 基准上的大量实验证明了 TICL 在因果发现和干预目标检测多个方面的优越性。

authors.name: Yuxuan Liang
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

title_en: Test-time Offline Reinforcement Learning on Goal-related Experience
title_zh: 基于目标相关经验的测试时离线强化学习

sentences.en: Foundation models compress a large amount of information in a single, large neural network, which can then be queried for individual tasks.
sentences.zh: 基础模型将大量信息压缩进单个大型神经网络中，然后可以针对单个任务进行查询。

sentences.en: There are strong parallels between this widespread framework and offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning algorithms: a universal value function is trained on a large number of goals, and the policy is evaluated on a single goal in each test episode.
sentences.zh: 这一广泛框架与离线目标条件强化学习算法之间有很强的相通之处：一个通用价值函数在大量目标上训练，而策略在每次测试回合中针对单一目标进行评估。

sentences.en: Extensive research in foundation models has shown that performance can be substantially improved through test-time training, specializing the model to the current goal.
sentences.zh: 基础模型方面的大量研究表明，通过测试时训练使模型特化到当前目标，可以显著提升性能。

sentences.en: We find similarly that test-time offline reinforcement learning on experience related to the test goal can lead to substantially better policies at modest compute costs.
sentences.zh: 我们同样发现，在与测试目标相关的经验上进行测试时离线强化学习，可以以适中的计算成本带来明显更优的策略。

sentences.en: We propose a novel self-supervised data selection criterion, which selects transitions from an offline dataset according to their relevance to the current state and quality with respect to the evaluation goal.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的自监督数据选择准则，它根据转移与当前状态的相关性及其相对于评估目标的质量，从离线数据集中选择转移样本。

sentences.en: We demonstrate across a wide range of high-dimensional loco-navigation and manipulation tasks that fine-tuning a policy on the selected data for a few gradient steps leads to significant performance gains over standard offline pre-training.
sentences.zh: 我们在广泛的高维移动-导航和操作任务上展示，仅对所选数据微调策略几个梯度步，就能带来相对于标准离线预训练的显著性能提升。

sentences.en: Our goal-conditioned test-time training (GC-TTT) algorithm applies this routine in a receding-horizon fashion during evaluation, adapting the policy to the current trajectory as it is being rolled out.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标条件测试时训练（GC-TTT）算法在评估期间以前瞻性滚动的方式应用这一流程，随着当前轨迹的推出不断调整策略。

sentences.en: Finally, we study compute allocation at inference, demonstrating that, at comparable costs, GC-TTT induces performance gains that are not achievable by scaling model size.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们研究了推断时的计算分配，证明在相当的成本下，GC-TTT 带来的性能提升是单纯扩大模型规模所无法实现的。

title_en: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Flow Matching
title_zh: 面向流匹配的测试时强化学习

sentences.en: Flow-matching has emerged as a leading framework for high-fidelity text-to-image generation.
sentences.zh: 流匹配已成为高保真文本到图像生成的主导框架。

sentences.en: However, its alignment with human preferences through RL is often hindered by substantial computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 然而，通过 RL 实现其与人类偏好的对齐，常常受到可观计算开销的阻碍。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce Flow-TTRL, the first test-time reinforcement learning framework that achieves alignment on the fly.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入了 Flow-TTRL，第一个实现即时对齐的测试时强化学习框架。

sentences.en: Our approach reinterprets intermediate latent representations as an implicit policy and utilizes SDE-based rollouts to explore high-reward trajectories within the learned vector field.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将中间潜在表示重新诠释为隐式策略，并利用基于 SDE 的 rollout 在所学向量场中探索高奖励轨迹。

sentences.en: Specifically, we propose a two-stage optimization strategy: Proximal Reward Difference Prediction (PRDP) ensures structural stability in high-noise regimes through pairwise reward regression, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines fine-grained aesthetic details by maximizing relative advantages within sampled candidate groups.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们提出了一种两阶段优化策略：近端奖励差异预测（PRDP）通过成对奖励回归确保高噪声环境中的结构稳定性，而组相对策略优化（GRPO）通过最大化采样候选组内的相对优势来细化细粒度的美学细节。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that Flow-TTRL significantly boosts aesthetic quality, text-image alignment, and human preference across diverse backbones.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，Flow-TTRL 在多种骨干网络上显著提升了美学质量、文本-图像对齐和人类偏好。

sentences.en: On the GenEval benchmark, Flow-TTRL elevates the accuracy of SD 3.5-Medium from 63\% to 87\% and Flux.1 Dev from 66\% to 83\%.
sentences.zh: 在 GenEval 基准上，Flow-TTRL 将 SD 3.5-Medium 的准确率从 63\% 提升到 87\%，并将 Flux.1 Dev 从 66\% 提升到 83\%。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our framework achieves an average gain of 15\% to 20\% across T2I-CompBench metrics, delivering performance comparable to state-of-the-art RL-based fine-tuning methods without the need for additional fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的框架在 T2I-CompBench 指标上实现了平均 15\% 到 20\% 的提升，在无需额外微调的情况下，提供了与最先进的基于 RL 的微调方法相当的性能。

sentences.en: Our code is available at ~\url{https://github.com/TheShy-Dream/Flow-TTRL}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 ~\url{https://github.com/TheShy-Dream/Flow-TTRL} 获取。

title_en: Test-Time Training with KV Binding Is Secretly Linear Attention
title_zh: 带 KV 绑定的测试时训练其实是一种线性注意力

sentences.en: Test-time training (TTT) with KV binding as sequence modeling layer is commonly interpreted as a form of online meta-learning that memorizes a key–value mapping at test time.
sentences.zh: 将带 KV 绑定的测试时训练（TTT）作为序列建模层，通常被诠释为一种在测试时记忆键-值映射的在线元学习形式。

sentences.en: However, our analysis reveals multiple phenomena that contradict this memorization-based interpretation.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的分析揭示了多种与这种基于记忆的诠释相矛盾的现象。

sentences.en: Motivated by these findings, we revisit the formulation of TTT and show that a broad class of TTT architectures can be expressed as a form of learned linear attention operator.
sentences.zh: 受这些发现的启发，我们重新审视了 TTT 的公式，并表明一大类 TTT 架构可以被表达为一种学习到的线性注意力算子。

sentences.en: Beyond explaining previously puzzling model behaviors, this perspective yields multiple practical benefits: it enables principled architectural simplifications, admits fully parallel formulations that preserve performance while improving efficiency, and provides a systematic reduction of diverse TTT variants to a standard linear attention form.
sentences.zh: 除了解释此前令人费解的模型行为之外，这一视角还带来多种实际益处：它支持有原则的架构简化；允许在保持性能的同时提升效率的完全并行公式；并为多种多样的 TTT 变体提供了一种将其系统规约为标准线性注意力形式的简化方案。

sentences.en: Overall, our results reframe TTT not as test-time memorization, but as learned linear attention with enhanced representational capacity.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果将 TTT 重新定位为——并非测试时记忆——而是一种具有更强表示能力的习得线性注意力。

sentences.en: Project page: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/tttla/.
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/tttla/。

authors.name: Sven Elflein
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Toronto

title_en: TestExplora: Benchmarking LLMs for Proactive Bug Discovery via Repository-Level Test Generation
title_zh: TestExplora：通过仓库级测试生成对 LLM 进行主动缺陷发现基准测试

sentences.en: Given that Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to automate software development, comprehensive software assurance spans three distinct goals: regression prevention, reactive reproduction, and proactive discovery.
sentences.zh: 鉴于大型语言模型（LLM）日益被应用于软件开发的自动化，全面的软件保障涵盖三个不同目标：回归预防、事后再现和主动发现。

sentences.en: Current evaluations systematically overlook the third goal.
sentences.zh: 当前的评估系统性地忽视了第三个目标。

sentences.en: Specifically, they either constrain models to a compliance trap by treating existing code as the ground truth for regression prevention, or rely on post-failure artifacts (e.g., issue reports) for reactive bug reproduction, failing to expose defects before they manifest as failures.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，它们要么将模型约束在合规陷阱中，把现有代码视为回归预防的基准真值；要么依赖故障后的人工产物（例如问题报告）进行反应式缺陷再现，从而未能在缺陷表现为故障之前将其暴露。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we present TestExplora, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs as proactive testers within full-scale, realistic repository environments.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们提出了 TestExplora，一个在完整、逼真的仓库环境中评估 LLM 作为主动测试员的基准。

sentences.en: Comprising 2,389 tasks across 482 repositories, TestExplora conceals all defect-related information, forcing models to uncover bugs by identifying discrepancies between implementation and documentation-derived intent—utilizing documentation as the reference oracle.
sentences.zh: TestExplora 包含跨 482 个仓库的 2,389 个任务，它隐藏所有与缺陷相关的信息，迫使模型通过识别实现与文档推导意图之间的差异来发现缺陷——以文档作为参考预言机。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to ensure sustainable evaluation and mitigate risks of data leakage in static datasets, we propose a continuous, time-aware data collection framework.
sentences.zh: 此外，为确保持续评估并缓解静态数据集中的数据泄漏风险，我们提出了一种持续的、时间感知的数据收集框架。

sentences.en: Our evaluation reveals a significant capability gap: state-of-the-art models achieve a maximum Fail-to-Pass ($F2P$) rate of only 16.06%.
sentences.zh: 我们的评估揭示了一个显著的能力差距：最先进的模型实现的失败到通过（$F2P$）率最高仅为 16.06%。

sentences.en: Further analysis indicates that navigating complex cross-module interactions and leveraging agentic exploration are critical to advancing LLMs toward autonomous software quality assurance.
sentences.zh: 进一步分析表明，导航复杂的跨模块交互并利用智能体式探索，对于推动 LLM 走向自主软件质量保障至关重要。

sentences.en: Consistent with this, SWEAgent instantiated with GPT-5-mini achieves an $F2P$ of 17.27% and an $F2P@5$ of 29.7%, highlighting the effectiveness and promise of agentic exploration in proactive bug discovery tasks.
sentences.zh: 与此一致，以 GPT-5-mini 实例化的 SWEAgent 实现了 17.27% 的 $F2P$ 和 29.7% 的 $F2P@5$，凸显了智能体式探索在主动缺陷发现任务中的有效性和前景。

title_en: Testing For Distribution Shifts with Conditional Conformal Test Martingales
title_zh: 使用条件共形检验鞅进行分布偏移检测

sentences.en: We propose a sequential test for distribution-shift detection that allows conformal test martingales (CTMs) to work under a fixed, reference-conditional setting.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种用于分布偏移检测的序列检验，它使共形检验鞅（CTM）能够在固定的参考条件设定下工作。

sentences.en: Existing CTM detectors construct test martingales by continually growing a reference set with each incoming sample, using it to assess how atypical the new sample is relative to past observations.
sentences.zh: 现有的 CTM 检测器通过随每个新样本不断扩增参考集来构造检验鞅，并用它来评估新样本相对于先前观测的异常程度。

sentences.en: While this design yields anytime-valid type-I error control, it suffers from test-time contamination: after a change, post-shift observations enter the reference set and dilute the evidence for distribution shift, increasing detection delay and reducing power.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种设计能提供任意时刻有效的第一类错误控制，但它饱受测试时污染的困扰：变化发生后，偏移后的观测会进入参考集，稀释分布偏移的证据，从而增大检测延迟并降低功效。

sentences.en: In contrast, our method avoids contamination by design by comparing each new sample to a fixed null reference dataset.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们的方法通过将每个新样本与固定的零假设参考数据集进行比较，在设计上避免了污染。

sentences.en: Our main technical contribution is a robust martingale construction that remains valid conditional on the null reference data, achieved by explicitly accounting for the estimation error in the reference distribution induced by the finite reference set.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要技术贡献是一种稳健的鞅构造，它在以零假设参考数据为条件时仍然有效，这是通过显式计入由有限参考集引起的参考分布估计误差而实现的。

sentences.en: This yields anytime-valid type-I error control together with guarantees of asymptotic power one and bounded expected detection delay.
sentences.zh: 这带来了任意时刻有效的第一类错误控制，以及渐近功效为一和有界期望检测延迟的保证。

sentences.en: Empirically, our method detects shifts faster than standard CTMs, providing a powerful and reliable distribution-shift detector.
sentences.zh: 实证上，我们的方法比标准 CTM 检测偏移更快，提供了一种功能强大且可靠的分布偏移检测器。

authors.name: Yarin Bar
authors.institution: Computer Science Department, Technion-Israel Institute of Technology

title_en: TetraJet-v2: Accurate NVFP4 Training for Large Language Models with Oscillation Suppression and Outlier Control
title_zh: TetraJet-v2：具有振荡抑制与离群值控制的 LLM 精确 NVFP4 训练

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) training is prohibitively expensive, driving interest in low-precision fully-quantized training (FQT).
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的训练成本高得令人望而却步，这推动了人们对低精度全量化训练（FQT）的兴趣。

sentences.en: While novel 4-bit formats like NVFP4 offer substantial efficiency gains, achieving near-lossless training at such low precision remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 虽然像 NVFP4 这样的新型 4 位格式提供了可观的效率增益，但在如此低的精度下实现近乎无损失的训练仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: We introduce **TetraJet-v2**, an end-to-end 4-bit FQT method that leverages NVFP4 for activations, weights and gradients in all linear layers.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 **TetraJet-v2**，一种端到端的 4 位 FQT 方法，它在所有线性层中对激活、权重和梯度利用 NVFP4。

sentences.en: We identify two critical issues hindering low-precision LLM training: weight oscillation and outliers.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出阻碍低精度 LLM 训练的两个关键问题：权重振荡和离群值。

sentences.en: To address these, we propose: 1) an unbiased double-block quantization method for NVFP4 linear layers, 2) **OsciReset**, an algorithm to suppress weight oscillation, and 3) **OutControl**, an algorithm to retain outlier accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出：1）一种用于 NVFP4 线性层的无偏双块量化方法；2）**OsciReset**，一种抑制权重振荡的算法；以及 3）**OutControl**，一种保持离群值精度的算法。

sentences.en: **TetraJet-v2** outperforms prior methods on FP4 pre-training for LLMs across models up to 370M parameters trained up to 212B tokens, reducing the performance gap to BF16 by an average of $51.3$% while enabling an $1.67\times$ end-to-end speedup over FP8.
sentences.zh: **TetraJet-v2** 在多达 370M 参数的预训练高达 212B token 的 LLM 的 FP4 预训练上优于先前方法，将到 BF16 的性能差距平均缩小了 51.3%，同时相较 FP8 实现了 $1.67\times$ 的端到端加速。

authors.name: Michael Beyer
authors.institution: Robert Bosch GmbH, Bosch Center for Artificial Intelligence

title_en: TexEditor: Structure-Preserving Text-Driven Texture Editing
title_zh: TexEditor：保持结构的文本驱动纹理编辑

sentences.en: Text-guided texture editing aims to modify object appearance while preserving the underlying geometric structure.
sentences.zh: 文本引导的纹理编辑旨在修改物体外观，同时保持底层的几何结构。

sentences.en: However, our empirical analysis reveals that even SOTA editing models frequently struggle to maintain structural consistency during texture editing, despite the intended changes being purely appearance-related.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的实证分析揭示，尽管预期更改纯粹与外观相关，即便最先进的编辑模型也常常难以在纹理编辑过程中保持结构一致性。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we jointly enhance structure preservation from both data and training perspectives, and build TexEditor, a dedicated texture editing model based on Qwen-Image-Edit-2509.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察启发，我们从数据和训练两个角度共同增强结构保持，并构建了 TexEditor，一个基于 Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 的专用纹理编辑模型。

sentences.en: Firstly, we construct BlenderTex, a high-quality SFT dataset generated with Blender, which provides strong structural priors for a cold start.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们构建了 BlenderTex，一个用 Blender 生成的高质量 SFT 数据集，它为冷启动提供了强大的结构先验。

sentences.en: Secondly, we introduce StructureNFT, a RL–based approach that integrates structure-preserving losses to transfer the structural priors learned during SFT to real-world scenes.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们引入了 StructureNFT，一种基于 RL 的方法，将结构保持损失整合进来，把 SFT 阶段学到的结构先验迁移到真实世界场景。

sentences.en: Moreover, due to the limited realism and evaluation coverage of existing benchmarks, we introduce TexBench, a general-purpose real-world benchmark for text-guided texture editing.
sentences.zh: 此外，由于现有基准的真实感和评估覆盖有限，我们引入了 TexBench，一个面向文本引导纹理编辑的通用真实世界基准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on existing Blender-based texture benchmarks and our TexBench show that TexEditor consistently outperforms strong baselines such as Nano Banana Pro.
sentences.zh: 在现有的基于 Blender 的纹理基准和我们的 TexBench 上进行的大量实验表明，TexEditor 持续优于 Nano Banana Pro 等强基线。

sentences.en: In addition, we assess TexEditor on the general-purpose benchmark ImgEdit to validate its generalization.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在通用基准 ImgEdit 上评估 TexEditor，以验证其泛化能力。

title_en: Text Before Vision: Staged Knowledge Injection Matters for Agentic RLVR in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding
title_zh: 文本先于视觉：分阶段知识注入对超高分辨率遥感理解中的智能体 RLVR 至关重要

sentences.en: Multimodal reasoning for ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) is usually bottlenecked by visual evidence acquisition: the model necessities localizing tiny task-relevant regions in massive pixel spaces.
sentences.zh: 超高分辨率（UHR）遥感（RS）的多模态推理通常受限于视觉证据获取：模型需要在海量像素空间中定位微小的任务相关区域。

sentences.en: While Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) using zoom-in tools offers a path forward, we find that standard reinforcement learning struggles to navigate these vast visual spaces without structured domain priors.
sentences.zh: 虽然使用缩放工具的带可验证奖励的智能体强化学习（RLVR）提供了一条前进之路，但我们发现，如果没有结构化的领域先验，标准强化学习难以在这些广阔的视觉空间中导航。

sentences.en: In this paper, we investigate the interplay between post-training paradigms: comparing Cold-start Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), RLVR, and Agentic RLVR on the UHR RS benchmark.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了各类后训练范式之间的相互作用：在 UHR RS 基准上比较冷启动监督微调（SFT）、RLVR 和智能体 RLVR。

sentences.en: Our controlled studies yield a counter-intuitive finding: high-quality Earth-science text-only QA is a primary driver of UHR visual reasoning gains.
sentences.zh: 我们的受控研究得出了一个反直觉的发现：高质量的地球科学纯文本问答是 UHR 视觉推理提升的主要驱动力。

sentences.en: Despite lacking images, domain-specific text injects the concepts, mechanistic explanations, and decision rules necessary to guide visual evidence retrieval.
sentences.zh: 尽管缺乏图像，领域特异的文本注入了引导视觉证据检索所必需的概念、机理解释和决策规则。

sentences.en: Based on this, we propose a staged knowledge injection recipe: (1) cold-starting with scalable, knowledge-graph-verified Earth-science text QA to instill reasoning structures; and (2) "pre-warming'' on the same hard UHR image–text examples during SFT to stabilize and amplify subsequent tool-based RL.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出了一种分阶段知识注入方案：（1）以可扩展的、经知识图谱验证的地球科学文本问答进行冷启动，以灌输推理结构；（2）在 SFT 期间，对同样的高难度 UHR 图像-文本示例进行“预热”，以稳定并放大后续基于工具的 RL。

sentences.en: This approach achieves a 60.04\% Pass@1 on XLRS-Bench, significantly outperforming larger general-purpose models (e.g., GPT-5.2, Gemini 3.0 Pro, Intern-S1) and establishing a new state-of-the-art. We provide both the automated data pipeline and the rigorous ablation studies that validate this "Text-Before-Vision'' paradigm.
sentences.zh: 该方法在 XLRS-Bench 上取得了 60.04\% 的 Pass@1，显著优于更大的通用模型（例如 GPT-5.2、Gemini 3.0 Pro、Intern-S1），树立了新的最先进水平。我们同时提供了自动化数据流水线和严谨的消融研究，以验证这一“文本先于视觉”范式。

sentences.en: Datasets and code will be released.
sentences.zh: 数据集和代码将予以发布。

authors.institution: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

title_en: Text Generation as Continuous Latent Dynamics via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 将文本生成视为连续潜在动力学：基于强化学习的视角

sentences.en: We propose to model text generation as a continuous-time latent dynamical process, where token generation is formulated as a Markov decision process whose internal state evolves via a neural ODE.
sentences.zh: 我们提出将文本生成建模为连续时间的潜在动力学过程，其中词元生成被表述为一个内部状态通过神经ODE 演化的马尔可夫决策过程。

sentences.en: This formulation bridges discrete token sequences and continuous semantic evolution, providing a theoretically grounded framework for text generation with continuous-time latent states.
sentences.zh: 这一表述架起了离散词元序列与连续语义演化之间的桥梁，为具有连续时间潜在状态的文本生成提供了有理论基础的框架。

sentences.en: The framework is optimized via reinforcement learning, maximizing a composite objective that integrates cumulative rewards with a Kullback–Leibler divergence regularization term from a pre-trained language model.
sentences.zh: 该框架通过强化学习进行优化，最大化一个将累积奖励与来自预训练语言模型的 Kullback–Leibler 散度正则项整合起来的复合目标。

sentences.en: Both theoretical and empirical results demonstrate that our Continuous-Time Latent Language Model (CT-LLM) achieves superior effectiveness and efficiency in text generation, establishing a new paradigm for continuous-time language modeling.
sentences.zh: 理论和实证结果均表明，我们的连续时间潜在语言模型（CT-LLM）在文本生成方面取得了卓越的有效性和效率，为连续时间语言建模确立了新的范式。

title_en: Text Has Curvature
title_zh: 文本具有曲率

sentences.en: Does natural language text have an intrinsic curvature?
sentences.zh: 自然语言文本是否具有内在的曲率？

sentences.en: Language is increasingly modeled in curved geometries—hyperbolic spaces for hierarchy, mixed-curvature manifolds for compositional structure—yet a basic scientific question remains unresolved: what does curvature mean for text itself, in a way that is native to language rather than an artifact of the embedding space we choose?
sentences.zh: 语言正越来越多地在弯曲几何中被建模——用双曲空间表示层级、用混合曲率流形表示组合结构——然而一个基础的科学问题仍未解决：对文本本身而言，曲率意味着什么，并且这种含义是语言固有的，而非我们所选嵌入空间的产物？

sentences.en: We argue that text does indeed have curvature, and show how to detect it, define it, and use it.
sentences.zh: 我们主张文本确实具有曲率，并展示了如何检测它、定义它和使用它。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose Texture, a text-native, word-level discrete curvature signal, and make three contributions.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了 Texture，一种文本本源的、词级离散曲率信号，并做出了三项贡献。

sentences.en: (a) Existence: We provide empirical and theoretical certificates that semantic inference in natural corpora is non-flat.
sentences.zh: （a）存在性：我们提供了经验上的和理论上的证明，表明自然语料中的语义推断是非平坦的。

sentences.en: (b) Definition: We define Texture as a signed two-axis curvature of the word-in-context belief field—the differential of reconciliation between prefix and suffix—measuring, via a debiased Schrödinger transport divergence, whether adding context from one side contracts the semantic effect of context from the other side (focus, positive) or expands it into competing continuations (fan-out, negative).
sentences.zh: （b）定义：我们将 Texture 定义为词在上下文中信念场的带符号双轴曲率——前缀与后缀之间协调的差分——通过一种去偏的 Schrödinger 输运散度来衡量，添加一侧的上下文是收缩另一侧上下文的语义影响（聚焦，正），还是将其扩展为相互竞争的延续（扇出，负）。

sentences.en: (c) Utility: Texture is actionable: it serves as a general-purpose measurement and control primitive enabling geometry without geometric training; we instantiate it on two representative tasks, improving long-context inference through curvature-guided compression and retrieval-augmented generation through curvature-guided routing.
sentences.zh: （c）效用：Texture 是可行动的：它作为一种通用测量和控制原语，无需几何训练即可实现几何；我们将其实例化在两个代表性任务上，通过曲率引导的压缩改进长上下文推断，并通过曲率引导的路由改进检索增强生成。

sentences.en: Together, our results establish a text native curvature paradigm, making Texture practically useful.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果确立了文本本源的曲率范式，使 Texture 具有实际用途。

title_en: Text-Conditional JEPA for Learning Semantically Rich Visual Representations
title_zh: 用于学习语义丰富视觉表示的文本条件 JEPA

sentences.en: Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA) offers a promising approach to visual self-supervised learning through masked feature prediction.
sentences.zh: 基于图像的联合嵌入预测架构（I-JEPA）通过掩码特征预测，为视觉自监督学习提供了一种有前景的方法。

sentences.en: However with the inherent visual uncertainty at masked positions, feature prediction remains challenging and may fail to learn semantic representations.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于掩码位置固有的视觉不确定性，特征预测仍然具有挑战性，并可能无法学习语义表示。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Text-Conditional JEPA (TC-JEPA) that uses image captions to reduce the prediction uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了文本条件 JEPA（TC-JEPA），它使用图像标题来降低预测不确定性。

sentences.en: Specifically, we modulate the predicted patch features using a fine-grained text conditioner that computes sparse cross-attention over input text tokens.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们利用一个细粒度的文本条件器来调制预测的补丁特征，该条件器对输入文本词元计算稀疏的交叉注意力。

sentences.en: With such conditioning, patch features become predictable as a function of text, thus are more semantically meaningful.
sentences.zh: 借助这种条件化，补丁特征成为文本的函数，因此更具语义意义。

sentences.en: We show TC-JEPA improves downstream performance and training stability, with promising scaling properties.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，TC-JEPA 改善了下游性能和训练稳定性，并具有有前景的扩展特性。

sentences.en: TC-JEPA also offers a new vision-language pretraining paradigm based on feature prediction only, outperforming contrastive methods on diverse tasks, especially those requiring fine-grained visual understanding and reasoning.
sentences.zh: TC-JEPA 还提供了一种仅基于特征预测的新的视觉-语言预训练范式，在多样任务上优于对比方法，尤其是在需要细粒度视觉理解和推理的任务上。
